Chandrabhanu Satpathy and Malay Mishra composed the music. Satpathy and Nirmal Nayak were among the lyricists, and the singers included Satyajit Pradhan, Ira Mohanty and Bishnu Mohan Kabi.
The film was released in cinemas on 4 July 2025.

Q116809820.lead: Bohu Ama Bichhuati is a 2023 Odia-language film directed by Sanjay Nayak, starring Lipsa Mishra and Bikram, which premiered on television.

p: Raja Nayak produced the film. Dillip Kumar Das wrote the story, Debidatta Mohanty the dialogue, and Sanjay Nayak the screenplay. R. Bhagat Singh was the cinematographer and Ranjan Khatei the editor. Manaswini Pati, Kuna Tripathy, Rabi Mishra, Dhir Mallik, Rajashree and Pragyan Pradhan appeared in supporting roles.

Baidyanath Dash scored the film, with lyrics by Nirmal Nayak and Debidatta Mohanty. The singers included Humane Sagar, Neha Niharika Kar, Antara Chakraborty, Satyajit Pradhan, Abhijit Majumdar, Sanju Mohanty and Sital Kabi.
Rather than a theatrical opening, the film was released on Tarang TV and Tarang Plus on 29 January 2023.

Q47090769.lead: Dhire Dhire Prema Hela is a 2009 Odia-language film written and directed by Dilip Panda, with Sabyasachi Mishra and Barsha Priyadarshini in the lead roles.

p: Sunil Rout produced the film. Dilip Panda wrote the story and screenplay, directed, and is also credited as editor; Subodh Patnaik wrote the dialogue. Sushant Bahinipati and Abhiram Mishra shared the cinematography. Mihir Das, Chandan Kar, Priya Mahapatra, Priyanka Mahapatra, Jayiram Samal, Kirti Mohanty, Minaketan, Pradyumna Lenka and Kuna Tripathy were in the supporting cast.

Prem Anand composed the music. The lyricists included Basantaraj Samal, Bijay Malla, Arun Mantri and Prabhanshu Samantaray, and Mohammed Aziz, Kumar Bapi, Sricharan Mohanty, Tapu Mishra and Udit Narayan were among the singers.
The film was released on 1 January 2009.

Q43227222.lead: Chowka Chhaka is a 2013 Odia-language film written and directed by K. Murali Krishna, starring Sambit Acharya and Nutan Mohanty.

p: Gayadhar Jena produced the film. K. Murali Krishna wrote the story and screenplay as well as directing, and Deepak Jena wrote the dialogue. R. Bhagat Singh was the cinematographer and Chandrasekhar Mishra the editor. Papu Pam Pam, Lovely, Sritam Das, Sunita Garabadu, Pradyumna Lenka, Priyanka Mahapatra, Shakti Baral, Salil Mitra, Babu Pradhan and Hara Patnaik made up the supporting cast.
Abhijit Majumdar composed the score, and the lyrics were by Nizam and Nirmal Nayak. Udit Narayan, Vinod Rathod, Pamela Jain, Anjali Mishra, Abhijit Majumdar, Rinki and Anuradha Paudwal sang.
It was released on 24 March 2013.
Papu Pam Pam won the best comedian award for this film at Chalachitra Jagat's 38th annual festival and Pratibha Samman in 2013.

Q112632038.lead: Adha Lekha Gapa is a 2022 Odia-language film directed by Sudhanshu Mohan Sahu and produced by Pradyumna Lenka, with Abhishek Giri and Arlin Ankita in the leading roles.

p: B. Chandan Kumar wrote the story and dialogue, and Debidatta Mohanty the screenplay. Rabindra Behera was the cinematographer and Rajesh Dash the editor. Satyaki Misra, Madhumita Mohanty, Choudhury Bikash Das, Ananta Mishra and Devi Barik were among the supporting cast, along with the producer himself.
Prem Anand composed the music and Debidatta Mohanty wrote the songs. Biswajit Mahapatra, Satyajit Pradhan, Diptirekha Padhi, Sohini Mishra, Bishnu Mohan Kabi and Pragyan Hota were among the singers.
The film premiered on Tarang TV and Tarang Plus on 13 February 2022.

Q28006033.lead: Punarmilan is a 1977 Odia-language film directed by K. D. H. Rao, with a cast that included Raghunath Behera, Chakrapani, Ajit Das, Tandra Ray and Roja Ramani.

p: Rama Rao produced the film. Its story was by K. P. Kottarakkara and the dialogue by Raghu Mishra, who also appeared in it. K. G. Viragan was the cinematographer and Ajay Kumar the editor. Other performers included Gananath Jena, Ajit Kar, Nityananda Mishra, Saroj Mishra, Sunil Mishra, Rituparna Pattnaik, Niharika Sahu, Basanta Samal and Durga Satpathy.

Upendra Kumar composed the music. Shibabrata Das and Raghu Mishra wrote lyrics, and the playback singers included Sikandar Alam, H. P. Geetha, S. Janaki, Pranab Patnaik, Malabika Ray, Swarnalata and S. Vidyarani.
The film, 136 minutes long, was released on 13 April 1977.

Q109519704.lead: Rati Sari Sari Jauchhi is a 2021 Odia-language television film directed by Anupam Patnaik, starring Raj Rajesh Panda and Riya Dey.

p: Manas Padihari wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue. The film was Anupam Patnaik's first as a director. Deepak Kumar was the cinematographer, and Jagadish Mishra and Sabyasachi Mishra edited it. Sukanta Rath, Raimohan Parida, Jiban Panda, Anindya, Nibi and Samparka Mishra were in the supporting cast.

Srikanta Panda composed the music. Sthita Patnaik, Rakesh Dash and Parambrahma Tripathy wrote the lyrics, and Ratikanta Satpathy, Kuldeep Pattanaik, Gourav Kumar, Asima Panda and Sucharita were among the singers.
The film premiered on Manjari TV on 15 August 2021.

Q114804708.lead: Hi Krushna is a 2022 Odia-language television film directed by Happy Chandan, with Sailendra Samantray and Jasmine Rath in the lead roles of Jeet and Anu.

p: Manoj Mishra and Chinmay Mishra produced the film. Pranab Rath wrote the story and dialogue, and Happy Chandan wrote the screenplay, directed and edited it. Biswajit Kuldi was the cinematographer. Manoj Mishra also acted, as a police officer; Sukanta Rath and Mamuni Barik played Jeet's parents, Subhransu Nayak and Rakhee Dash played Anu's parents, and Shweta Acharya played a college principal.
The music is credited to Bunny-Gourav. Sumit Panda, Satyaranjan Bal, Sthita Patnaik and Sandeep Panda wrote the lyrics, and Papu Pam Pam, Arpita Choudhury, Gourav Anand and Kuldeep Pattanaik sang.
The film premiered on Tarang TV and Tarang Plus on 14 August 2022.

Q109855673.lead: Chorani is a 2021 Odia-language television film directed by Mrutyunjay Sahu, starring Jagjit Pal and Sheetal Patra.

p: Ajay Rout produced the film. Debidatta Mohanty wrote the story and screenplay, and B. Chandan Kumar the dialogue. S. Ranjan was the cinematographer and Rajesh Dash the editor. Jagjit Pal played Rajesh and Sheetal Patra played Anu; Raimohan Parida, Pintu Nanda, Choudhury Jayprakash Das, Rakhee Dash, Tribhuban Panda and Kunal Pattnaik also appeared.

Abhijit Majumdar composed the music, with lyrics by Nirmal Nayak and Debidatta Mohanty. Swayam Padhi, Sasank Sekhar, Antara Chakraborty, Sohini Mishra and Smrutimayee Mahapatra were among the singers.
The film, which runs about 2 hours 49 minutes, premiered on Tarang TV and Tarang Plus on 28 November 2021.

Q115786312.lead: Parikaribe Bholashankar is a 2022 Odia-language television film directed by Mrutyunjay Sahu, starring Dipak Barik and Sasmita Piyali Sahoo.

p: Ajay Rout produced the film, and Chinmay Das Pattnaik wrote its story, screenplay and dialogue. R. Bhagat Singh was the cinematographer and Rajesh Dash the editor. Pintu Nanda, Pradyumna Lenka, Bina Moharana, Rabi Mishra, Soumya, Guddu and Lucky were in the supporting cast, along with the child actor Sourans.

Prasant Padhi composed the music to lyrics by Nirmal Nayak. Humane Sagar, Asima Panda, Satyajit Pradhan, Antara Chakraborty, Sohini Mishra, Tariq Aziz, Bishnu Mohan Kabi and Swastik sang. The songs were released on 31 October 2022.
The film premiered on Zee Sarthak on 6 November 2022, timed for the Bada Osha festival.

Q20890421.lead: Sri Jagannath is a 1979 Odia-language film directed by Bijay Bhaskar, based on the legend of how Nilamadhaba was found and how King Indradyumna came to build the Srimandira.

p: The film covers the discovery of Nilamadhaba at Nilakandara, Vidyapati's meeting with Lalita, and how Viswavasu allows Vidyapati to see Nilamadhaba. It ends with King Indradyumna's construction of the Srimandira.

Kranti Kumar produced the film and Bijay Mishra wrote the screenplay. T. H. Rama Rao was the cinematographer. Chakrapani played Vidyapati, Jharana Das Queen Gundicha, Kedar Guru King Indradyumna, Nityananda Mishra Viswavasu and Munishree Lalita; Shyamalendu Bhattacharya, Dhiren Das, Mamina and Luna Mahapatra also had roles.
Akshaya Mohanty directed the music and also wrote lyrics and sang, alongside lyricists Binodini Devi and Shirshananda Das Kanungo and singer S. Janaki.
It was released on 14 September 1979.

Q56026886.lead: Suna Chadhei is a 1988 Odia-language film directed by Ravi Kinagi, starring Uttam Mohanty and Archana Joglekar.

p: Keshab Rout and Sunil Rout produced the film. The story was credited to Ravi Kinagi and Bijay Mishra; Mishra also wrote the dialogue and Kinagi the screenplay. Ranjan Kinagi was the cinematographer and Rabi Shankar Patnaik the editor. Bijay Mohanty, Debu Bose, Hara Patnaik, Anita Das, Ajit Das, Akshaya Mohanty, Jayiram Samal, Debu Brahma and Runu Parija were also in the cast.

Akshaya Mohanty composed the music. The lyricists included Debdas Chhotray, Shirshananda Das Kanungo and Mohanty himself, and Mohammed Aziz, Mahendra Kapoor, Anuradha Paudwal and Ravindra Sathe were among the singers.
The film was released on 1 April 1988.

Q56677595.lead: Pua Bhangi Dela Suna Sansara is a 1999 Odia-language film directed by Basant Sahu, featuring Siddhanta Mahapatra, Moumita Gupta, Aparajita Mohanty and Uttam Mohanty.

p: Dhruba Rana produced the film from a story by Srinath Rana. Arun Mohanty and Shirshananda Das Kanungo wrote the screenplay. Rama Krishna was the cinematographer and Ashok Sharma the editor. Namrata Das, Debu Bose, Debu Brahma, Biraj Dash, Salil Mitra, Asit Pati, Jayiram Samal and Kuna Tripathy were among the other actors.

Bachu Mukherjee composed the music. Arun Mohanty, Nimai Mohanty, Purnendu Das Mahapatra and Ranjit Patnaik wrote the lyrics, and Subasish Mahakud, Lopita Mishra, Shakti Mishra, Ira Mohanty, T. Souri and Babul Supriyo sang.

Q50825302.lead: Prem Rogi is a 2009 Odia-language film written and directed by Ashok Pati, with Buddhaditya Mohanty and Barsha Priyadarshini in the lead roles.

p: Narayan Nayak and Sunita Narendra Singh produced the film. Ashok Pati wrote the story and screenplay, and Rajani Ranjan wrote the dialogue. Sitanshu Mahapatra was the cinematographer and Sushant Mani the editor. Siddhanta Mahapatra, Babi Mishra, Arpita Mukherjee, Pintu Nanda, Santosh Bhuyan, Bibhu Kishore and Rakhee Dash were among the supporting cast, Sabyasachi Mishra made a guest appearance, and Anmol Pati appeared as a child actor.

Prasant Padhi, who also acted in the film, composed the music. Basantaraj Samal, Nirmal Nayak and Rajani Ranjan wrote lyrics, and the singers included Kumar Bapi, Bibhu Kishore, Krishna, Tapu Mishra, Udit Narayan, T. Souri and Suresh Wadkar.

Q15723710.lead: Asibu Kebe Saji Mo Rani is a 2010 Odia-language film directed by Manoranjan Pal, starring Akash Dasnayak and Khushi Garvi.

p: Rakesh Behera and Anurag Sahu produced the film. Chaitanya Behera wrote the story, Ajay Samal the dialogue, and Manoranjan Pal the screenplay. S. Ranjan was the cinematographer and Kuna Raul the editor. Mihir Das, Bina Moharana, Raimohan Parida, Akshaya Bastia, Braja Singh, Devi Barik, Debu Bose and Smita Mohanty were in the supporting cast; the writer Chaitanya Behera and producer Anurag Sahu also appeared.

Gagan Bihari directed the music. Arun Mantri and Panchanan Nayak wrote the songs, which were sung by Abhijeet, Mohammed Aziz, Bapu Goswami, Ira Mohanty, Udit Narayan, Sailabhama Mahapatra and Suresh Wadkar, among others.
The film was released on 19 November 2010.

Q41377215.lead: Rasta is a 2014 Odia-language film directed by Nishikant Dalabehera, starring Abhilash and Elli Padhi.

p: Lambodar Hota produced the film, which was based on a story by Prabhanjan Mishra. Nishikant Dalabehera wrote the screenplay and dialogue. Prabhanjan Mishra also acted, alongside Choudhury Bikash Das, Debu Bose, Nupur Ghosh, Choudhury Jayprakash Das, Susmita Mishra, Suryanarayan Mishra, Udayabhanu and Sankar Basu Mallick.

Dalabehera composed the music as well. Mohit Chakraborty and Panchanan Nayak wrote the lyrics, and Satyajit, Ratikanta, Rozalin, Bishnu Mohan Kabi, Anita and Antara Chakraborty were among the singers.
The film was released on 25 December 2014.

Q140290560.lead: Lahari is a 2025 Odia-language film written and directed by Amartya Bhattacharyya and produced by Jhillik Bhattacharya, featuring Choudhury Bikash Das, Choudhury Jayprakash Das and Dipanwit Dashmohapatra.

p: Amartya Bhattacharyya wrote the story and was also the cinematographer and editor. Smruti Mahala, Susant Mishra, Swastik Choudhury and Zainab Kwasi Doyer were in the cast, while Babushaan, Jhillik Bhattacharya, Hara Rath and Debasish Patra made guest appearances.
Kishalaya Ray composed the music to lyrics by Amartya Bhattacharyya, and Gourav Anand and Nabhya Jaiti were among the singers.
The film was shown at the 30th Kolkata International Film Festival in 2024 before opening in cinemas on 12 September 2025.
It is listed as the recipient of the National Film Award for best feature film in 2025.

Q140250220.lead: Shikar is a 2026 Odia-language film directed by Mrutyunjay Sahu, with Amlan Das, Elina Samantray, Supriya Nayak and Ankit Kumar in the main roles.

p: Sachikanta Jena produced the film, and Priyabrata Panda wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue. Pratap Rout was the cinematographer and Rajesh Das the editor. Tapas Sargharia, Pradyumna Lenka, Smita Mohanty, Abhinab Singh, Gyana Hota, Pushpa Panda, Soham Singh and Mitu Mithun were among the supporting cast.

Baidyanath Dash composed the music. Nirmal Nayak, Arun Mantri and Priyabrata Panda wrote lyrics, and the singers included Mantu Chhuria, Antara Chakraborty, Chiragdeep Panda, Asima Panda, Adyasha Panigrahi, Ruturaj Mohanty and Gourav Anand.
The film opened in cinemas on 12 June 2026.

Q44402641.lead: Pahili Raja is a 2010 Odia-language film directed by Tapas Sargharia, starring Siddhanta Mahapatra and Anu Choudhury.

p: Niranjan Rana produced the film from a story by Gitanjali Rana, and Rajani Ranjan wrote the screenplay and dialogue. Mihir Das, Priyanka Mahapatra, Minaketan, Debu Bose, Saroj Das, Harihara Mahapatra, Pintu Nanda, Debasish Patra and Jayiram Samal were in the supporting cast. Child actors Swaraj Barik, Niki, Simran and Khushi also appeared.

Rabinarayan Nanda composed the music to lyrics by Debdas Chhotray and Panchanan Nayak. Kumar Bapi, Gobinda Chandra, Pamela Jain, Mamun, Tapu Mishra, Udit Narayan, Manas Pritam and Sulagna were among the singers.
The film was released on 7 July 2010.

Q112230821.lead: Detective Karan Arjun is a 2022 Odia-language television film directed by Ashwini Gadanayak and produced by the actress Lipsa Mishra, starring Papu Pam Pam and Pragyan Khatua.

p: Papu Pam Pam wrote the story as well as acting in the lead, and his associate Tukuna wrote the dialogue. Ashwini Gadanayak prepared the screenplay. R. Bhagat Singh was the cinematographer and Ranjan Khatei the editor. Lipsa Mishra, Priyanka Mohanty, Priyanka Mahapatra, Kuna Tripathy, Jiban Panda and Arabinda Sadangi were among the supporting cast.
Abhijit Majumdar composed the music and Nirmal Nayak wrote the lyrics. Smruti, Sanju, Ishwari, Majumdar and Papu Pam Pam were among the singers.
The film premiered on Zee Sarthak on 15 May 2022.

Q3211302.lead: Aadi Mimansa (A Rare Solution) is an Odia and Hindi-language film written and directed by Apurba Kishore Bir. Ashok Kumar, Mohan Gokhale and Neena Gupta lead the cast.

p: Bir, previously known as a cinematographer, made his debut as a director with this film. He was responsible for the story, the screenplay and the photography, and Dilip Panda edited. The cast also featured Gloria Mahanty, Bijainee Misra, Nargis, Lalatendu Rath, Arveen Panda and Smeeti Mishra.
The score was by Bhavdeep Jaipurwale.
The film received the Nargis Dutt Award for Best Feature Film on National Integration, and Bir was also honoured for Best Cinematography.

facts: Nargis Dutt Award for Best Feature Film on National Integration

Q43379201.lead: Badmas Toka is an Odia-language film directed by Prashant Pal, starring Uday and the Bengali actress Malabika Banerjee. It was released on 15 September 2017.

p: Soubhagya Kumar Parida produced the film, the first made under its banner. Lingaraj Pati wrote the story and Rajani Ranjan the dialogue, and Ajit Babu was the cinematographer. Uday, who had earlier worked in Tamil films, made his Odia debut here. Shivam, Mihir Das, Bijay Mohanty, Minaketan, Asrumochan Mohanty, Asit Pati, Hadu, Guddu and Suman Moharana played supporting roles.
P. Kumar composed the music, and Arun Mantri and Manas Sasmal wrote the lyrics. The songs were released on 1 September 2017.

Q112323589.lead: Mana Mora Kagaja Gudi is a 2022 Odia-language film directed by Debajyoti Patra, with Rakesh Deo and Bhoomika Dash in the leading roles.

p: Sibir Kumar Parida and Bibekananda Barik produced the film. Dibyasingha Ray wrote the story and Manas Padihari the dialogue, while Debajyoti Patra wrote the screenplay. Pritiraj Satpathy, Choudhury Jayprakash Das, Devi Barik and Mamata Das were among the other actors.

Debasish Mallick (Japani) composed the music. Basantaraj Samal, Tapu Nayak and Subrat Swain wrote lyrics, and Udit Narayan, Kumar Bapi, Ruturaj Mohanty, Ananya Sritam Nanda, Jyotirmayee Nayak and Humane Sagar were among the singers.
The film was released on 4 March 2022 and was later broadcast on Zee Sarthak on 24 May 2026.

Q38148287.lead: Ajatashatru is a 2018 Odia-language film directed by Bibhuti Bhusan Mahapatra and produced by Soham Singh, who also played the male lead opposite Debjani.

p: Bibhuti Bhusan Mahapatra wrote the story and screenplay, and Nirmal Nayak wrote the dialogue. Prasanna Kumar Behera was the cinematographer. Soham Singh was a newcomer, and Swadhi Singh also began her Odia film career with this film. Manoj Mishra, Shakti Baral, Pragyan Khatua and Kali were in the supporting cast.
Mahapatra also served as music director, with lyrics by Nirmal Nayak. Abhijit Majumdar and Humane Sagar were among the singers.

Q16964551.lead: My Love Story is an Odia-language film released on 1 March 2013. Deepak Panda directed it, wrote its screenplay and dialogue, and acted in it with Katrine Kovi and Mihir Das.

p: The producers were Ahmad Shayed and Sunil Singh, and the story came from Ram Narayan Panda. Ranjan handled the camera and Sukumar Mani the editing. Other cast members included Minaketan, Sunita Garabadu, Babi Kumar, Priyanka Mahapatra and Usasi Mishra, while Riya Sen featured in an item song.
Gagan Bihari wrote the music, and the soundtrack was put out by Anhad Studio.

Q109519691.lead: Mana Mo Neigalu Re is a 2021 Odia-language film directed by Sanjay Nayak, starring Jyoti Ranjan Nayak and Bhoomika Dash.

p: Sunil Kumar Dash produced the film. Dillip Kumar Dash wrote the story, and Sanjay Nayak wrote the screenplay and dialogue. S. Ranjan was the cinematographer and Ranjan Khatei the editor. Jyoti Ranjan Nayak played Akash/Badal and Bhoomika Dash played Kajal; Kuna Tripathy, Pushpa Panda, Biju Badajena, Guddu, Biraj Dash and Pradyumna Lenka were also in the cast.

Baidyanath Dash composed the music. Arun Mantri, Tapu Nayak, Pramod Parida and Sanjay Nayak wrote lyrics, and the singers included Humane Sagar, Kuldeep Pattanaik, Gourav, Pragyan Hota, Asima Panda, Antara Chakraborty and Jyotirmayee.
The film was released on 14 October 2021, during Durga Puja.

Q55455069.lead: Stree is a 1998 Odia-language film directed by Ravi Kinagi, starring Mihir Das and Archana Joglekar.

p: Ashok Kumar Lenka produced the film. Shankar Kinagi wrote the story and Ravi Kinagi the screenplay. Niranjan Das was the cinematographer and Dilip Pani the editor. The supporting cast included Uttam Mohanty, Snigdha Mohanty, Asrumochan Mohanty, Priyanka Mahapatra, Raimohan Parida, Debu Bose, Namrata Das, Pradyumna Lenka, Suresh Bal and Ajit Das.
Amarendra Mohanty composed the music, with lyrics by Shirshananda Das Kanungo and Nizam among others. Anuradha Paudwal was one of the singers.

Q21468148.lead: Aain Kanoon is a 2011 Odia-language film directed by S. Shankar, with Tanmay Mishra and Babli in the lead roles.

p: Rabindra Panda produced the film. Bijayalaxmi Panda wrote the story, Santosh Mishra the dialogue, and S. Shankar the screenplay. Ajit Srivastava was the cinematographer and Kuna Raul the editor. Mihir Das, Kuna Tripathy, Pintu Nanda, Samaresh Routray, Nrusingha Mohanty and Priyanka Mahapatra were among the supporting cast.

Abhijit Majumdar composed the music. Bapu Goswami, Nirmal Nayak and Sujit Parija wrote the lyrics, and James, Majumdar, Ira Mohanty, Udit Narayan, Pami, Kumar Sanu, Shantanu and Babul Supriyo were among the singers.
The 121-minute film was released on 16 December 2011.

Q42931513.lead: Kehi Jane Bhala Lagere is a 2013 Odia-language film directed by K. Murali Krishna, starring Anubhav Mohanty and Barsha Priyadarshini.

p: Pradyumna Lenka, Kusharanjan Pattnaik, Kedar Rout and Buddhadev Sahu produced the film. Bijay Malla wrote the dialogue and K. Murali Krishna the screenplay. R. Bhagat Singh was the cinematographer and Chandrasekhar Mishra the editor. Kuna Tripathy, Pradyumna Lenka, Namrata Das, Sukanta Rath, Salil Mitra and Madhumita Mohanty were among the supporting cast.

Abhijit Majumdar composed the music, and Arun Mantri and Nirmal Nayak wrote the lyrics. Krishna Beura, Kunal Ganjawala, Pamela Jain, Amit Kumar, Ira Mohanty, Sonu Nigam and Baba Sehgal were among the singers.
The film was released on 17 October 2013.

Q140695958.lead: Valentine – The Memorable Day is a 2025 Odia-language film directed by Manas Sahoo, written and produced by its lead actor Sambit Kumar Sahu.

p: Sambit Kumar Sahu produced the film and wrote its story, screenplay and dialogue, besides playing the lead opposite Barsha and Manali. Chaturbhuj Das was the cinematographer and Pintu Nayak the editor. Biren Mishra, Abhi, Mita Chakraborty and Kusum Tripathy were among the rest of the cast.

Gobinda Senapati, Gagan Beura and Srinivas Biswal composed the music. The lyricists included Niranjan Panda, Rabindra Muduli and the three composers, and Pragyan Hota, Humane Sagar, Sanju Mohanty, T. Souri, Kishore and Arundhati were among the singers.
The film opened in cinemas on 14 February 2025.

Q114804734.lead: Ame Ta Middle Class is a 2022 Odia-language television film directed by Rasesh Mohanty, featuring Asrumochan Mohanty, Subhasis Sharma, Mahaprasad Kar and Bijainee Mishra.

p: Sanjeev Dwivedi and Umesh Pattnaik produced the film. Santosh Narayan Das wrote the story, and B. Chandan Kumar the screenplay and dialogue. Sudarshan Senapati was the cinematographer and Pintu Nayak the editor. Tanushree and Mahima Das were also in the cast.
Abhijit Majumdar composed the music to lyrics by Nirmal Nayak. Satyajit Pradhan, Lipsa Mahapatra, Neha Niharika Kar, Swayam Padhi and Majumdar were among the singers.
The film premiered on Tarang TV and Tarang Plus on 22 October 2022.

Q141214720.lead: Vote is a 2024 Odia-language feature film written and directed by Debasish Mahapatra, with Surya Mohanty, Chakradhar Jena, Hara Rath, Usasi Misra and Ranu Padhi in the cast.

p: Atish Kumar Rout produced the film. Ajay Mahapatra wrote the story, and Debasish Mahapatra prepared the screenplay and dialogue in addition to directing. Prasantanu Mahapatra was the cinematographer and Rabi Pattnaik the editor.

Bikash Das composed the score. The songs were written by lyricists including Mohit Chakraborty and Bapu Goswami, and were sung by Humane Sagar, Diptirekha Padhi, Sibashish Mishra, Lipsa Mahapatra, Bishnumohan Kabi and Satyajit Pradhan, among others.
The film opened in cinemas on 23 February 2024.

Q26595176.lead: Galpa Nuhen Alpa Dinara is a 2015 Odia-language film directed by Ritesh Nayak and produced by Jagannath Pradhan, starring Dipak Barik and Lipi.

p: The plot combines a love triangle with family drama and takes up the issue of suicide among farmers.
Ritesh Nayak returned to direction with this film after a long break. The story was by Chittaranjan Dhal, Arabinda Mishra is credited as writer, and Bijay Pakal edited the film.

Dipak Barik played the hero, and Lipi appeared as a heroine for the first time, opposite him. The two had already worked together in several music albums but had not shared the screen in a feature film before. Babli took on a villainous role, and Jina Samal and Rudra Panigrahi also had parts.
Prem Anand directed the music. Arun Mantri, Jayanta Das, Subrat Swain and Prabhanshu Samantaray were among the lyricists.
The film was released over the Christmas season, on 25 December 2015.

Q117286070.lead: Nari Nuhen Tu Ardhanari is a 2023 Odia-language film directed by Manas Sahu and produced by Sambit Kumar Sahu, with Roshan Nanda, Laxmipriya and Payal in the lead roles.

p: Sambit Kumar Sahu, who also appeared in the film, both produced it and wrote its story. Manas Sahu wrote the screenplay and directed, Papu Brahma wrote the dialogue, and Chaturbhuj Das handled the camera. The supporting cast included Harihara Mohapatra, Biren Mishra, Suresh Panda and Mita Chakraborty.

Srinivas Biswal was the music director. Lyrics came from Sudeep, Annapurna, Srinivas, Anum Mohanty, Sonali and Kumar Lucky, and the singers included T. Souri, Pragya, R. S. Kumar, Arpita, Jagadish, Niranjan and Krishna.
It reached cinemas on 24 March 2023.

Q109519701.lead: Maa Ra Mamata is a 2021 Odia-language film directed by Himanshu Parija and produced by Pradyumna Lenka, starring Anu Choudhury and Sritam Das.

p: Himanshu Parija wrote the screenplay as well as directing, and Chinmay Das Pattnaik wrote the dialogue. Kahnu Charan Nanda was the cinematographer and Ranjan Khatei the editor. Producer Pradyumna Lenka also acted in the film alongside Sukanta Rath, Saraswati Devi, Prabhati Sahu, Kailash Panigrahi and Mahaprasad Kar; Rishab, Trishna, Puja and Tikili appeared as child artists.
Goodly Rath composed the music to lyrics by Surya Mahapatra. Sudhisna Bindhani, Sushant Mishra, Lipsa Mahapatra, Gaurav Anand, Humane Sagar and Ananya Sritam Nanda were among the playback singers.
The film premiered on the Zee Sarthak channel on 22 August 2021.

Q112246390.lead: Jatha Rabanasya Mandodari is a 2022 Odia-language film directed by Pinu Nayak and produced by Kabir Das, starring Dipak Barik and Lipika Senapati.

p: Kalucharan Nayak wrote the story and Jitendra Baral the dialogue, while Pinu Nayak prepared the screenplay and directed. Ajit was the cinematographer and Ranjan Khatei the editor. Choudhury Jayprakash Das, Rakhee Dash, Akash Satapathy, Papi Santuka and Kuni Panda were in the supporting cast.

Abhijit Majumdar composed the music. Nirmal Nayak and Debidatta Mohanty wrote the songs, which were sung by Kuldeep Pattnaik, Amrita Nayak, Tariq Aziz, Lopamudra Dash, Smrutimayee Mahapatra and Humane Sagar, among others.
The film premiered on 1 May 2022 on Tarang TV and the Tarang Plus platform at the same time.

Q112164537.lead: Prema ATM is a 2022 Odia-language film written and directed by Sudhanshu Mohan Sahu, starring Pradeep Dutta, Divya Mohanty and Lipika Senapati.

p: Surendra Narayan Pradhan and Nabanita Mishra produced the film. Sudhanshu Mohan Sahu wrote both the story and the screenplay, and Nirmal Nayak supplied the dialogue. Dhrubananda Panda was the cinematographer and Soumya Sobhan Nayak the editor.
Pradeep Dutta played Prema, Divya Mohanty played Puja and Lipika Senapati played Aradhana, with Pradyumna Lenka, Snigdha Mohanty, Prithviraj Nayak and Bina Moharana in supporting roles.
Abhijit Majumdar scored the film, with all lyrics by Nirmal Nayak. The playback singers included Mantu Chhuria, Humane Sagar, Swayam Padhi, Tariq Aziz, Diptirekha Padhi and Amrita Nayak.
The film was released on 27 May 2022.

Q15724709.lead: Phula Chandana is a 1982 Odia-language film directed by Mohammad Mohsin, starring Uttam Mohanty and Aparajita Mohanty. It won seven Odisha State Film Awards.

p: Chandan and Phula share an affection from childhood, and his father and her mother agree that the two will marry once grown up. When Chandan's father becomes rich, he forgets the promise and fixes his son's marriage to the daughter of a wealthy man, played by Deepa Sahu. In the end, Chandan marries Phula.

Batakrushna Nayak produced the film. Ananda Shankar Das wrote the story and Mohammad Mohsin the screenplay. Rajan Kinagi and Gagarin Mishra shared the cinematography, and Rabi Shankar Patnaik edited it. Jayiram Samal played the character Daka Aja, whose catchphrase "Dekhe taku" became popular.

Saroj Patnaik composed the music to lyrics by Nizam, Sangram Keshari Mohanty and Dillip Das, with Akshaya Mohanty, Anuradha Paudwal and Alka Yagnik as playback singers. The songs include "Ei Je Banalata Pahada", "Kahana E Phula Kahana", "Nahin Mo Pade Aji Nupura" and "To Bina Lagena Bhala Kichhi".
At the 1982 Odisha State Film Awards the film won in seven categories: Best Film, Best Director, Best Actor, Best Actress, Best Music Director, Best Cinematographer and Best Story Writer.

facts: Ei Je Banalata Pahada; Kahana E Phula Kahana; To Bina Lagena Bhala Kichhi

Q114804698.lead: Lage Prema Najar is a 2022 Odia-language film directed by Dilip Panda and produced by Byomkesh Sejpada, with Amlan Das, Priya Chaudhury, Riya Dey and Ragini Sutradhar in the main roles.

p: Khageswar Sejpada wrote the story and Chinmay Das Pattnaik the dialogue, while Dilip Panda wrote the screenplay in addition to directing. Pradeep shot the film and Chandrasekhar Mishra edited it. Rakesh Deo, Babi Mishra and Papi Santuka were among the supporting actors.

Baidyanath Dash directed the music. Arun Mantri, Nirmal Nayak and Ranjan Kumar Das wrote the lyrics, and Gaurav Anand, Diptirekha Padhi, Kuldeep Pattnaik, Asima Panda, Humane Sagar, Ananya Sritam Nanda and Arpita Choudhury were among the singers.
The film was released on 8 July 2022, coinciding with Bahuda Yatra.

Q141647627.lead: Kuhudi is a 2024 Odia-language film directed by Ajay Padhi and produced by Himadri Tanaya Das, starring Anubhav Mohanty, Dipanwit Dashmohapatra, Supriya Nayak and Prakruti Mishra.

p: Manas Padhiari, Anil Barik and Amit Kumar Das wrote the screenplay together. Anil Akki was the cinematographer and Dillip Kumar Routray the editor. Anubhav Mohanty played the advocate Anshuman Pattnaik and Dipanwit Dashmohapatra played Sagar Mishra, with Kuna Tripathy, Shakti Baral and Sukumar Tudu in supporting parts.

Somesh Satapathy composed the score. J. P. Wordsmith and Sthita Pattnaik were among the lyricists, and the songs were sung by Rituraj Mohanty, Humane Sagar, Ananya Sritam Nanda and Gaurav Anand, among others.
Kuhudi opened in cinemas on 14 June 2024, during the Raja festival. It runs 153 minutes.

Q28934580.lead: Golamgiri is a 1987 Odia-language film written and directed by Prashanta Nanda, who also acted in it alongside Uttam Mohanty, Bijay Mohanty, Prithviraj Nayak, Ajit Das and Mahasweta Ray.

p: Pradyumna Lenka and Akshaya Mishra produced the film. Prashanta Nanda wrote the story and screenplay and shared the dialogue with Ratikanta Mishra. Uday Barman was the cinematographer and Bhai Telang the editor. The cast also included Dukhiram Swain, Jayiram Samal, Biraj Dash, Prasanna Mishra and Tushar Panigrahi.

Shantanu Mahapatra was the music director, with songs written by Debdas Chhotray and Prashanta Nanda among others. The singers included Subash Das, Lila Ghosh, Prafulla Kar, Radharani Mishra, Debashis Mahapatra, Nibedita, Anuradha Paudwal and Raghunath Rout.

Q117221489.lead: Bapa Superman is a 2023 Odia-language film directed by Sudhanshu Mohan Sahu and produced by Prakash Ranjan Jena, starring Siddhanta Mahapatra and Supriya Nayak.

p: Priyabrata Panda wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue. Dhrubananda Panda handled the cinematography and Rajesh Dash the editing.

Siddhanta Mahapatra played Bharat Jena and Supriya Nayak played Parimita Dash. Other roles went to Subhransu Nayak as Chandrakanta Sabat, Sofia Alam as Bina, Ashwini Brahma as ACP Sagar, Prakash Jena as a secretary and Prashant Patra as Murali, with Shubham, Trisha, Rishik and Tej as child artists.
Soumitri Palai composed the music and Guru Satapathy wrote the lyrics. Sushil Kumar, Papu, Gugul and Trisha were among the singers.
The film was released in cinemas on 3 March 2023.

Q110270897.lead: Pal Pal Tate Chahen is a 2021 Odia-language film directed by Sudhakar Vasant and produced by actor Dipak Barik, who also stars in it with Prachi Chaudhary and Mansi Pal.

p: Tanuja Sahu wrote the story and Rajani Ranjan the dialogue. Ajit Kishore Das was the cinematographer and Ranjan Khatei the editor. Pintu Nanda, Pradyumna Lenka, Saroj Das, Nonsense Mani and Bikash Somu appeared in supporting roles.

Abhijit Majumdar composed the music to lyrics by Nirmal Nayak. Humane Sagar, Diptirekha Padhi, Dipak, Sonali Nanda, Smrutimayee Mahapatra, Swayam Padhi, Sohini Mishra, Manas Pritam and Antara Chakraborty were among the singers.
The film premiered on Tarang TV and Tarang Plus on 26 December 2021.

Q19810635.lead: Dhare Alua is a 1984 Odia-language parallel film directed by Saghir Ahmed from a story by Manorama Das, with Prithviraj Mishra, Sharmistha Mathews and Dipen Ghosh in the cast.

p: After thugs murder the wife of Hemanta, a journalist, his children Bulu and Ranu are left on their own and suffer ill treatment in a neighbour's house. They find a home with Hemanta's friend Lalit, whose wife Sumitra and father Rudrababu treat them with love, and they refuse to go back when Hemanta comes to fetch them. Bulu drowns in a pond while running to hide from his father, and Hemanta, blaming Lalit's family, sets out to kill Lalit. He later sees his mistake, asks Lalit's forgiveness and surrenders to the police, taking on himself the case and charges that Lalit faced.

The film was produced by the Odisha Film Development Corporation. Saghir Ahmed wrote the screenplay, Harihar Panda composed the music, Bidhushree Bindhani shot the film and Bidhu Raul edited it. Indrani Mishra was the playback singer.
Dhare Alua was screened in the Indian Panorama, a showing that brought international attention to Odia cinema.

Q44251784.lead: Aalo Mora Kandhei is a 2010 Odia-language film directed by Himanshu Parija and produced by Manas Sahu, starring Akash Dasnayak, Priya Chaudhury and Archita Sahu.

p: Chanchala Sahu wrote the story and Chinmay Das Pattnaik the dialogue; Himanshu Parija wrote the screenplay and directed. Dhrubananda Panda was the cinematographer and Pratik Mishra the editor. Siddhanta Mahapatra played the villain, and Mihir Das, Saroj Das, Anita Das, Harihara Mohapatra and Bina Moharana were also in the cast.

Prem Anand composed the music, and the songs were written by Basantaraj Samal and Arun Mantri. Kumar Bapi, Sricharan Mohanty, Khushboo Jain, Pamela Jain, Udit Narayan, Dipti Panda, Sailabhama Mahapatra and Subhadra were among the singers.
The film was released on 11 June 2010.

Q29033655.lead: To Pain Nebi Mu Sahe Janama is a 2007 Odia-language film directed by Sanjay Nayak, starring Arindam Roy and Archita Sahu.

p: Ajit Mishra and Soumya Ranjan Patnaik produced the film, and Patnaik also wrote the story and appeared in the cast. Sanjay Nayak wrote the screenplay, and Rabi Shankar Patnaik was the editor. The supporting cast included Jina Samal, Bijay Mohanty, Aparajita Mohanty, Siddhanta Mahapatra, Raimohan Parida, Kuna Tripathy and Jayiram Samal.
Malay Mishra was the music director. Basantaraj Samal, Arun Mantri and Guru Satapathy wrote the songs, which were sung by Sricharan Mohanty, Bibhu Kishore, Ira Mohanty and Swayansh, among others.

Q46066903.lead: Subha Vivaha is a 2010 Odia-language film written and directed by Jyotiprakash Das, starring Pupinder Singh, Barsha Priyadarshini and Akash Dasnayak.

p: Pupinder Singh, who also played one of the leads, produced the film together with Sunita Laxmi and Manisha. Jyotiprakash Das wrote the story and shared the screenplay with Prakash Baral. Nagendra Kumar was the cinematographer and Susmit Mandal the editor. Mihir Das, Aparajita Mohanty, Bijay Mohanty, Tandra Ray, Jiban Panda and Salil Mitra were in the supporting cast.

Abhijit Majumdar composed the music, with lyrics by Basantaraj Samal, Nirmal Nayak and Nizam among others. The playback singers included Abhijeet, Gautam Ganguly, Pamela Jain, Sanghamitra Jena, Tapu Mishra, Jolly Mukherjee, Udit Narayan, Vinod Rathod and Sadhana Sargam.
The film was released on 28 February 2010.

Q66425465.lead: Baishali is a 2019 Odia-language film directed by Ashutosh Das and produced by Sudhir Kumar, with Preet, Abhishek Rath and Suman Priya in the lead roles.

p: Sudhir Kumar wrote the story as well as producing, and Ashutosh Das wrote the screenplay and directed. S. Ranjan was the cinematographer and Sukumar Mani the editor. Bijay Mohanty, Aparajita Mohanty, Prithviraj Nayak, Harihara Mohapatra, Manisha Mishra and Asit Pati were among the supporting cast.

Abhijit Majumdar was the music director, and Arun Mantri and Nirmal Nayak wrote the lyrics. Mantu Chhuria, Udit Narayan, Pamela Jain, Arabinda Dutta, Humane Sagar, Diptirekha Padhi and Amrita were among the singers.
Baishali had its premiere at New Cineplex in Bhawanipatna and opened on 19 July 2019 in 49 other cinemas.

Q117286069.lead: Mana Museum is a 2023 Odia-language film directed by Dhrubananda Panda and produced by Sangeeta Mohanty, starring Nihar Nayak and Upasana Bhadra Mohanty.

p: Rashmirekha Panda wrote the story, and Bharadwaj Panda wrote the screenplay and dialogue. The cinematography was by Litu and Jitu, and Sukumar Mani edited the film. Sayal Mukherjee, Suryamayee Mohapatra, Prashant Patra and Animesh Ghosh had supporting roles. It was made under the Sangeet Motion Pictures banner and distributed by INOX.

Sarat Nayak composed the film's seven songs, all written by Bijay Malla. Sashank Sekhar, Antara Chakraborty, Sohini, Bishnumohan Kabi and Sarat Nayak himself sang them. The soundtrack came out on 11 March 2023.
The film opened in cinemas on 24 March 2023.

Q139900617.lead: Parichaya is a 2026 Odia-language film directed by actor Satyaki Misra, who also co-produced and co-wrote it and stars alongside Smita Mohanty, Soma Bhowmick and Ayushman.

p: Satyaki Misra produced the film with Suchismita Mishra and wrote the screenplay with Satarupa Mishra; Hrudananda wrote the dialogue. Bibhu Prasad Mishra handled the cinematography. Janmesh, Agnesh, Bibhas Paramaguru, Shreya Swain, Arpita Sahu and Kusum Tripathy were among the other actors.
Sarat Nayak composed the music and Arun Mantri wrote the songs. Satyajit Pradhan, Arpita Choudhury, Sashank Sekhar and Sarat Nayak were among the singers.
The film was released in cinemas on 22 May 2026.

Q56677128.lead: Abhilasha is a 1984 Odia-language film produced and directed by Sadhu Meher, starring Uttam Mohanty as a doctor working in a village.

p: The film looks at rural India, where many people die young for want of medical care. Its story takes in the everyday problems of village life, the scheming of the local sarpanch, the unquestioning faith simple villagers place in the temple priest, and caste divisions. Dr Chinmay Chhotray, played by Uttam Mohanty, confronts these obstacles.

Ramesh Mohanty and Purna Mohanty wrote the dialogue. Suresh Patel was the cinematographer and Rabi Pattnaik the editor. Aparajita Mohanty, Sujata Anand, Jaya B, Byomkesh Tripathy, Niranjan Satapathy, Ajit Das and Deepa Sahu were in the cast, and Sadhu Meher also acted.
Saroj Patnaik composed the music. Dilip Das, Ramesh Mohanty, Sangram Keshari Mohanty and Saroj Patnaik wrote songs, and Bhikari Bal, Hariharan, Hemlata and Arati Mukherjee were among the singers.

Q57514872.lead: Sathi Tu Pheria is a 2018 Odia-language film directed by Sudhakar Vasant and produced by Bini Samal, starring Jyoti Ranjan Nayak and Anubha Sourya.

p: Chinmay Das Pattnaik wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue. Mahasweta Ray, Sritam Das, Subhasis Sharma, Anisha Sharma, Pinky Pradhan, Praygan Khatua and Rajib Mohanty appeared in supporting roles.
Prem Anand was the music director, with lyrics by Basantaraj Samal and Subrat Swain among others. Sabisesh, Diptirekha Padhi, Ashutosh, Sashank Sekhar and Antara Chakraborty sang the songs.
The film came out on 23 November 2018, the day of Panchaka Purnima. Another film featuring Jyoti Ranjan Nayak, Pyar Alaga Prakar, was released on the same day.

Q15723721.lead: Idiot: I Do Ishq Only Tumse, usually shortened to Idiot, is a 2012 Odia-language film written and directed by Ashok Pati, starring Babushaan Mohanty and Riya Dey.

p: Sunil Kumar Panda produced the film. Ashok Pati wrote the story and the screenplay, the latter together with Ranjit Pattnaik, who also wrote the dialogue. Sitansu Mohapatra was the cinematographer and Sukumar Mani the editor. Green India Entertainment was the production banner.

Babushaan played Sanjay and Riya Dey played Ichha. Mihir Das appeared as Guru Bhai, Debashis Patra as Pratik, Praygan Khatua as Silsila, Jayiram Samal as Chaturbhuj, Minaketan Das as Gobardhan, Pritiraj Satpathy as Bishnu and Priyanka Mahapatra as Lakshmi.
Goodly Rath composed the music.
The film was released on 12 June 2012 with a running time of 166 minutes.

facts: Idiot: I Do Ishq Only Tumse

Q15724060.lead: Chakabhaunri is a 1986 Odia-language film written and directed by Mohammad Mohsin, starring Uttam Mohanty and Aparajita Mohanty.

p: Kalpana, the daughter of a wealthy, high-status man played by Debu Bose, and Ramu, son of a servant in the household, have loved each other since childhood. Ramu stays behind to farm in the village while Kalpana goes to the city to study, and they fall in love again as young adults. Two village brothers, Ganga and Jamuna, inform her father, who arranges her marriage to another young man against her wishes; in the end the lovers are united.

Akshaya Mishra produced the film, with a budget of ₹35.6 lakh. Mohammad Mohsin wrote the story and screenplay, and Subodh Pattnaik is credited as writer. Dillip Ray shot the film and A. Sanjib edited it. Bijay Mohanty played Ganga, Hemanta Das played Ramu's father and Sulu Mohanty played the prospective groom; Jayiram Samal, Anita Das and Dukhiram Swain were also in the cast.

Akshaya Mohanty and Basudev Rath composed the music to lyrics by Debdas Chhotray and Sirsananda Das Kanungo. Akshaya Mohanty, Mohammad Ajit and Anuradha Paudwal sang the songs, which include "Jharana Jharana Chapala Jharana" and "Golapi Othe Dautu Jebe Golapa Pari Hasi".
The film was released on 27 June 1986.

facts: Jharana Jharana Chapala Jharana; Golapi Othe Dautu Jebe Golapa Pari Hasi; Smruti Eka Rupa Janha

Q4739008.lead: Amada Bata (The Untrodden Road) is a 1964 Odia-language film directed by Amar Ganguly, adapted from Basanta Kumari Patnaik's 1930 novel of the same name. Jharana Das played the central character, Maya.

p: The story centres on Maya and follows her life both before and after her marriage.

Babulal Doshi produced the film for the Chhayabani concern. Gopal Chhotray wrote the screenplay from the novel, and Deoji Bhai was the cinematographer. Besides Jharana Das, the cast included Sarat Pujari, Umakant Mishra, Akshaya Mohanty, Laxmipriya Mahapatra, Krishnapriya Mahapatra, Brundaban and Gita Das, who played Kaberi.
Balakrushna Dash composed the music. The song "Jibana Jamuna Re" was written by Narayan Prasad Singh and sung by Nirmala Mishra.
The film was released in 1964 and runs 144 minutes.

facts: Amada Bata (1930), novel by Basanta Kumari Patnaik

Q140964265.lead: Ganda Bhairav is a 2026 Odia-language film directed by Sudhanshu Mohan Sahu and produced by Ramesh Barik, starring Debasish Patra and Sivani Sangita.

p: Sankar Tripathy wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue. Rudrakanta Singh, Subrat Khatoi and B. Satish shared the cinematography, and Rajesh Das edited the film. Ananya Mishra, Krishna Kar, Prithviraj Nayak, Choudhury Bikash Das and Soma Bhowmick were among the supporting cast.

Gaurav Anand composed the music, with lyrics by Nirmal Nayak, Bapu Goswami and J. P. Wordsmith among others. Humane Sagar, Satyajit Pradhan, Gaurav Anand, Ananya Sritam Nanda, Lipsa Mahapatra and Rupak Parida sang the songs.
The film opened in cinemas on 16 July 2026. It runs 148 minutes.

Q42751176.lead: Bajrangi is a 2017 Odia-language film directed by Bini Pattnaik and produced by Sachikanta Jena, starring Amlan Das and Anubha Sourya.

p: Sachikanta Jena wrote the story, and Rajani Ranjan wrote the screenplay and dialogue. Siddhanta Mahapatra, Naina Das, Asit Pati, Pintu Nanda, Praygan Khatua and Pralipta were in the supporting cast, and Ananya Mishra danced in an item number.
Prem Anand composed the music, and Subrat Swain and Basantaraj Samal wrote the lyrics. Ananya Sritam Nanda, Humane Sagar and Diptirekha Padhi were among the singers.
The film was released on 3 November 2017.
At the 12th Film and Television Award Show Time in 2018, Siddhanta Mahapatra was named Best Supporting Actor and Asit Pati Best Villain for their roles in the film.

Q112422864.lead: Gupchup is a 2022 Odia-language film directed by Prithviraj Pattnaik, starring Amlan Das and Sanmira Nagesh.

p: Aniket Das and Sanghamitra Mohanty produced the film under the Black and White Motion Pictures banner. Manas Padihari wrote the story, and Prithviraj Pattnaik wrote the screenplay besides directing. Akshaya Kumar Nayak was the cinematographer and Manas Kumar Sahu the editor. Sailendra Samantray, Ananya Mishra, Aroshikha Mishra, Himangi Dutta, Papu Pam Pam and Mihir Das had supporting roles.

The music was by the duo Nabs and Saroj. Arun Mantri, Tapu Nayak, Debdas Chhotray and Aptakam Rath were among the lyricists, and Swayam Padhi, Amrita Nayak, Sashank Sekhar, Satyajit Pradhan and Asima Panda sang the songs.
The film was released on 10 June 2022.

Q53734290.lead: Mo Bhai Jaga is a 1995 Odia-language film directed by P. V. Sarathi, with Bijay Mohanty, Tandra Ray, Aparajita Mohanty and Jayiram Samal in the cast.

p: Subash Nanda, Rajanikanta and Anusuya Samal produced the film. Rajani Ranjan wrote the dialogue and co-wrote the story with Ramesh Samantaray. Samba Siva Rao and Ashok Swain handled the cinematography, and Jitendra Pani edited the film. Bapu Acharya, Sujata Anand, Biraj Dash, Aman Dhawan, Puja Mishra and Nihar Samal were among the other actors.

Narayan Rath was the music director. Rajani Ranjan, Ramesh Samantaray and Kailash Tripathy wrote the songs, and Subash Das, Lata Ghosh, Dipti, Anita Goswami, Lopita Mishra, Dibakar Mohanty and Tansen Singh sang them.
The film was released on 3 March 1995.

Q57552057.lead: Tu Mo Suna Chadhei is a 2019 Odia-language film directed by Dilip Panda, starring Jyoti Ranjan Nayak and Elsa Ghosh.

p: Nitin Panda, Bhupesh Panda, Sitanshu Mohanty and S. Dilip produced the film. Dilip Panda wrote the screenplay and shared the story credit with Lina Panda and Sitanshu Mohanty, while Rajani Ranjan wrote the dialogue. The supporting cast included Raimohan Parida, Daitari Panda, Babu Pradhan, Bhupati Tripathy, Chintamani Biswal, Krishna Kar, Jaya Swami, Jiban Panda, Chandini Jena and Mita Chakraborty.

Baidyanath Dash composed the music to lyrics by Nirmal Nayak, Arun Mantri and Bapu Goswami. Satyajit Pradhan, Asima Panda, Humane Sagar, Ananya Sritam Nanda, Kaushik and Arpita were among the singers.
The film was released on 25 January 2019.

Q110646847.lead: Hau Hau Hei Gala Re is a 2022 Odia-language film directed by Ramesh Rout, starring Raj Rajesh Panda and Riya Dey. It was released directly on an OTT platform.

p: Subash Das and Nilamani Sahu produced the film. Abhijit Sindhe wrote the story and screenplay, and Deepak Jena the dialogue. Kahnu Nanda was the cinematographer and Rajesh Dash the editor.
Raj Rajesh Panda played Ajay and Riya Dey played Priya. Pintu Nanda, Sasmita Pradhan, Akshay Bastia, Shweta Acharya, Rani Panda and producer Nilamani Sahu were among the supporting cast.
Bimugdha Das was the music director. Santosh Panigrahi and Soumya Ranjan Bal were among the lyricists, and Humane Sagar, Antara Chakraborty and Swayam Padhi sang the songs.
The film premiered on the Kanchalanka platform on 21 January 2022.

Q56490016.lead: Love Promise is a 2018 Odia-language film directed by Santosh Biswal and produced and written by Jaya Biswas, who also stars in it opposite Rakesh Deo.

p: Jaya Biswas wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue, and she and Rakesh Deo both choreographed the dances. Before this film she had worked as a dance choreographer on several Odia films, acted in Chup Kie Asuchi, and served as a judge on the Sarthak TV dance programme Dance Odisha Dance alongside Harihar Das and Saswat Joshi.
Biswabhusan Mahapatra was the cinematographer and Ranjan Khatei the editor. Manoj Mishra and Usasi Misra were in the supporting cast. Tarang Cine Production distributed the film.

Prem Anand composed the music to lyrics by Basantaraj Samal and Subrat Swain. Humane Sagar, Ananya Sritam Nanda, Ashutosh, Sabisesh, Diptirekha Padhi, Lopamudra and Biswajit Mahapatra were among the singers.
The film was released on 24 May 2018.

Q66459341.lead: Ranga Barasiba Tupuru Tupuru is a 2019 Odia-language film written and directed by Jitendra Mahapatra, starring Tapas Behera and Sushree Rath.

p: Sushant Kumar Behera and B. L. N. Subudhi produced the film. Jitendra Mahapatra wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue. Bubei and Bobby Islam handled the cinematography. Hara Rath, Mihir Das, Aparajita Mohanty, Asrumochan Mohanty, Biju Badajena and Saroj Das were in the supporting cast.

Amarendra Mohanty was the music director, with lyrics by Srikant Gautam and Sirsananda Das Kanungo. Satyajit Pradhan, Shubham, Sashank Sekhar, Diptirekha Padhi, Lalita Bhanja, Antara Chakraborty and Chameli Mahapatra were among the singers.
The film was released on 2 August 2019.

Q109588363.lead: Bijayinee is a 2021 Odia-language film directed by Sudhakar Vasant, with actress Barsha Priyadarshini in the title role of Bijayinee Roy Choudhury.

p: Bijay Kandoi and Sangeeta Kandoi produced the film. Barsha Priyadarshini wrote the story as well as playing the lead, and Bijay Malla is credited with the dialogue. Bhagat Singh was the cinematographer and Chandrasekhar Mishra the editor. Debasish Patra, Bikram Mohanty, Papi Santuka, Praygan Khatua, Trupti Sinha and Saroj Das were in the supporting cast.

Prem Anand composed the music. Bijay Malla, Nirmal Nayak, Arun Mantri and Sirsananda Das Kanungo wrote the songs, which were sung by Ananya Sritam Nanda, Sashank Sekhar, Sabisesh Mishra and Diptirekha Padhi.
The film was released on 13 November 2021.

Q112269006.lead: Sunayana is a 2022 Odia-language television film directed by Mrutyunjaya Sahoo and produced by Pabitra Nayak, starring Pradeep Kumar Sahoo and Jagruti Rath.

p: S. K. Muralidharan wrote the story and screenplay, and B. Chandan Kumar the dialogue. R. Bhagat Singh was the cinematographer and Rajesh Dash the editor. Tribhuban Panda, Bhupati Tripathy, Saroj Das, Rajesh Panda, Manini Nanda and Sushil Mishra were in the supporting cast, with Nandu as a child artist.

Abhijit Majumdar composed the music, with lyrics by Nirmal Nayak and Debidatta Mohanty among others. Swayam Padhi, Jyotirmayee Nayak, Gaurav Anand, Biswajit Mahapatra and Ananya Sritam Nanda were among the singers.
The film premiered on Tarang TV and Tarang Plus on 3 April 2022.

Q56479061.lead: Ishq Punithare is a 2018 Odia-language film directed by Jyoti Das, starring Arindam Roy and Elina Samantray.

p: The film was produced by Tarang Cine Production and Ratna Banners. Debidatta Mohanty and Santosh Narayan Das wrote the dialogue, and R. Bhagat Singh was the cinematographer.

Arindam Roy played Raja and Lipika Senapati played Ruby. Harihara Mohapatra, Pushpa Panda, Babi Mishra, Ajit Das, Samaresh Routray, Rabi Mishra and Tribhuban Panda were also in the cast, along with child artists Animesh and Ayusha.

Prem Anand composed the music to lyrics by Basantaraj Samal and Subrat Swain. Sabisesh, Lopamudra, Ashutosh, Humane Sagar and Diptirekha Padhi were among the singers. The song "Dasara Maja" did much to make the film popular.
The film was released on 13 September 2018, during the Ganesh Puja festival.

Q114804729.lead: Trushna is a 2022 Odia-language film written, directed and edited by Suresh Pattnaik and produced by Nabin Bhandari.

p: Suresh Pattnaik wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue and also edited the film, while Prafulla Kumar Sahu was the cinematographer. The cast included Sailendra Samantray, Samaresh Routray, Lipsa Mishra, Abhishek Giri, Suryamayee Mohapatra, Pradyumna Lenka, Dhir Mallick, Jiban Panda and Rushi Pattnaik.
Abhijit Majumdar composed the music, with lyrics by Nirmal Nayak and Kumarshree Routray among others. Kuldeep Pattnaik, Iswari Behera, Swayam Padhi, Rupak Kumar and Gaurav Anand sang the songs.
The film was released on 14 October 2022.

Q45701552.lead: Diwana is a 2010 Odia-language film directed by Ashok Pati and produced by Bijay Kandoi, starring Anubhav Mohanty and Barsha Priyadarshini.

p: Bijay Kandoi wrote the story as well as producing. Ranjit Pattnaik wrote the dialogue and co-wrote the screenplay with Ashok Pati. Sitansu Mohapatra was the cinematographer and Sukumar Mani the editor. Papu Pam Pam, Mihir Das, Samaresh Routray, Minaketan Das, Shakti Baral, Choudhury Jayprakash Das, Bijay Mohanty and Pintu Nanda were among the supporting cast.
Malay Mishra was the music director. Nirmal Nayak, Arun Mantri and Basantaraj Samal wrote lyrics, and the singers included Krishna, Ira Mohanty, Udit Narayan, Vinod Rathod and Babul Supriyo.
The film was released on 14 October 2010.

Q50825280.lead: Krishna Govinda is a 2014 Odia-language film directed by T. Ganesh, starring Suraj Tripathy and Kajal Satapathy, with Subhasis Sharma as Lord Krishna.

p: Lord Krishna comes down to earth to help one of his devotees. He explains the ways of the world to the man and shows him how to live his life.

Satyakanta Sahu produced the film. Sushama Sahu wrote the story, Dr Nirmal Nayak the dialogue, and T. Ganesh the screenplay. Illu Banerjee, Suresh Bal, Jayiram Samal, Arpan Mohanty, Debu Bose and Nupur Ghosh were in the supporting cast.
S. Chandrakant composed the music, and Nirmal Nayak and Arun Mantri wrote the songs.
The film was released on 22 August 2014.

Q43799271.lead: Only Pyar is a 2018 Odia-language film directed by Tapas Sargharia and produced by Sunil Kumar Das, starring Babushaan Mohanty, Supriya Nayak and Anisha Sharma.

p: Bharadwaj Panda wrote the story and dialogue. Rabindra Behera was the cinematographer and Biren Jyoti Mohanty the editor. Mihir Das, Aparajita Mohanty, Praygan Khatua, Choudhury Bikash Das and Choudhury Jayprakash Das had supporting roles.
Abhijit Majumdar composed the music to lyrics by Nirmal Nayak. Humane Sagar, Diptirekha Padhi, Tariq Aziz, Satyajit and Ira Mohanty were among the singers, and Babushaan also sang.
Released on 12 January 2018, it was the first Odia film of that year, but it did not do well at the box office. Happy Lucky came out the following week.

Q109519707.lead: Kokoli: Fish Out of Water is a 2021 Odia-language film written and directed by Snehasis Das and produced by Kaushik Das, with Gargi Mohanty in the lead. It was released on an OTT platform.

p: Snehasis Das wrote both the story and the screenplay. Srikant Pattnaik was the cinematographer and Prasant Kumar Naik the editor. Linkan Pattnaik, Dharitri Khandual, Bhaswati Basu, Bidyutprava Pattnaik, Sonali Ojha and Dipanwit Dashmohapatra were among the supporting cast.
Nalinikanta Pattnaik composed the music, and Kumudini Chhotray wrote the songs.
The film premiered on the Aao NXT platform on 12 June 2021. It runs about 123 minutes.

Q56677582.lead: Samaya Chakare Sansara Ratha is a 2002 Odia-language film directed by Himanshu Parija and produced by Jitendra Mahapatra, with Siddhanta Mahapatra, Mama Mishra, Mihir Das, Aparajita Mohanty and Bijay Mohanty in the cast.

p: Bijay Mishra wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue. Niranjan Das was the cinematographer and Deban Mishra the editor. The large supporting cast included Snigdha Mohanty, Pradyumna Lenka, Suresh Bal, Priyanka Mahapatra, Satyaki Misra, Kuna Tripathy, Harihara Mohapatra, Sukanta Rath, Uttam Mohanty and Jayiram Samal.
Biju Swain composed the music and Nizam wrote the lyrics. Subash Das, Gita Dash, Ira Mohanty, Debashis Mahapatra, Arabinda Muduli and Yonesh were among the singers.
The film was released on 11 June 2002.

Q119889688.lead: Dho Re Babu Dho is a 2023 Odia-language film directed by Himanshu Parija, starring Harihara Mohapatra, who also wrote it, and Divya Mohanty.

p: Sitaram Agarwal and Namita Agarwal produced the film. Actor Harihara Mohapatra wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue. Shubham was the cinematographer and Rajesh Dash the editor. Satyaki Misra, Pinky Pradhan, Babi Mishra and Braja Singh were in the supporting cast. The film was first titled Dho Re Baia Dho before the name was changed.

Abhijit Majumdar composed the five songs, all written by Nirmal Nayak. Diptirekha Padhi, Humane Sagar and Saini sang them, as did Abhijit Majumdar and the two leads, Harihara Mohapatra and Divya Mohanty.
The film was released on 14 April 2023, the day of Pana Sankranti.

Q140521926.lead: Sautuni No. 1 is a 2025 Odia-language film directed by Mahesh Hazra, starring Neel Panda and Jasmine Rath. It premiered on television and an OTT platform rather than in cinemas.

p: Subhendra Malla and Pradyumna Lenka produced the film, and both also acted in it. Sanjay Mahakul wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue. Sarbeswar Dash was the cinematographer and Pintu Nayak the editor. The cast also included Loverin Khanam, Mili Mohanty, Hadu, Sheela Tripathy, Udit Guru, Guddu, Tapas Sargharia and Saraswati Devi.
Biraja Prasad composed the music, with lyrics by Nirmal Nayak and Deepak Jena among others. Antara Chakraborty, Satyajit Pradhan, S. Jitu and Soujanya Rath were among the singers.
The film premiered on Tarang TV and Tarang Plus on 4 May 2025.

Q33605409.lead: Gote Shua Gote Shari is a 2016 Odia-language film directed by Mrutyunjaya Sahoo and produced by Niranjan Rana, starring Anubhav Mohanty and Barsha Priyadarshini.

p: The film was the sixth production of the Maa Tarini Film Production banner. Gitanjali Rana wrote the story, Nirmal Nayak the dialogue and Mrutyunjaya Sahoo the screenplay. Abhiram Mishra was the cinematographer and Chandrasekhar Mishra the editor. Minaketan Das, Salil Mitra and Praygan Khatua were in the supporting cast.

Prem Anand and Rabinarayan Nanda jointly directed the music. Arun Mantri, Bijay Malla and Subrat Swain wrote the songs, and Udit Narayan, Ira Mohanty, Humane Sagar and Kumar Bapi were among the singers.
The film was released on 12 February 2016.

Q55455040.lead: To Binu Anya Gati Nahin is a 1991 Odia-language film directed by Mohammad Mohsin and produced by Subash Rath, with Uttam Mohanty, Sriram Panda, Bijay Mohanty and Mahasweta Ray in the cast.

p: Actor Bijay Mohanty wrote the story and also appeared in the film. Subodh Pattnaik wrote the dialogue, and Mohammad Mohsin the screenplay. Dillip Ray was the cinematographer and Abhishek the editor. Dukhiram Swain, Geeta Rao, Sujata Anand, Debu Bose, Braja Singh and Debu Brahma were among the supporting cast.
Akshaya Mohanty composed the music, and he and Debdas Chhotray were among the lyricists. Lopita Mishra, Gita Pattnaik and Subhasish were among the singers.
The film was released on 5 September 1991 and runs 173 minutes.

Q122205828.lead: Kartabya is a 2023 Odia-language film directed by Manas Ranjan Patra, with Satyajit Purohit, Rupesh, Tanushree and Priyadarshini in the main roles.

p: Shankar Patra produced the film under the Shree Jagannath Movies and Mukti Express banners. Surya Narayan Behera wrote both the story and the dialogue and also appeared in the cast. Patra edited the film as well as directing it, and the cinematography was by Nilu and Prakash. The supporting cast included Bijay Mohanty, Asrumochan Mohanty, Ratan Meher and Jiban Panda.

P. Kumar was the music director. Arun Mantri, Manas Sasmal and Surya Narayan Behera wrote the songs, which were sung by Mohammed Aziz, Humane Sagar, Madhab, Kumar Biju, Sanju Mohanty, Kumar Bapi and Gina, among others.
The film opened in cinemas on 1 September 2023.

Q139498055.lead: Murabi is a 2026 Odia-language film directed by Sisir Kumar Sahu and Peenakee Singh, starring Kuna Tripathy and Choudhury Jayprakash Das.

p: Bishal Mourya and Debi Prasad Lenka produced the film and wrote its story; Lenka also edited it. P. Santosh wrote the screenplay and dialogue. Bijayini Mishra, Ankita Mohanty, Udit Guru, B. M. Baisali, Prasanjit Mahapatra, Kalpana Rout, Amir Das, Susmita Pradhan, Lotan Khatai, Pragati Guru and Rohan Mahapatra were among the supporting cast.

The music is credited to Agnimitra Behera in one account and to Yudhisthir Behera in another; the former account lists Yudhisthir Behera as cinematographer. P. Santosh wrote the lyrics, and the singers included Gaurav Anand, Satyajit Pradhan, Papu Pam Pam and Anurag Das.
The film was released on 14 April 2026.

Q50824821.lead: Priya Mo Priya is a 2005 Odia-language film directed by Gudia Mohapatra, starring Anubhav Mohanty and Namrata Thapa.

p: Swarnalata Das produced the film. The story was by Purna Chandra Das and the dialogue by Pradeep Nanda, while Mohapatra shared screenplay credit with Swarup Nayak. Niranjan Das was the cinematographer and B. Satyanarayan the editor. Bijay Mohanty, Raimohan Parida, Lisa Mohanty, Jayiram Samal, Harihara Mahapatra, Anita Das, Debu Bose and Rabi Mishra played supporting roles.

Swarup Nayak composed the music. The lyricists included Debdas Chhotray, Bijay Malla, Nayak himself and Suresh Parida, and the songs were sung by Kumar Bapi, Soma Bhattacharya, Tapu Mishra, Rupali and T. Souri, among others.

Q114804716.lead: Kiss Miss is a 2022 Odia-language film written and directed by Sushant Mani, starring Swaraj Barik and Shivani Sangita.

p: The actress Jhillik Bhattacharya produced the film. Mani wrote the story and screenplay, and Sanjeev Rath wrote the dialogue. Kuhu Malla handled the cinematography and Sukumar Mani the editing. Prithviraj Nayak, Neetu Singh, Somen Pujari, Dharitri Khandual, Mamuni Nanda, Barsha and Lincoln Pattnaik also appeared.

Abhijit Majumdar composed the music to lyrics by Nirmal Nayak. The singers included Swayam Padhi, Antara Chakraborty, Sasank Sekhar, Amrita Nayak, Satyajit Pradhan, Jagruti Mishra, Tariq Aziz and Diptirekha Padhi.
The film reached cinemas on 31 August 2022, during the Ganesh Puja festival.

Q50825285.lead: Rudra is a 2013 Odia-language film directed by Jitu Rout, with Ananta and Srushti in the lead roles.

p: Rudra Narayan Mishra and Nimai Charan Biswal produced the film, and Mishra also wrote the story. Rout prepared the screenplay, and Hrudananda Sahu wrote the dialogue. Satyabrata Maharana was the cinematographer and Pitambar Singh the editor. Babu Pradhan, Salil Mitra and Braja Singh were among the supporting cast.
Abhijit Majumdar composed the score, with lyrics by Nirmal Nayak and Nizam. Majumdar also sang, alongside Kumar Lulu, Saini Mishra, Amrita, Bishnumohan Kabi and Sasmita.
The film was released on 17 May 2013.

Q55994957.lead: To Akhi Mo Aaena is a 1999 Odia-language film written and directed by Sangram Biswal, featuring Siddhanta Mahapatra, Jyoti Mishra, Mama Mishra and Bijay Mohanty.

p: Arun Sahu produced the film, and Biswal wrote its story and screenplay. Ranjan was the cinematographer. The cast also included Pintu Nanda, Saroj Das, Harihara Mahapatra, Kailash Maharana, Uttam Mohanty, Adikanta Rout and Deepa Sahu.

Deepak Kumar was the music director. Debdas Chhotray and Sirshananda Das Kanungo were among the lyricists, and the playback singers included Mohammed Aziz, Sunidhi Chauhan, Pamela Jain, Sonu Nigam and Shiba.

Q44254493.lead: Dil Tate Deichi is an Odia-language film written and directed by Sanjay Nayak, starring Sabyasachi Mishra and Priya Choudhury, released on 11 June 2010.

p: Uttam Chand Jain produced the film. Nayak wrote the story and screenplay and also edited the film, while Nirmal Nayak wrote the dialogue. S. Ranjan was the cinematographer. Bijay Mohanty, Tandra Roy, Kuna Tripathy, Biren Mishra, Ankita Bhowmick, Mihir Das, Harihara Mahapatra, Biju Badajena, Gour Acharya and Sachin appeared in supporting roles.

Manmath Mishra composed the music. The lyricists included Basantaraj Samal, Nirmal Nayak, Arun Mantri and Sujitra Parija, and the singers included Udit Narayan, Mohammed Aziz, Krishna Mishra, Abhijit Mishra, Tapu Mishra, Ira Mohanty, Shaan and Arupa Das.

Q119889696.lead: Bou – Khai Pii, Darama Nahin is a 2023 Odia-language television film directed and produced by Mrutyunjay Sahu, with Smita Mohanty in the lead role.

p: The film was made by Tarang Cine Productions. B. Chandan Kumar wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue. R. Bhagat Singh was the cinematographer and Pintu Nayak the editor. Prithviraj Nayak, Biranchi Narayan Nayak, Manaswini Pati, Tanushree Dash, Rakhee Dash and Pupinder Singh were among the supporting cast.
Abhijit Majumdar composed the music, and the songs were written by lyricists including Bijay Malla and Debidutta Mohanty.
It premiered on Tarang TV and Tarang Plus on 14 May 2023, to mark Mother's Day.

Q139892150.lead: Ladhei is a 2025 Odia-language film directed by Ashok Pati, with Lohitakshya Pattnaik and Abhilipsa Raul in the lead roles.

p: Debashis Pattnaik produced the film, and Bharadwaj Panda wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue. Biswajit Kuldi was the cinematographer and Manas Kumar Sahu the editor. The supporting cast included Phani Pratik, Bibhas, Krishna Kar, Sushant Das Mahapatra, Amiya Prakash, Chandra Narayan Mallick, Rajib Mohanty, Preeti Ranjan, Ashok Pattnaik and Rabi Behera.

Gaurav Anand and Somesh Satpathy directed the music. Nirmal Nayak, JP Wordsmith and Bapu Goswami were among the lyricists, and Swayam Padhi, Antara Chakraborty, Kuldeep Pattnaik and Asima Panda were among the singers.
The film opened in cinemas on 31 December 2025.

Q47004312.lead: Mitare Mita is a 2009 Odia-language film directed by Sudhakar Vasant, starring Arindam Roy, Lovely and Namrata Thapa.

p: Anam Charan Sahu and Laxmipriya Sahu produced the film, with Laxmipriya Sahu also writing the story. Vasant wrote the screenplay and Rajani Ranjan the dialogue. Sitanshu Mahapatra was the cinematographer and Chandra Sekhar Mishra the editor. Tanmay Mishra, Mihir Das, Bijay Mohanty, Saroj Das, Pintu Nanda, Raja, Harihara Mahapatra and Jayiram Samal played other roles, and Shivani Sangita appeared as a child artist.

Prasant Padhi composed the music and was one of the lyricists, along with Basantaraj Samal, Arun Mantri and Nirmal Nayak. The singers included Mohammed Aziz, Kumar Bapi, Tapu Mishra, Udit Narayan, Padhi and the producer Anam Charan Sahu.
The film was released on 24 September 2009.

Q140859627.lead: Rangashoor is a 2025 Odia-language film directed by Pratap Rout, featuring Suryamayee Mohapatra, Jyoti Ranjan Nayak, Dipanwit Dashmohapatra, Subhasis Sharma and Samaresh Routray.

p: Sachikanta Jena produced the film. Rout wrote the story with Umang and also served as cinematographer, while Satrughna and Himanshu wrote the screenplay and Rajani Ranjan the dialogue. Sandeep Sethi edited the film. Choudhury Jayprakash Das and Subhashree Jena were also in the cast.

Gaurav Anand and Boni Mohanty composed the music. Sthita Pattnaik, Sumit Panda and Ranjan Nayak were among the lyricists, and the singers included Anand, Barnali Hota, Ananya Sritam Nanda, Antara Chakraborty and Ashish Pradhan.
The film was released in cinemas on 12 January 2025.

Q7421153.lead: Saptasajya is an Odia-language film directed by Kalyan Gupta, starring Byomkesh Tripathi and Anima Pedini, released in 1950 or 1951 depending on the account.

p: The Odia account credits the production to Sesha Pratap Singhdeo, a member of the Dhenkanal royal family known as Nini Saheb, while the English account names Ratikant Nayak, who also acted in the film, as producer. The poet Ananta Patnaik wrote the story, screenplay, dialogue and songs. Giridhari, Pankaj Nanda, Kishori Rajendra, Kamala Sen, Bhagaban Mohanty and Tunia were also in the cast.
Udaya Nath Sahu composed the music. One of the songs was "Rangi Dhana Kie Luti Neichi Lo Bata Re".

The Odia account dates the release to 1 December 1951, based on a newspaper advertisement in the Samaja, while the English account gives 1950. A review of the film by Dhira Biswal appeared in the magazine Cine Odisha.

facts: "Rangi Dhana Kie Luti Neichi Lo Bata Re"

Q110656584.lead: Twist Wala Love Story is a 2019 Odia-language television film directed by Rajesh Mohanty, featuring Subhasis Sharma, Jagjit Pal, Raj Rajesh Panda, Mahaprasad Kar, Niharika Dash, Lipika and Puja.

p: Jagi Mangat Panda produced the film under the Tarang Cine Productions banner. Mohanty wrote the screenplay, and Debidutta Mohanty and Santosh Narayan Das wrote the dialogue. Sudarshan Sahu was the cinematographer and Tapas Ranjan Behera the editor. Premanjan Parida and Pratibha Panda were among the supporting cast.

The music was directed by Goodly Rath, Prem Anand and Jagya Dash. Debidutta Mohanty, Subrat Swain and Prakash Gochhayat were among the lyricists, and Humane Sagar, Diptirekha Padhi, Satyajit Pradhan and Lipsa Mohapatra were among the singers.
The film premiered on television on 10 February 2019.

Q116809819.lead: Kanyadana is a 2023 Odia-language television film directed by Mrutyunjay Sahu, with Bikram Mohanty, Jasmine Rath and Amir in the lead roles.

p: Kabir Das produced the film, made under the Zee Sarthak Films banner. Priyabrata wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue. D. Srinivas was the cinematographer and Rajesh Dash the editor. Mahasweta Roy, Ashok Das, Namita Das, Debu Pattnaik, Aishwarya Behera, Bidubhusan Sadangi, Aradhana and Keshab Mallick appeared in supporting roles.
Prasant Padhi composed the music to lyrics by Nirmal Nayak. Swayam Padhi, Antara Chakraborty, Debanshi and Subhasish Lenka were among the singers. The audio was released on 20 January 2023.
The film premiered on Zee Sarthak on 29 January 2023.

Q55757019.lead: Sasti is a 1989 Odia-language film written and directed by Brundaban Jena, adapted from Kahnu Charan Mohanty's novel of the same name.

p: Sudhanshu Mishra produced the film. Jena wrote the screenplay and dialogue, and Guru Gopikrishna Behera choreographed the dances. Ashok Swain was the cinematographer and Rabi Shankar Patnaik the editor. The cast included Uttam Mohanty, Aparajita Mohanty, Mihir Das, Snigdha Mohanty, Bijay Mohanty, Jayiram Samal, Dukhiram Swain, Shyamalendu Bhattacharya, Hemanta Das, Gita Rao and Kanta Singh.
Atish Mazumdar composed the music, Jena wrote the songs, and Trupti Das sang them.
The film won the Odisha State Film Award for Best Film.

facts: Sasti, novel by Kahnu Charan Mohanty

Q55455047.lead: Rakhi Bhijigala Aakhi Luhare is a 1999 Odia-language film directed by Sangram Biswal, featuring Siddhanta Mahapatra, Rachna Banerjee, Mihir Das and Debu Bose.

p: Subrat Samantaray produced the film and wrote its story. Biswal wrote the screenplay and Sirshananda Das Kanungo the dialogue. Samba Siva Rao was the cinematographer and Deben Mishra the editor. Saroj Das, Rabi Mishra, Aparajita Mohanty, Bijay Mohanty, Raimohan Parida, Runu Parija, Asit Pati, Nimananda Patra and Jayiram Samal were also in the cast.

Arun Mohanty was the music director. The lyricists included Sirshananda Das Kanungo, Nizam and Sujogya Samantaray, and the playback singers included Swapna Agasti, Kumar Kanchan, Amit Kumar, Ira Mohanty, Anuradha Paudwal and Kumar Sanu.

Q116809821.lead: Bibhranta is a 2023 Odia-language film written and directed by Biswabhusan Mahapatra, starring Jyoti Ranjan Nayak and Tamanna Vyas.

p: Hara Prasad Sahu produced the film. Mahapatra wrote the story and screenplay, and Amit Kumar Das the dialogue. Bitul Das was the cinematographer and Amarendra Mohanty the editor. Pragyan Khatua and Dipan Barua were among the supporting cast.

Abhijit Majumdar and Gaurav Anand composed the music. Nirmal Nayak, Arun Mantri and Ranjan Nayak were among the lyricists, and the singers included Anand, Tariq Aziz, Diptirekha Padhi, Satyajit Pradhan and Antara Chakraborty.
The trailer was launched at the Adiyogi Auditorium of the Isha Yoga Center in Coimbatore. The film opened in cinemas on 10 February 2023.

Q122603618.lead: Pratisodh is a 2023 Odia-language film directed by Sai Swaraj Mangaraj, with Elina Samantray in the lead role.

p: Khirod Pattnaik produced the film, which was made under the Zee Sarthak Films banner. Bharadwaj Panda wrote the screenplay and dialogue. Pratap Rout was the cinematographer and Manas Kumar Sahu the editor. Samaresh Routray, Kuna Tripathy, Niki, Pritiraj Satpathy, Piyush Tripathy, Jiban Panda and Pushpa Panda also appeared.
Goodly Rath composed the music, Surya Mahapatra wrote the lyrics, and the singers included Gaurav Anand, Satyajit Pradhan and Lipsa Mohapatra.
Originally planned for 22 September 2023, the release was pushed back, and the film reached cinemas on 25 September 2023. It was broadcast on Zee Sarthak on 1 October 2023.

Q55995438.lead: Agni Pariksha is an Odia-language film directed by Surya Misra, starring Siddhanta Mahapatra and Anu Choudhury.

p: Narayan Rout produced the film. Subodh Pattnaik wrote the story and dialogue, and Misra wrote the screenplay. Satya Pattnaik was the cinematographer and Rabi Pattnaik the editor. Work on the film first began in 1997 with Rachna Banerjee chosen as the heroine; she was later replaced by Anu Choudhury. Uttam Mohanty, Bijay Mohanty, Hara Patnaik, Anita Das, Asit Pati, Jayiram Samal, Harihara Mahapatra and Runu Parija played supporting roles.
Akshaya Mohanty composed the music and Nizam wrote the songs. The playback singers included Udit Narayan, Sonu Nigam, Nizam and Anuradha Paudwal.
The film was released in 2004.

Q56683158.lead: Ole Ole Dil Bole is a 2018 Odia-language film directed by Kailash Mahapatra, starring Jyoti Ranjan Nayak and Jhillik Bhattacharya.

p: Bibhuti Bhusan Sadangi produced the film. D. Niranjan Reddy wrote the story and shared the dialogue with Antarjami Sarghariya, while Mahapatra wrote the screenplay. Dipankar Jahna was the cinematographer and Rajesh Nayak the editor. Siddhanta Mahapatra, Mihir Das, Choudhury Bikash Das, Hadu, Prabhati Sahu and Piyush Mohanty were among the supporting cast.
Prem Anand composed the music, with lyrics by Basantaraj Samal and Subrat Swain. The singers included Diptirekha Padhi, Udit Narayan, Ashutosh, Lopamudra, Sabisesh, Ananya Sritam Nanda and Biswajit.
The film was released on 13 April 2018.

Q139851576.lead: Mehermunda is a 2026 Odia-language film directed by Nikunja Hota, featuring Jyoti Ranjan Nayak, Rajesh Kumar Padhi and Arnil Ankita.

p: Rakesh Kumar Padhi produced the film. Suraj Mahapatra and Hota wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue together. Srikant Pattnaik was the cinematographer and Somya Priyadarshi Mishra the editor. The cast also included Sushant Dashmohapatra, Gadadhar Barik, Rajeswar Patra, Kamalalochan Rout, Mita Chakraborty, Shree Radha, Prabhakar Mishra, Santoshini Nayak, Laxmipriya Panigrahi and Bijay Kumar Patra.
Amit Yubaraj and Chandrashiv Shah directed the music, Pushpak Parida wrote the lyrics, and Yubaraj sang the songs.
The film was released in cinemas on 15 May 2026.

Q6419692.lead: Klanta Aparahna (Tired Afternoon) is a 1985 Odia-language film written and directed by Manmohan Mahapatra, depicting everyday life in a small village in Odisha.

p: The film is set against the problem of dowry and portrays daily life in an Odisha village. Its central character is Neeru, played by Kanak Panigrahi, with Kishori Devi as her grandmother.

Mahapatra wrote the story. The film was shot in rural surroundings, with Ranajit Ray as cinematographer and Satyendra Mohanty as editor. Sachidananda Rath, Madhukar Goshthi and Master Sushil were also in the cast.
Shantanu Mahapatra composed the music.
The film runs 93 minutes. It was shown in the Indian Panorama in 1986 and at a feminist film festival in Mumbai.
The film received a National Film Award and an Odisha State Film Award.

Q55443735.lead: Ki Heba Sua Posile is a 1991 Odia-language film directed by Basant Sahu, featuring Bijay Mohanty, Anita Das, Uttam Mohanty and Nupur Ghosh.

p: Rabi Swain produced the film and wrote its story. Sahu wrote the screenplay and Bijay Mishra the dialogue. Madhukar S. Rao was the cinematographer and Deben Mishra the editor. Munna Khan, Aruna, Jayiram Samal, Kanta Singh, Nihar Samal, Sasmita Pradhan, Debu Bose, Nityananda Mishra, Gita Rao, Asit Pati, Byomkesh Tripathy and Mihir Das were among the supporting cast.
Swarup Nayak composed the music and wrote songs together with Suresh Parida. The singers included Subash Das, Anupama Deshpande, Debashish Mahapatra, Jayashree Shivaram and Ursula Vaz.
The film was released on 9 July 1991 and runs 154 minutes.

Q45036759.lead: Rangila Toka is a 2012 Odia-language film directed by K. Murali Krishna, starring Papu Pam Pam and Debjani.

p: Prabhas Chandra Rout produced the film. Munna Patra wrote the story and Deepak Jena the dialogue. R. Bhagat Singh was the cinematographer and Chandra Sekhar Mishra the editor. Siddhanta Mahapatra, Neetu Singh, Minaketan, Priyanka Mahapatra, Jiban Panda, Hadu, Arabinda Sadangi, Jayiram Samal and Lovely were among the supporting cast.

Abhijit Majumdar composed the music, with lyrics by Nizam and Nirmal Nayak. The playback singers included Pamela Jain, Kavita Krishnamurthy, Majumdar, Udit Narayan, Vinod Rathod, Babul Supriyo and the lead actor Papu Pam Pam.
The film was released on 27 July 2012.

Q121668040.lead: Priye Tu Mo Sie is a 2023 Odia-language film directed by Sudhanshu Mohan Sahu, starring Amlan Das and Elina Samantray.

p: Jhillik Bhattacharya produced the film. Saranarabinda Ojha wrote the story and dialogue, and Sahu wrote the screenplay. Iswar Barik was the cinematographer and Rajesh Dash the editor. Bobby Mishra, Abhishek Giri and Bibhuti Tripathy were among the supporting cast.

Baidyanath Dash composed the music. Nirmal Nayak and Arun Mantri were among the lyricists, and the singers included Satyajit Pradhan, Subhasish Sahu, Kuldeep Pattnaik, Humane Sagar, Ananya Sritam Nanda and Asima Panda.
The film opened in cinemas on 29 June 2023.

Q43226562.lead: Sapanara Nayika is a 2013 Odia-language film directed by Raj Pradeep, starring Dipak Barik and Pinki Priyadarsini.

p: Rabindra Panda and Anarbha Routray produced the film. Bijayalaxmi Panda wrote the story, and Rajani Ranjan wrote the screenplay and dialogue. Jay Pradhan was the cinematographer and Rajesh Dash the editor. Daitari Panda, Manoj Mishra, Sritam Das, Lawrence Behera, Chinmayee Priyadarshini, Guddu, Badal Mohanty and Ananta Mishra were in the supporting cast.

Prasant Padhi composed the music. Kumar Jiten, Arun Mantri, Panchanan Nayak and Rashmi Ranjan were among the lyricists, and Pamela Jain, Udit Narayan, Pami, Vinod Rathod and Saurav were among the singers.
The film was released on 24 May 2013.

Q54281150.lead: Mukti Tirtha is a 1992 Odia-language film written and directed by Himanshu Das, featuring Asim Basu, Uttam Mohanty, Mahasweta Roy, Anita Das and Hara Patnaik.

p: Gopal Chandra Sahu and Harendra Sahu produced the film. Das wrote the story and screenplay and also acted in it, while Subodh Pattnaik wrote the dialogue. Rajan Kinagi was the cinematographer and Rabi Shankar Patnaik the editor. The cast also included Isa Bebarta, Anil Chatterjee, Rinku Dutta, Ajit Kar, Kuni Mishra, Debika Mukherjee, Radha Panda, Sarat Pujari and Jayiram Samal.
