Shantanu Mahapatra composed the music. The lyricists included Debdas Chhotray and Sirshananda Das Kanungo, and the singers included Subash Das, Lopita Mishra, Debashish Mahapatra and Anuradha Paudwal.
The film was released on 5 March 1992.

Q50825287.lead: Hari Om Hari is a 2013 Odia-language film directed by Dilip Panda, starring Siddhanta Mahapatra, Akash Dasnayak, Megha Ghosh and Riya Dey.

p: Sumit Rout and Sipra Das produced the film. The story was written by Shibaprasad Das and Sujata Rout, the dialogue by Nirmal Nayak and the screenplay by Panda. Samaresh Routray, Pintu Nanda, Minaketan, Priyanka Mahapatra, Jiban Panda, Chunga, Saroj Das and Salil Mitra were in the supporting cast.

Abhijit Majumdar composed the music to lyrics by Nirmal Nayak and Nizam. The playback singers included Javed Ali, Pamela Jain, Majumdar, Anjali Mishra, Udit Narayan, Saurav Nayak, Asima Panda and Rinki.
The film was released on 12 July 2013.

Q110327133.lead: Akhi Bujidele Tu is a 2021 Odia-language television film directed by S. K. Muralidhar, starring Pupinder Singh, Deepika Tripathy and Jyotirmayee Bal.

p: The actor Pupinder Singh produced the film as well as playing one of the leads. Niranjan Kar wrote the story and Tusharkanta Pattnaik the screenplay. Pradeep was the cinematographer and Tubun the editor. Samaresh Routray, Manoj Mishra, George Tiadi, Rabi Mishra, Jiban Panda and Guddu also appeared.
Abhijit Majumdar composed the music, and Tusharkanta Pattnaik wrote the songs. The singers included Humane Sagar, Antara Chakraborty, Tilak Chakraborty, Anjali Mishra, Sasank Sekhar and Asima Panda.
The film premiered on Colors Odia on 31 December 2021.

Q112582964.lead: Chorani 2 is a 2022 Odia-language film directed by Mrutyunjay Patra, starring Suryamayee Mohapatra and Abhishek Panda.

p: Ramesh Barik produced the film. Debidutta Mohanty and Santosh Narayan Das wrote the story and screenplay, and B. Chandan Kumar the dialogue. R. Bhagat Singh was the cinematographer and Rajesh Dash the editor. The supporting cast included Pintu Nanda, Shankar, Tribhuban Panda, Ashok Das, Alaka Satapathy, Diana Aishwarya, Babu Pradhan and Subhasis.
Abhijit Majumdar composed the music to lyrics by Nirmal Nayak. Swayam Padhi, Antara Chakraborty, Satyajit Pradhan, Lopamudra Dash and Amrita Nayak were among the singers.
The film was released on 12 June 2022.

Q52154827.lead: Aeithi Swarga Aeithi Narka is a 2003 Odia-language film directed by Sisir Mohan Pati, featuring Siddhanta Mahapatra, Mihir Das, Mama Mishra and Jyoti Mishra.

p: Phelu Pattnaik and Kanwal Singh produced the film. Pattnaik also wrote the story and dialogue, and Pati wrote the screenplay. Samba Siva Rao was the cinematographer and A. Sekhar Prasad the editor. Usasi Mishra, Hara Patnaik, Suresh Bal, Namrata Das, Saroj Das, Satyaki Mishra, Pintu Nanda, Braja Singh, Jayiram Samal and Priyambada Ray were also in the cast.

Phelu Pattnaik composed the music and was among the lyricists, with Debdas Chhotray, Sriharsha Kar, Nizam and Pradipta Ray. The singers included Mohammed Aziz, Pankaj Jal, Ira Mohanty, Arabinda Muduli and Sailabhama Mahapatra.

Q110137686.lead: Bishwaas – The Light Over Darkness is a 2021 Odia-language film written and directed by Chinmay Das Pattnaik, featuring Sahil Mishra, Sujay Mohanty, Arun Mohanty and Sagarika Das.

p: Bibekananda Panigrahi produced the film. S. Ranjan was the cinematographer and Jyoti Prakash Maharana the editor. The cast also included Darshan Bhanjdeo, Arpita Das, Resli Patra, Prakashini Mishra, Biswajit Das, Tapas Panda, Sudhir Mohanty, Gokul Chandra Das, Sangram Bhanjdeo, Mangal Besra and Santosh Mohanty.
Shantanu Satpathy composed the music, and Das Pattnaik wrote the songs. Shiba Rath, Ira Mohanty and Bishnumohan Kabi were among the singers.
The film opened in cinemas on 15 December 2021 and was released in theatres again on 29 July 2022.

Q33129277.lead: Premara Nisha Niara Niara is a 2016 Odia-language film directed by Saroj Kant, starring Shubham Naik and Jina Samal.

p: Kant wrote the screenplay as well as directing. The story was by Rajendra and the dialogue by Manoranjan Das, and Rajesh Das edited the film. The producer is named as Bharati Naik in one place and Bharati Kant in another. Sonia, George Tiadi, Asrumochan Mohanty, Manoj Mishra, Pragyan and Jhansi played supporting roles.
Soumitri Palai and Sailendra directed the music. Kishore Kumbhar and Manoj Das were among the lyricists, and Chitta Ranjan, Humane Sagar and Asima Panda were among the singers.
The film was released on 9 December 2016.

Q28946717.lead: Paradeshi Chadhei is a 1990 Odia-language film directed by Ravi Kinagi, featuring Uttam Mohanty, Sujata Anand, Dukhiram Swain and Mihir Das.

p: Gyan Pattnaik produced the film and also acted in it. Shankar Kinagi wrote the screenplay and Bijay Mishra the dialogue. Rajan Kinagi was the cinematographer and Deben Mishra the editor. Ajit Das, Namrata Das, Hara Patnaik, Suresh Bal, Arminta, Premanjan Parida, Nityananda Mishra, Binayak Mishra, Keshab Rout and Debu Brahma were also in the cast.

Akshaya Mohanty composed the music and wrote songs together with Nimai Mohanty. The playback singers included Subash Das, Anupama Deshpande, Kavita Krishnamurthy, Anuradha Paudwal, Sadhana Sargam and Suresh Wadkar.

Q51080374.lead: Tate Mo Rana is a 2005 Odia-language film written and directed by Sanjay Nayak, starring Siddhanta Mahapatra and Barsha Priyadarshini.

p: Narayan Badhol produced the film, and Nayak wrote its story and screenplay. Ranjan was the cinematographer and Ashok Sharma the editor. Mihir Das, Bijay Mohanty, Kuna Tripathy, Snigdha Mohanty, Bina Moharana, Biju Badajena, Jayiram Samal, Puja Thapa and Prabhas Samantaray were among the supporting cast.

Malay Mishra composed the music. The lyricists included Basantaraj Samal, Ganesh Mahapatra, Nirmal Nayak, Panchanan Nayak, Satya Narayan Sahu and Guru Satpathy, and the singers included Kumar Bapi, Bibhu Kishore, Ira Mohanty, Saurav Mohanty and Sanghamitra.

Q30327086.lead: Bhakta Salabega is a 1983 Odia-language film directed by Radha Panda, featuring Uttam Mohanty, Aparajita Mohanty, Sarat Pujari, Anita Das and Dukhiram Swain.

p: Surya Narayan Mohanty produced the film. Subhalaxmi Mohanty wrote the story, Prayag Raj the screenplay and Byomkesh Tripathy the dialogue; Tripathy and Panda also acted in it. Srinivas Mahapatra was the cinematographer and Rabi Pattnaik the editor. Hemanta Das, Biren Routray, Gobinda Tej, Jayiram Samal, Gurudutta and Sulu Mohanty were also in the cast.
Bhubaneswar Mishra composed the music. Narasingha Mahapatra wrote the songs, and the soundtrack also used songs composed by Salabega. Bhikari Bal and Anuradha Paudwal were among the singers.
The film was released on 15 May 1983.

Q47034745.lead: Shakti is a 2018 Odia-language film directed by Sudhakar Vasant, starring Karan and Suryamayee Mohapatra.

p: Ronak Sahu and Minati Sahu produced the film. Ranjit Pattnaik wrote the story and dialogue, and Vasant wrote the screenplay. The film marked Karan's acting debut in Odia cinema. Mihir Das, Uttam Mohanty, Pintu Nanda, Harihara Mahapatra, Guddu, Biju Badajena, Rajib Mohanty, Aparajita and Pratibha Panda were among the supporting cast.
Abhijit Majumdar composed the music and Nirmal Nayak wrote the lyrics. The singers included Majumdar, Smruti, Satyajit, Humane Sagar, Bishnumohan Kabi, Madhab Das and Priyanka.
The film was released on 27 April 2018.

Q110754796.lead: Samaapajura Raghu is an Odia-language television film directed by Chinmay Mishra, starring Manoj Mishra and Suryamayee Mohapatra.

p: The actor Manoj Mishra produced the film and wrote its story and screenplay together with Chinmay Mishra. Pranab Rath wrote the dialogue. Deepak Kumar was the cinematographer and Ranjan Khatei the editor. Partha Sarathi Ray, Debjani Deghuria, Mamata Nanda, Astha, Ratan Meher and Angel appeared in supporting roles.

Suroj Purohit and Bibhuti Bhusan Gadanayak directed the music. Binod Pasayat, Satya Ranjan Bal and Sthita Pattnaik were among the lyricists, and Asit Tripathy, Ananya Sritam Nanda, Sarbeswar Bhoi and Padmini Dora were among the singers.
The film premiered on Tarang TV and Tarang Plus on 30 January 2022, although one account gives the year as 2020.

Q34475471.lead: Hela Mate Prema Jara is a 2016 Odia-language film directed by Amaresh Pati, starring Sabyasachi Mishra and Archita Sahu. It is based on the Telugu film Bhale Bhale Magadivoy.

p: Smruti Ranjan Rout and Suresh Kumar Haibru produced the film. Rajani Ranjan wrote the screenplay and dialogue, adapting the story of the Telugu original. Dhrubananda Panda was the cinematographer. Mihir Das, Minaketan, Jiban Panda, Snigdha Mohanty, Pragyan, Guddu and Suman were in the supporting cast.
Prem Anand composed the music, and Arun Mantri and Basantaraj Samal wrote the songs.
The film was released on 18 March 2016.

Q110664324.lead: Chirkut is a 2019 Odia-language film written and directed by Papu Pam Pam, his first film as a director, starring Arjyoti and Ananya.

p: Akshaya Kumar Parija, Prashant Behera and Sunil Kumar Yadav produced the film. Papu Pam Pam wrote the story and screenplay and composed the music, and Deepak Jena wrote the dialogue. Niranjan Das and Ajit handled the cinematography and Rajesh Das the editing. Arabinda Jena, Krupasindhu Nayak, Binod Rout, Deepak Tripathy and Pratibha Panda were in the supporting cast.
The lyricists included Deepak Jena, Sumit Jena and Suresh Panda. Iswari Behera, Debashish Pati, Papu Pam Pam, Bishnumohan Kabi, Antara Chakraborty, Swayam Padhi and Asim Panda were among the singers.
The film was released on 14 June 2019.

Q114804702.lead: Kahibini Tate I Love You is a 2022 Odia-language film directed by the duo Lubun-Tubun, starring Lubun, Sona and Manaswini.

p: Pritish Mohanty produced the film and wrote its story. Lubun-Tubun wrote the screenplay, and Bapu Goswami wrote the dialogue. Sandeep Mishra, Arpita Kar, Risna, Saroj Das, Prabhati Sahu, Ashok Das, Pushpa Panda, Mili Mohanty and Nonsense Mani were among the supporting cast.
Baidyanath Dash composed the music. Nirmal Nayak and Bapu Goswami were among the lyricists, and Humane Sagar, Arpita Choudhury and Diptirekha Padhi among the singers.
The film was released on 17 July 2022, with premiere shows at 11 am at Swati in Bhubaneswar and Brundaban Hall in Cuttack.

Q56617270.lead: Topae Sindura Di Topa Luha is a 2005 Odia-language film directed by Basant Sahu, starring Siddhanta Mahapatra, Anu Choudhury, Anubhav Mohanty and Barsha Priyadarshini.

p: Bijay Kandoi produced the film and wrote its story. Pradeep Nanda wrote the screenplay and Mohammed Safi the dialogue. Abhiram Mishra was the cinematographer and Ashok Sharma the editor. Mihir Das, Aparajita Mohanty, Suresh Bal, Debu Bose, Harihara Mahapatra, Jayiram Samal, Braja Singh and George Tiadi played supporting roles.

The music is credited to Krishna Chandra in one account and to Krushna Sahu in another. Sirshananda Das Kanungo, Panchanan Nayak and Nizam were among the lyricists, and Kumar Bapi, Tapu Mishra, Udit Narayan, Sailabhama Mahapatra and Suresh Wadkar among the singers.

Q47091773.lead: Hasiba Puni Mo Suna Sansar is a 2008 Odia-language film directed by Ranjan Misra, starring Siddhanta Mahapatra, Anu Choudhury and Mamuni Mishra.

p: Babu Singh produced the film and wrote its story. Misra wrote the screenplay and was also the cinematographer, while Rajani Ranjan wrote the dialogue and Sushant Mani edited the film. Mihir Das, Aparajita Mohanty, Debu Brahma, Choudhury Jayprakash Das, Hadu, Asrumochan Mohanty, Pintu Nanda, Banamali Panda and George Tiadi were among the supporting cast.
Babu Mishra composed the music, Nizam wrote the lyrics, and the singers included Babu Kishore, Ira Mohanty and Saurav Mohanty.
The film was released on 20 February 2008.

Q112341364.lead: Dil Mora Manena is a 2022 Odia-language film directed by Himanshu Parija, starring Swaraj Barik and Shivani Sangita.

p: Bapun Kumar and Chhabita Martha produced the film. Parija wrote the story, and Bijay Raul wrote the dialogue; the screenplay is credited to Himalaya Prusti in one account and to Parija in another. Subham was the cinematographer and Rajesh Das the editor. Harihara Mahapatra, Salil Mitra, Mihir Das, Jiban Panda, Bidusmita, Usasi Mishra and Sridhar Martha played supporting roles.
Prem Anand composed the music. The lyricists included Nirmal Nayak, Arun Mantri, Basantaraj Samal and Subrat Swain, and the singers included Biswajit Mahapatra, Ashutosh Mohanty and Diptirekha Padhi.
The film was released on 10 June 2022.

Q49840538.lead: Rakhi Bandhili Mo Rakhiba Mana is a 2006 Odia-language film directed by Sanjay Nayak, starring Mihir Das, Siddhanta Mahapatra and Anu Choudhury.

p: Ratikanta Kanungo and Pramod Kumar Swain produced the film. Suchismita Kanungo wrote the story, and Nayak wrote the screenplay and dialogue. Ranjan was the cinematographer and Rabi Shankar Patnaik the editor. Asit Pati, Uttam Mohanty, Minaketan, Snigdha Mohanty, Bina Moharana, Dipti Panda and Jayiram Samal were among the supporting cast.

Malay Mishra composed the music and Srikanta Gautam wrote the lyrics. The singers included Mohammed Aziz, Subash Das, Abhay Mishra, Shakti Mishra, Ira Mohanty, Pritinanda Routray, Arabinda Sadangi, Sailabhama Mahapatra and Babul Supriyo.

Q28924659.lead: Mimansa is a 2016 Odia-language film directed by Chakradhar Sahu and produced by Soumya Ranjan Patnaik, with Lipi in the lead role.

p: The film follows the events among a fisherman's relatives after he goes missing. Its central theme is the swift erosion of human decency and values, showing how people can suddenly change for the sake of a small amount of money.

The film was based on an original story of the same name by Pradeep Dash, with a screenplay by Sutanu Gupta. Prasantanu Mahapatra handled the cinematography. Alongside Lipi, the cast included Hara Rath, Minaketan, Manoj Pattnaik and Suresh Bal.

The score was composed by Ratnesh Bhagat, a music director from Mumbai. Nizam, Jitendra Pradhan and Mohit Chakraborty wrote the lyrics, and the songs were sung by Mahalakshmi Iyer, Sangram Mohanty and Aman Trikha, among others.
Mimansa was released on 5 August 2016.

Q48937732.lead: Tu Eka Aama Saha Bharasa is a 2006 Odia-language film directed by Shakti Baral, starring Siddhanta Mahapatra, Jyoti Mishra and Mihir Das.

p: Sushant Sahu produced the film and wrote its story, while Subodh Pattnaik wrote the dialogue. Shakti Baral wrote the screenplay in addition to directing. Dilip Ray was the cinematographer and Bijay Mishra the editor. The supporting cast included Suresh Bal, Ilu Banerjee, Mahua Bhattacharya, Minaketan, Aparajita Mohanty and Raimohan Parida.

The film marked Prem Anand's first work as a music director in Odia cinema. Lyrics came from Debdas Chhotray, Bijay Malla and Arun Mantri, and Ira Mohanty and Udit Narayan were among the playback singers.

Q114804700.lead: Astika Nastika is a 2022 Odia-language film directed by Sudhanshu Mohan Sahu, starring Buddhaditya Mohanty and Supriya Nayak, that premiered on television.

p: Pabitra Nayak produced the film. B. Chandan Kumar wrote the story and dialogue, and Debidutta Mohanty wrote the screenplay. Dhrubananda Panda was the cinematographer and Rajesh Dash the editor. Cookies Swain, Abhishek Giri, Tribhuban Panda, Saroj Das and Bhupati Tripathy appeared in supporting roles.
Goodly Rath composed the music, with lyrics by Surya Mahapatra and Nirmal Nayak. Sohini Mishra, Humane Sagar, Asima Panda, Mantu Chhuria and Lipsa Mahapatra were among the singers.
The film premiered on Tarang TV and Tarang Plus on 10 July 2022.

Q81827314.lead: Mun Paradeshi Chadhei is a 2020 Odia-language film directed by K. Murali Krishna, with Ardhendu Sahu and Anubha Sourya in the lead roles.

p: Adikanda Sahu produced the film, and Santosh Narayan Das and Debidutta Mohanty wrote the dialogue. Pratap Rout was the cinematographer and Ranjan Khatei the editor. Mihir Das, Pushpa Panda, Prithviraj Nayak and Pintu Nanda were part of the supporting cast.

Asad Nizam composed the music, with lyrics by Tapu Nayak and Nizam. The film takes its title from the popular Odia song "Mun Paradeshi Chadhei", which was recorded again for the film by Udit Narayan, who had sung the original. Other singers included Shaan, Humane Sagar, Swayam Padhi, Asima Panda and Diptirekha Padhi.
The film opened in cinemas on 10 January 2020.

facts: From the Odia song "Mun Paradeshi Chadhei"

Q139555898.lead: Aafaa is a 2026 Odia-language film directed by Pritiraj Satpathy, who also wrote its story and stars in it opposite Naina Das.

p: Pritiraj Satpathy and Naina Das produced the film. Kuna Tripathy wrote the dialogue and co-wrote the screenplay. Biswajit Kuldi handled the cinematography and Manas Ranjan the editing. The cast also included Anmol Pati, Kuna Tripathy, Hara Rath and Rabi Mishra; the film was the acting debut of Anmol Pati, daughter of director Ashok Pati.
Prem Anand composed the music, with lyrics by Dibya Kumar Sahu and Bapu Goswami. The singers included Diptirekha Padhi, Sashank Sekhar, Kuldeep Pattnaik, Ananya Sritam Nanda and Subhechha Mohanty.
Aafaa was released in cinemas on 3 April 2026.

Q45022682.lead: Tike Anadi Pura Khiladi is a 2017 Odia-language film written and directed by Lokanath Barik, starring Karan Singh Roy alongside three heroines: Bobly, Sanjana and Ipsita.

p: Robin Nanda produced the film, and Lokanath Barik wrote its story and screenplay; Ajay Samal wrote the dialogue. Mihir Das, Robin Nanda, Bijay Mohanty, Tandra Ray, Asit Pati and Jayiram Samal appeared in supporting roles.

Agniraj Kishore composed the score. Nirmal Nayak, Arun Mantri, Jatindra Pradhan, Jayanta Das and Sumit wrote the lyrics, and the singers included Satyajit, Humane Sagar, Kumar Bapi, Tariq Aziz and Asima Panda.
The film was released on 24 November 2017.

Q116809818.lead: Mama Weds Papa is a 2023 Odia-language film written and directed by Appu Kanungo, starring Abhishek Rath, Ritisha and Priyanka.

p: B. Chandrapriya Subudhi produced the film. Appu Kanungo wrote the story and screenplay and shared dialogue-writing with Chinmay Das Pattnaik. Niranjan Das was the cinematographer and Chandrasekhar Mishra the editor. The supporting cast included Krushna Abhishek, Jyoti Mishra, Debu Pattnaik, Rajani Ranjan and Guddu, with Munni as a child artist.
The music was composed jointly by Appu Kanungo and Asad Nizam, with lyrics by Arun Mantri and Surya Mahapatra.
The film opened in 30 cinemas across Odisha on 17 February 2023.

Q109460159.lead: Gaon Ra Na Galuapur is a 2021 Odia-language film directed by Jitendra Mahapatra, starring Papu Pam Pam and newcomer Manisha Dhar Mahapatra.

p: Samprit Swarup Satapathy produced the film. Nandalal Mahapatra wrote the story and dialogue and co-wrote the screenplay with the director. Kuna Tripathy, Mihir Das, Sujit Paikaray, Antarjami Panda, Girija Panda, Debi Barik, Rani Panda and Bijayini Mishra appeared in supporting roles.
Amarendra Mohanty composed the music. Asima Panda, Satyajit, Papu Pam Pam, T. Souri and Amarendra Mohanty himself sang the songs.
The film was released on 15 October 2021, during the Durga Puja festival.

Q66707613.lead: Khusi is a 2019 Odia-language film directed by Tapas Sargharia, featuring Mihir Das, Madhumita Mohanty and Soma Bhowmick. It won four Odisha State Film Awards.

p: The film was a Tarang Cine Productions venture. Tapas Sargharia and Bharadwaj Panda wrote the screenplay, and the dialogue was written by Shakti Baral, Debidutta Mohanty and Bharadwaj Panda. Rabindra Behera was the cinematographer and Rajesh Dash the editor. The cast also included Ashok Das, Shakti Baral, Saroj Parida, Kavya Keeran and child artist Aishwarya Mishra.
Bibhuti Bhusan Gadanayak composed the music and wrote the songs together with Bharadwaj Panda. Navya Jyoti, Baibhab Gadanayak, Purnachandra and Arpita were among the singers.
Khusi was released on 23 August 2019.

At the 31st Odisha State Film Awards the film received four awards: Best Actress for Kavya Keeran, Best Comedian for Saroj Parida, Best Child Artist for Aishwarya Mishra and Best Editor for Rajesh Dash.

Q52155291.lead: Maa Mangala is a 2003 Odia-language film directed by Surya Mishra and produced by Basudev Tripathy. It was the first Odia film of actress Naina Das.

p: Basudev Tripathy wrote the story as well as producing the film, and Alok Ray wrote the dialogue. Surya Mishra handled the screenplay alongside direction. Subhranshu was the cinematographer and Ashok Sharma the editor. Naina Das, Jyoti Mishra, Sritam Das and Minaketan headed a cast that also included Saroj Das, Rabi Mishra, Bijay Mohanty, Pintu Nanda and Raimohan Parida.

Biju Swain composed the music and wrote songs together with Nirmal Nayak. Kumar Bapi, Shakti Mishra, Ira Mohanty, Gopinath Mahapatra, Sunil Nayak, Pritinanda Routray and T. Souri were among the singers.
The film was released on 10 January 2003.

Q6956660.lead: Naari is a 1963 Odia-language film directed by Narendra Kumar Mitra and B. Trilochan. It won the National Film Award for Best Feature Film in Odia.

p: Jayanta is about to marry Manashi when he loses his sight, and she calls off the engagement. Malati, a nurse caring for him, first tries to bring Manashi back, then poses as Manashi herself and gives him one of her eyes. Once he can see again, Jayanta searches for Manashi, learns the truth from a servant and reaches Malati just in time to stop her from taking her own life.

Narendra Kumar Mitra produced the film, which was made on a budget of 66,000 rupees. Anima Pedini, Ashok and Durlabh played the main roles. The music was composed by Kali Charan Pattanayak, and the film runs 122 minutes.
Naari was released on 25 January 1963.
In 1964 the film received the President's Silver Medal, as the National Film Award for Best Feature Film in Odia.

facts: National Film Award for Best Feature Film in Odia

Q21043181.lead: Yashoda is a 1996 Odia-language film directed by Hara Patnaik and produced by Basanta Nayak under the Brajaraj Movies banner.

p: Basanta Nayak wrote the story in addition to producing the film, and Bijay Mishra wrote the dialogue. Deben Mishra was the editor. The film's budget was ₹85,60,200. The cast was led by Uttam Mohanty, Siddhanta Mahapatra, Aparajita Mohanty and Rachana Banerjee, with Priyanka Mahapatra, Usasi Mishra, Mihir Das, Jayiram Samal, Ashrumochan Mohanty and Smita Mohanty in other roles. Bhiku Seth, known as a villain in jatra theatre, played the film's villain.
Swarup Nayak both wrote and composed the songs. They were sung by Ghanashyam Panda, Debashis, Srikant, Ira Mohanty, Trupti Das and T. Souri, among others.
The film was released on 17 October 1996.

Q21403021.lead: Nua Nua Premare is a 2015 Odia-language film directed by S. K. Muralidharan, starring Amlan Das and Patrali Chattopadhyay.

p: Deepak Mishra produced the film and wrote its story, while Debidutta Mohanty wrote the dialogue and Sukumar Mani edited it. Amlan Das played Bunu Biswal and Patrali Chattopadhyay played Khushi Tripathy. Mihir Das and Aparajita Mohanty appeared as the lawyers Ashish and Sandhya Samantaray, Minaketan as a police inspector, Prithiraj Nayak as Khushi's brother and Subhasish Sharma as Dr. Rahul.
The music was composed by Abhijit Majumdar.
The film was released on 13 February 2015.

Q47068125.lead: Laila o Laila is a 2017 Odia-language film directed by Sushant Mani, starring Swaraj Barik and Sanmira Nagesh.

p: Sitaram Agrawal produced the film from a story by Siddharth Agrawal. Nirmal Nayak wrote the screenplay and dialogue, Subhranshu Das was the cinematographer, and Sushant Mani edited the film as well as directing it.

Baidyanath Dash composed the music and Nirmal Nayak wrote the lyrics. Humane Sagar, Ami Dash, R. S. Kumar, Nibedita, Sourin Bhatt, Asima Panda, Ananya Sritam Nanda and Diptirekha Padhi were among the singers.
The film opened on 29 December 2017, ahead of the 2018 New Year, and did not achieve much commercial success.
At the 12th Film and Television Award Show Time 2018, Lubun Tubun won Best Choreographer and Baidyanath Dash won Best Music Director for the film.

Q28924661.lead: Om Shanti Om is a 2005 Odia-language film that Prashanta Nanda produced, wrote, directed and edited, starring Siddhanta Mahapatra, Anu Choudhury and Lipi Parida.

p: Prashanta Nanda took on the story, screenplay, direction and editing himself, and Samba Siva Rao was the cinematographer. Mihir Das, Uttam Mohanty, Anita Das, Minaketan, Harihar Mahapatra, Ashrumochan Mohanty, Deepak Parida and Jayiram Samal were in the supporting cast. The film was the screen debut of Lipi Parida, and actress Gungun appeared in it as a child artist at the start of her career.
Manmath Mishra composed the music and wrote the songs, which were sung by Ira Mohanty, Sailabhama Mahapatra and T. Souri, among others.

Q110441089.lead: Pheria - Come Back is a 2020 Odia-language film written and directed by Mihir Ranjan Acharya, starring Pritiraj Satpathy and Jina Samal. It received eight Odisha State Film Awards.

p: Sunil Kumar Das produced the film, and Mihir Ranjan Acharya wrote both the story and screenplay. Amarjit Mohanty was the cinematographer and Amarendra Mahapatra the editor. Pritiraj Satpathy played Prakash and Jina Samal played Jyoti; the cast also included Debidutta Pradhan, Jayanta Santra, Atmananda Nayak, Sarbeswar Bhoi, Shibani Khara as Jhumuri and Sarthak Hota.
Shantiraj Khosla composed the music and wrote songs together with Nirmal Nayak. Karunakar Sethi, Gobinda and Sanju were among the singers.
The film was released on 15 August 2020.
The film won eight State Film Awards. Among them were Best Singer for Karunakar Sethi, Best Supporting Actress for Shibani Khara and Best Child Artist for Sarthak Hota.

Q114804720.lead: Pheri Asuthibi Kolaku Tora is a 2022 Odia-language television film written and directed by Sanjay Nayak, starring Jyotiprakash Panda and Poonam Mishra.

p: Actor Rabi Mishra produced the film and also appeared in it. Sanjay Nayak wrote the story and screenplay, and Ranjan Khatei was the editor. The cast included Saloni, Biren Mishra, Premanjana Parida, Biju Badajena and Dhiren Mishra.
Goodly Rath composed the music, with lyrics by Surya Mahapatra. Swayam Padhi, Neha Niharika, Mantu Chhuria, Lipsa Mahapatra and Sidhisna Bindhani sang the songs, which came out on 7 September 2022.
The film premiered on the Zee Sarthak channel on 18 September 2022.

Q112616800.lead: Kurukshetra is a 2022 Odia-language film directed by Ashwini Tripathy, starring Akash Dasnayak and Tamanna Vyas, that premiered on television.

p: Khirod Pattnaik produced the film. Ashwini Tripathy wrote the screenplay and Deepak Kumar the dialogue. Akshaya Kumar Nayak and Sarada Sahu handled the cinematography, and Manas Kumar Sahu edited the film. Samaresh Routray, Pintu Nanda, Pradyumna Lenka and Ilu Banerjee were among the supporting cast.
Goodly Rath composed the music, with lyrics by Nirmal Nayak and Surya Mahapatra. Kuldeep Pattnaik, Lipsa Mahapatra and Gaurav were among the singers.
The film premiered on Zee Sarthak on 13 February 2022.

Q15723860.lead: Kaberi is a 1983 Odia-language film directed by Ravi Kinagi and Govinda Tej, based on a novel by Gayatri Basu Mallik.

p: Kaberi has loved Sagar since they were children. When Sagar moves to the city for college, a young woman he tutors, Niharika, falls in love with him, and he marries her without informing his family before returning to the village. Hurt, Kaberi resolves never to marry, but in the end Sagar gives her the standing of a wife.

Nagen Sahu produced the film, which was adapted from Gayatri Basu Mallik's novel. Govinda Tej wrote the screenplay and playwright Biswajit Das wrote the dialogue. A. Sreekar Prasad edited the film, and its budget was ₹14.25 lakh. Mahasweta Ray played Kaberi and Sriram Panda played Sagar, with Debu Bose, Bijay Mohanty, Ajit Das, Jayiram Samal and Anima Pedini also in the cast.

Basudeba Rath composed the music to lyrics by Narayan Prasad Singh, Gour Pattnaik and Banabihari Panda. The playback singers were Chitta Jena, Bhubaneswari Mishra, Suresh Wadkar and Anuradha Paudwal. Songs included "Jhumi Jhumi Jauchhi Mana", "Asiba Bara Tora Hoiba Bahaghara" and "Jibanara Sabukichhi Maa Pain".

Q115786315.lead: Police Babu is a 2022 Odia-language television film directed by Sailendra Parida, starring Subhasish Sharma and Sayal Banerjee.

p: Ajay Rout produced the film. Sailendra Parida wrote the story, and Rajani Ranjan wrote the screenplay and dialogue. Rabindra Behera was the cinematographer and Rajesh Dash the editor. Bhupati Tripathy, Krishna Kar, Pintu Nanda, Kalia and Choudhury Jayprakash Das appeared in supporting roles.

Goodly Rath composed the music, with lyrics by Surya Mahapatra. Lipsa Mahapatra, Kuldeep Pattnaik, Sashank Sekhar and Jyotirmayee were among the singers. The soundtrack was released on 9 December 2022.
The film premiered on Zee Sarthak on 11 December 2022.

Q30004718.lead: Baazi is an Odia-language film written and directed by Ashok Pati, starring Siddhanta Mahapatra, Anu Choudhury, Barsha Priyadarshini and Sritam Das.

p: Namita Das and Sasmita Das produced the film. Ashok Pati wrote the story and screenplay, and Bijay Malla wrote the dialogue. Samba Siva Rao was the cinematographer and Chandrasekhar Mishra the editor. Anubhav Mohanty was first cast opposite Siddhanta Mahapatra, but because he had no dates available the part went to Sritam Das. Bijay Mohanty, Mihir Das, Anita Das, Uttam Mohanty and Ashrumochan Mohanty were also in the cast.
Malay Mishra composed the music, and the lyricists included Debdas Chhotray and Nimai Mohanty. Mohammed Aziz, Ira Mohanty, Udit Narayan and Nizam Shiba were among the singers.

Q112571498.lead: Mo Panatkanire Tu is a 2022 Odia-language television film directed by Pinu Nayak, starring Jyotiprakash Panda and Shraddha Panigrahi.

p: Pradyumna Lenka and Bikram Keshari Bisoyi produced the film. Actor Harihar Mahapatra wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue, and also appeared in it. Shubham was the cinematographer. Pradyumna Lenka acted in the film as well, and Mahasweta Ray played Sita Devi.

Baidyanath Dash composed the music. Arun Mantri, Surya Mahapatra and Nihar Priyashis wrote the lyrics, and Humane Sagar, Asima Panda, Arpita Choudhury, Kuldeep Pattnaik, Subas Sahu and Sanju were among the singers.
The film premiered on Zee Sarthak on 12 June 2022.

Q33403843.lead: Dele Dhara Katha Sare is a 2016 Odia-language film directed by Sailendra Mishra, starring Jyoti Ranjan Nayak and Malobika Banerjee.

p: Pankaj Rout produced the film. Rajani Ranjan wrote the story and dialogue, and Sailendra Mishra wrote the screenplay. Abhiram Mishra was the cinematographer and Deben Mishra the editor. The supporting cast included Ajit Das, Mahasweta Ray, Minaketan, Prithiraj and Priyanka Mahapatra. Bobby Mishra played a villain in the film, returning to such a role after a gap of four years.
Prasant Padhi composed the music to lyrics by Basantaraj Samal, Bapu Goswami and Arun Mantri, with Asima Panda and Kumar Bapi among the singers.
The film was released on 11 November 2016.

Q7503528.lead: Shree Shree Mahalaxmi Puja is an Odia mythological film from 1959, directed by Biswanath Nayak. Jharana Das, Sarat Pujari, Anubha Gupta and Bauribandhu head the cast.

p: Drawing on a legend, the film shows the goddess Laxmi walking out of the temple to teach the brothers Lord Jagannath and Lord Balabhadra a lesson.
Krushna Chandra Tripathy was the producer, and the budget was 85,000 rupees. Sarat Pujari made his film debut here. Shefali Nayak and Srikant were also cast.

The music director was Nachiketa Ghosh. Among the songs are "Mora Mana Sina Kehi Jane-na", "Aji Kartika Punei Dina Re Majhi Kata Mari", "Jaya Tu Maha Lakhmi Jaya Tu Ma", "Kete Maja E Dunia Bhai Maja" and "Ananta Akashe Aganita Taraka".

facts: Jaya Tu Maha Lakhmi Jaya Tu Ma; Mora Mana Sina Kehi Jane-na

Q43379233.lead: Bindas Romeo is a 2015 Odia-language film directed by Dipak Swain, with Pupun and Prakruti Mishra in the lead roles.

p: Jin Beura produced the film and wrote its story. Dipak Swain wrote the screenplay as well as directing, and Bapu Goswami wrote the dialogue. Ajit was the cinematographer. The supporting cast included Minaketan, Sritam Das, Mihir Das, Megha, Choudhury Bikash Das, Pintu Nanda, Hara Rath, George Tiadi, Jyoti Mishra and Manisha Mishra.
Bibhu Kishore composed the music, and Bapu Goswami wrote the song lyrics.
The film was released on 25 September 2015.

Q109519687.lead: Lali Haba Kahara is a 2021 Odia-language film directed by Ashok Pati and produced by actor Rabi Mishra, with Sambit Acharya and Suryamayee Mohapatra in the lead roles.

p: Sanjay Mahakud wrote the dialogue. The screenplay is credited variously to Amaresh Pati and to Ashok Pati. S. Ranjan handled the cinematography and Pintu Nayak the editing. Sambit Acharya played Krishna and Suryamayee Mohapatra played Lali, with Babi Mishra as Durgashankar, Pintu Nanda as Shaktishankar, Rabi Mishra as Gobardhan and Choudhury Jayprakash Das as Chaitanya.
Abhijit Majumdar composed the music and Nirmal Nayak wrote the lyrics. The singers included Tariq Aziz, Abhijit Majumdar, Sohini Mishra and Satyajit.
The film premiered on the television channel Zee Sarthak on 31 October 2021.

Q30004726.lead: Samay Kheluchhi Chaka Bhaunri is a 2002 Odia-language film directed by Sudhanshu Mohan Sahu, starring Siddhanta Mahapatra, Anu Choudhury, Mama Mishra, Mihir Das, Uttam Mohanty and Aparajita Mohanty.

p: Arun Sahu and Snehalata Sahu produced the film. Manoj Panda wrote the screenplay and Ranjit Patnaik the dialogue. Srinivas Mahapatra and Sachin Singh were the cinematographers, and Biswanath Rao edited the film. Sumit Sehgal, Debu Bose, Raicharan Das, Asrumochan Mohanty, Baishali Parida, Raimohan Parida and Premanjan Parida also appeared.
Malay Mishra composed the music, with lyrics by Debdas Chhotray. The playback singers included Abhijeet, Mohammed Aziz, Ira Mohanty, Jolly Mukherjee, Anuradha Paudwal and T. Sauri.

Q112208791.lead: Kou Akasa Ra Janha Tu is a 2022 Odia-language film directed by Rajendra Mahant, with Subhasis Sharma and Divya Mohanty in the lead roles.

p: Pabitra Nayak produced the film. B. Chandan Kumar wrote the story and screenplay, and Nishant Majhitia wrote the dialogue. Rabindra Behera was the cinematographer and Rajesh Das the editor. Saroj Das, Namita Das, Somu, Pradeep Dutta, Biranchi Narayan Nayak and Siya played supporting roles.

Sarat Nayak composed the score. Debidutta Mohanty, Bijay Malla and Gyani Debasish Mishra wrote the lyrics, and the songs were sung by Satyajit Pradhan, Antara Chakraborty, Susmita Mishra and Sohini Mishra, among others.
The film was released on 15 May 2022 on Tarang TV and Tarang Plus.

Q7408933.lead: Samay is a 1975 Odia-language film written, produced and directed by Ganesh Mahapatra, starring Shriram Panda, Prashanta Nanda, Tripura Misra, Dhir Biswal and George Tiadi.

p: The marriage of a newly-wed couple is thrown into turmoil when the husband loses his memory. A doctor friend offers the wife sympathy, but others misread their friendship and mock it, among them the doctor's Bombay-born wife, who herself becomes involved with an idle man from Bombay.
Samay was the first Odia film to include sequences in colour. Dilip Dutta and Rajan Kinagi were the cinematographers. Shyamalendu, Jyotsna Das and Neel Mahapatra were also in the cast.
The music was composed by Hariprasad Chaurasia and Bhubaneswar Mishra, credited together as Bhuban-Hari.

facts: First Odia film with parts in colour

Q54600885.lead: Bapa is a 1997 Odia-language film written and directed by Prashanta Nanda and produced by Bijay Khemka, starring Siddhanta Mahapatra, Mama Mishra, Mihir Das and Munna Khan.

p: Prashanta Nanda wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue, and also appeared in the cast. Madhu Ambat was the cinematographer and Ashok Sharma the editor. The ensemble included Naba Acharya, Nityananda Das, Sangeet Das, Srikant Gautam, Satyaki Mishra, Smita Mohanty, Prithwiraj Nayak, Ramachandra Pratihari, Premanjan Parida, Priyambada Ray, Jayiram Samal and Braja Singh.
Amarendra Mohanty composed the music.
The film was released on 9 October 1997.

Q110726024.lead: Kalia Karuchi Leela is a 2019 Odia-language television film directed by Ashwini Gadanayak and produced by actor Debasish Patra, starring Jyotiprakash Panda, Sradha Panigrahi and Debasish Patra.

p: Debasish Patra developed the story and screenplay, with Rajani Ranjan contributing to the story and screenplay and writing the dialogue. Rajanikanta Barik was the cinematographer. Suresh Bal, Jiban Panda, Pintu Nanda and Pinky Pradhan were also in the cast.
Sarat Nayak composed the music and Mohit Chakraborty wrote the lyrics. Bishnumohan Kabi sang the songs.
The film premiered on television, on Zee Sarthak, on 21 July 2019.
At the Jayadev Awards it won Best Telefilm, Best Director and Best Producer, along with Best Actor for Debasish Patra and Best Supporting Actor for Jiban Panda.

Q115786318.lead: Prasthanam is a 2022 Odia-language film directed by Raja D, with Amlan Das and Sradha Panigrahi in the lead roles.

p: Rinku Rinu Jena and Debesh Chandra Das produced the film. Kumarshree Sahu wrote the story and screenplay, and Manas Padihari wrote the dialogue. Akshay Nayak was the cinematographer and Ranjan Khatei the editor. Mihir Das, Manoj Mishra, Partha Sarathi Ray, Bunty R Samal, Usasi Misra and Rajasmita Kar were in the supporting cast.
Asad Nizam composed the music, with lyrics by Kumarshree Sahu and Tapu Nayak. Humane Sagar, Asima Panda, Kuldeep Pattnaik, R. S. Kumar, Neha Niharika and Asad Nizam were among the singers.
The film was released on 16 December 2022.

Q122958188.lead: Kaicha Mali is a 2023 Odia-language film directed by Mahesh Hazra, starring Subhasis Sharma, Supriya Nayak, Namrata Thapa and Dusmanta Panda.

p: Satyajit Bag produced the film. Mahesh Hazra wrote the story in addition to directing, while Biswa Bhusan Mishra wrote the screenplay and dialogue. Rabindra Behera handled the camera and Rajesh Dash the editing. Daitari Panda, Priyanka Mahapatra, Asrumochan Mohanty and Piyush were in the supporting cast.
Baidyanath Dash composed the music. Arun Mantri and Nirmal Nayak were among the lyricists, and Diptirekha Padhi, Humane Sagar, Kuldeep Pattnaik and Asima Panda were among the singers.
The film opened in cinemas on 6 October 2023.

Q141000630.lead: Guruji Namaskar is a 2026 Odia-language film directed by Jitendriya Pradhan and written and produced by Sanket Kumar Tripathy, starring Aman Parasar, Sukumar Tudu, Shivanshi Sen and Illu Banarjee.

p: Sanket Kumar Tripathy wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue, and also acted in the film. Jyoti Ranjan Patra was the cinematographer and Rashmi Ranjan Dash the editor. Gaurav Mohanty, Srishti Das Mahapatra, Sushil Mishra and Pushpanjali Sadangi were also in the cast.
Abhijit Majumdar and D. Ashesh composed the music. Srikant Gautam and Bapu Goswami were among the lyricists, and Anurag Das, Bishnumohan Kabi, Nishad Mishra and Sanju Mohanty sang the songs.
The film was released in cinemas on 10 July 2026.

Q109519705.lead: Pihu is a 2021 Odia-language film directed by Chinmaya Mishra and produced by Gungun, starring Siddhanta Mahapatra and Anu Choudhury.

p: The film was the first production of Gungun Films, the company set up by the presenter and actress Gungun. Mamata Nanda and Amit Kumar Dash wrote the story, and Dash co-wrote the screenplay with the director. Biswabhusan Mahapatra and Satyama shot the film, and Ranjan Khatei edited it. Prasiddhi Nayak played the title role of Pihu, with Manoj Mishra, Saloni and Sumanta Dash in other parts.
Goodly Rath composed the music, and Surya Mahapatra wrote the lyrics. Goodly Rath and Lipsa Mahapatra were among the singers.
Pihu premiered on Manjari TV on Father's Day, 20 June 2021.

Q47034692.lead: Aa Janhare Lekhiba Naa is a 2009 Odia-language film directed by Sushant Mani, with Anubhav Mohanty and Gitanjali in the lead roles.

p: Biranchi Narayan Panda produced the film. Ashirbad Pattnaik wrote the story and shared screenplay credit with Sushant Mani, who also edited the film. Bharadwaj Panda wrote the dialogue and Subhranshu was the cinematographer. Aparajita Mohanty, Jharana Das, Manoj Mishra, Jayiram Samal, Papun, Arosmita, Akanksha, Bibhudatta, Prakash and Suman played supporting roles.
Sarat Nayak composed the music. Bapu Goswami, Bijay Malla and Debidutta Mohanty were among the lyricists, and Kumar Bapi, Arabinda Dutta, Tapu Mishra, Sarat Nayak and Pami sang the songs.

Q141122116.lead: Khara – The Heat is a 2024 Sambalpuri-language Odia film directed by Jugal Sahu and produced by Manasi Panigrahi, starring Jagadananda Churia, Srikara Mishra, Gadadhar Barik and Sushila Nair.

p: Pankaj Jal wrote the story and composed the music, and Chudamani Chandan wrote the dialogue. Santosh Sahu was the cinematographer and Sunil Meher the editor. The large supporting cast included Ashok Behera, Lalit Pujari, Sabhya Deep, Sailendri Barik, Padmaja Bohidar, Sarbeswar Bhoi, Ellora Tanti, Himat Sagar, Srikant Sadangi, Asmita Mishra, Sakambari Bari and Adhayan Barik.
The film was released in cinemas on 19 January 2024.

Q140379971.lead: Chhi Re Nani is a 2025 Odia-language film written and directed by Sushant Mani, with Sailendra Samantray and Sivani Sangita in the lead roles.

p: Sitaram Agrawal and Namita Agrawal produced the film. Sushant Mani wrote the story and co-wrote the dialogue with Hiren Kumar. Kuhu Malla was the cinematographer and Rajesh Dash the editor. Dipanwit Dashmohapatra, Choudhury Jayprakash Das, Dharitri Khandual, Adyasha Das, Bhakti Ranjan Das, Kunal Mandal, Sumanta Mani and Smita Mohanty appeared in other roles.
Satya Adhikari composed the music and wrote the lyrics. Humane Sagar, Kuldeep Pattnaik, R. S. Kumar, Asima Panda and Arpita Choudhury were among the singers.
The film reached cinemas on 1 August 2025.

Q140738931.lead: Besahara is a 2025 Odia-language television film written and directed by Niranjan Behera, with Jyoti Ranjan Nayak and Supriya Nayak in the lead roles.

p: Pradipta Prakash Acharya produced the film, and Niranjan Behera wrote its story, screenplay and dialogue. Pintu Nanda, Pradyumna Lenka, Debu Brahma, Papi Santuka, Pratibha Panda, Aiswarya Behera, Biju Badajena and Bighnesh were in the supporting cast.

Abhijit Majumdar composed the music, with lyrics by Nirmal Nayak and Pushpak Parida among others. Swayam Padhi, Kriti Panigrahi, Amrita Nayak, Rukh Sona, Tariq Aziz and Bishnumohan Kabi were among the singers.
The film was broadcast on Alankar TV on 8 February 2025.

Q139601767.lead: Chakranta is a 2026 Odia-language film directed by Pinu Nayak and produced by Sourav Padhi, with Subhasis Sharma and Bhoomika Dash in the lead roles.

p: Disha Padhi wrote the story, Pinu Nayak the screenplay and Jitendra Baral the dialogue. Sudarshan Senapati was the cinematographer and Rajesh Dash the editor. Choudhury Jayprakash Das, Pradyumna Lenka, Asrumochan Mohanty, Subham Padhi, Dharitri Khandual and Harihara Mohapatra were in the supporting cast.
Abhijit Majumdar composed the music and Nirmal Nayak wrote the lyrics. Antara Chakraborty, Swayam Padhi and Satyajit Pradhan were among the singers.
The film was released in cinemas on 27 February 2026.

Q139908448.lead: Memshab is a 2026 Odia-language film directed by Biswa Bhusan Mohapatra and Kali Prasad Mishra, starring Priya Chaudhury, Sambhav Mansingh, Chittaranjan Tripathy and Choudhury Jayprakash Das.

p: Kali Prasad Mishra produced the film as well as co-directing it. Amit Kumar Dash wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue. K. Sunil and Manoj Patra were the cinematographers, and Rashmi Ranjan Dash and Biswaranjan Subudhi edited the film. Satya Prakash Jena, Bhaolina Barua, Dipan and Biswabhusan were also in the cast.
Abhijit Tripathy and Bunny Mohanty composed the music, and Sabyasachi Pradhan wrote the lyrics. Humane Sagar and Ananya Sritam Nanda were among the singers.
The film was released in cinemas on 22 May 2026.

Q109519716.lead: Tandav is a 2021 Odia-language film directed by Pruthwiraj Patnaik and produced by Sandeep Sahu, with Debasish Pati, Anisha Sharma and Chandrani Das in the lead roles.

p: Red Saga wrote the dialogue and shared the screenplay with Pruthwiraj Patnaik. Siddhanta Mahapatra served as narrator. Rabindra Behera was the cinematographer and Manas Kumar Sahu the editor. Mihir Das, Manoj Mishra, Pushpa Panda and Sambhav played supporting parts, and Zina Samal appeared in an item dance.

Agniraj Kishore composed the music, with lyrics by Prabin Kumar and Rakesh Dash. The singers included Humane Sagar, Bishnumohan Kabi, Lipsa Mahapatra, Antara Chakraborty, Nandita Bhanja and Tariq Aziz.
Tandav opened in cinemas on 11 March 2021 and was shown on Manjari TV on 11 April 2021.

Q28819012.lead: Chaka Akhi Sau Dekhuchhi is an Odia-language film written and directed by Raju Misra and produced by Amiya Ranjan Patnaik, starring Uttam Mohanty, Aparajita Mohanty, Sriram Panda and Sujata Anand.

p: Raju Misra wrote the story and screenplay and was also the cinematographer, while Subodh Patnaik wrote the dialogue and Deben Mishra edited the film. Bijay Mohanty, Asrumochan Mohanty, Raimohan Parida, Asit Pati, Hara Patnaik, Jayiram Samal, Sripada and Dukhiram Swain were also in the cast.
Akshaya Mohanty composed the music. Debdas Chhotray and Sirshananda Das Kanungo were among the lyricists, and Kavita Krishnamurthy and Akshaya Mohanty sang.
The film was released in 1987.

Q110557496.lead: Bhija Matira Swarga is an Odia-language film directed by Manmohan Mahapatra and produced by Akshaya Kumar Parija, starring Mihir Das, Gargi Mohanty and Bijayini Mohanty. It was released on the streaming platform Kanchalanka.

p: Nandalal Mahapatra wrote the story and dialogue, and Ashutosh Mahapatra wrote the screenplay. Dillip Ray was the cinematographer and Sashibhusan Mahapatra the editor. Mahesh Bhol and Pritiranjan Das played supporting roles.
Kishalaya Ray composed the music.
The film was released on Kanchalanka on 13 January 2022.
At the 30th Odisha State Film Awards it won Best Film, along with awards for best actor, best director, best photography, best screenplay and best dialogue.

facts: Odisha State Film Award for Best Film (30th)

Q56682918.lead: Rakhiba Jadi Se Maariba Kie is a 2004 Odia-language film directed by Ritesh Nayak and produced by Ratikanta Kanungo, starring Siddhanta Mahapatra and Anu Choudhury.

p: The film includes scenes about the divine power of snakes.

Suchismita Kanungo wrote the story, and Subodh Patnaik wrote the screenplay and dialogue. Ritesh Nayak was also the cinematographer, and Chandrasekhar Mishra edited the film. Mihir Das, Debu Bose, Uttam Mohanty, Bina Moharana, Pintu Nanda, Dipti Panda, Deepak Parida, Jayiram Samal, Upasana Singh and Sadashiv Amrapurkar were in the supporting cast.
Abhijit Majumdar composed the music, with lyrics by Nizam and Sirshananda Das Kanungo among others.

Q141462179.lead: Kemiti Kahibi Mu is a 2024 Odia-language film directed by Pinu Nayak and produced by Debapriya Senanayak, with Sapnil Mishra and Suman Pattnaik in the lead roles.

p: Sarika Swain wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue, and Akshay Nayak was the cinematographer. Sumanta Das, Subhransu Nayak, Baby Pradhan, Dharitri Khandual, Kailash Panigrahi, Umakanta Muduli, Swapna Puhan, Mantu Behera, Tapu and Gaurav were in the supporting cast.
Abhijit Majumdar composed the music and Nirmal Nayak wrote the lyrics. Antara Chakraborty, Tariq Aziz, Amrita Nayak and Arabinda Dutta were among the singers.
The film premiered on Sarthak TV on 14 April 2024.

Q140015965.lead: Nanda Masternka Chatasali is a 2025 Odia-language documentary film directed by Pranab Aich and produced by Abhay Pati, about Nanda Kishore Prusty, who also appears in it.

p: The film draws on the life of Nanda Kishore Prusty, a 104-year-old man who for more than 70 years taught children free of charge at his village school, or chatasali. His teaching work earned him the Padma Shri.
Asmita Pati prepared the outline of the story. Pranab Aich handled the cinematography and editing in addition to directing. Saishrestha Das, Nityasha Pattnaik and Rabindra Rout also appear.
Bibhuti Bhusan Gadanayak composed the music.
The film was shown at the 77th Cannes Film Festival. It opened in cinemas on 12 December 2025 and was also released in Hindi.

Q57901328.lead: Premi Diwana is a 2018 Odia-language romantic film directed by Anand Kumar and produced by Ayaskant Mohanty, with Rudra Panigrahi and Solanki Bhowmik in the lead roles.

p: James Shukla wrote the story and dialogue, and Anand Kumar wrote the screenplay. Dhiren Sahu shot and edited the film. Guddu, Pritiraj Satapathy, Prithwiraj Nayak, R.K., Nalini, Kunmun, Anjana Das and Mahesh Rao were in the supporting cast.

Sarat Chandra Pradhan and Pinaki P. Srichandan composed the music. Arun Mantri, Panchanan Nayak and Ashutosh Barik were among the lyricists, and Sangram Mohanty, Sasmita Biswal, Pankaj Jal, Humane Sagar, Antara Chakraborty and Sasank Sekhar were among the singers.
The film was released on 21 September 2018.

Q115786314.lead: Bichha Gang is a 2022 Odia-language television film written, produced and directed by Sanjay Nayak, with Dipak Barik and Arlin Ankita in the lead roles.

p: Sanjay Nayak wrote the story and dialogue, and Debidutta Mohanty wrote the screenplay. S. Ranjan was the cinematographer and Ranjan Khatei the editor. Pintu Nanda, Pushpa Panda, Pradeep Debata, Krishna Kar, Kali, Deb, Choudhury Jayprakash Das, Biju Badajena and Sonam Swain played supporting roles.
Baidyanath Dash composed the music, and Sanjay Nayak also wrote the songs. Satyajit Pradhan and Neha Niharika Kar were among the singers.
The film was released on Tarang TV and Tarang Plus on 20 November 2022.

Q47090846.lead: Bachelor is a 2013 Odia-language film directed by Mrutyunjay Sahu and produced by Mitali Madhumita, with Akhila Pattnaik and Utkantha Padhi in the lead roles.

p: Ananga Manjari Pattnaik wrote the story and Nirmal Nayak the dialogue. Mrutyunjay Sahu wrote the screenplay and was also the cinematographer. Bijay Mohanty, Pintu Nanda, Tandra Ray, Minaketan, Harihara Mahapatra, Jiban Panda, Bibhuti Tripathy, Mili, Debi, Eklavya and Tulu were also in the cast.
Prem Anand composed the music. Arun Mantri, Basantaraj Samal, Nirmal Nayak and Bapi were among the lyricists, and Bibhu Kishore sang.
The film was released on 20 September 2013.

Q114804726.lead: Mahisasura is a 2022 Odia-language film directed by Mrutyunjay Sahu and produced by Ajay Rout, with Archita Sahu in the lead role.

p: Debidutta Mohanty wrote the story and screenplay, and B. Chandan Kumar wrote the dialogue. Ishwar was the cinematographer and Ranjan Khatei the editor. Babi Mishra, Biranchi Narayan Nayak, Parag Pattnaik, Anjana Das, Raja D. and Rakesh were also in the cast.
Abhijit Majumdar composed the music, Debidutta Mohanty wrote the lyrics and Tariq Aziz sang.
The film was released on the streaming service Tarang Plus on 5 October 2022 and broadcast on television on 9 October 2022.

Q5521763.lead: Gapa Hele Bi Sata is a 1976 Odia-language film directed by Nagen Ray, starring Harish Mohapatra and Banaja Mohanty. It was the first Odia film made entirely in colour.

p: Subimal Chandra Mallick produced the film on a budget of ₹8 lakh. Basant Mohapatra wrote the story and P. D. Shenoy the screenplay. Surendra Kumar Sahoo was the cinematographer, Nikhil Baran Sengupta the art director and Jagrit Kamble the editor. The cast also included Niharika Sahu, Durlabh, Suresh Mohapatra, Netrananda, Sudharani Jena and Soudamini.
Bhubaneswar Mishra and Hariprasad Chaurasia composed the music under the joint credit Bhuban-Hari.
The film was released on 16 July 1976.

Q18127183.lead: Lekhu Lekhu Lekhideli is a 2014 Odia-language film directed by Sushant Mani and produced by Sitaram Agrawal, with Babushaan and Jhillik Bhattacharya in the lead roles.

p: Siddharth Agrawal wrote the story, Sushant Mani the screenplay and Srikant Gautam the dialogue. Sitanshu Mahapatra was the cinematographer. Babushaan played Ajay and Jhillik Bhattacharya played Amrita. Priyanka Mahapatra and Satyaki Mishra played Amrita's parents, Aparajita Mohanty and Prithiraj Nayak Ajay's parents, Mahasweta Ray the grandmother, Harihara Mahapatra a bus conductor and Ankita Bhowmick Indu. Sivani Sangita appeared as a child artist.
Bikash Das composed the music, and Srikant Gautam wrote the lyrics.
The film was released on 29 August 2014.

Q109519699.lead: To Pain Feribi Basudha Chiri is a 2021 Odia-language television film written and directed by Sanjay Nayak, with Chandan Kar and Namrata Singh Deo in the lead roles.

p: Sarat Priya Patjoshi and Shyamsundar Agrawal produced the film, and Sanjay Nayak wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue. Pradeep Sahu was the cinematographer and Ranjan Khatei the editor. Sritam Das, Dusmanta Panda, Saroj Das, Premanjan Parida and Biju Badajena were in the supporting cast.
Malay Mishra composed the music, with lyrics by Nirmal Nayak and Arun Mantri among others. Ira Mohanty, Humane Sagar, Chandan Kar and Swayam Padhi were among the singers.
The film premiered on Manjari TV on 29 August 2021.

Q56260321.lead: Apna Hath Jagannath is a 2015 Odia-language film produced and directed by Satyam Jha Suman, with Rudra Panigrahi and Upasana Mohanty in the lead roles. It was released in both Odia and Bhojpuri.

p: Sumit Jha Suman wrote the story. Santosh Mishra wrote the dialogue and shared screenplay credit with the director. Ajit Das was the cinematographer. The film marked Upasana Mohanty's debut in Odia cinema. Debu Bose, Saroj Das, Amar Mahapatra, Rabi Mishra, Pushpa Panda, Nilamani Sahu, Jina Samal and Bhai Thakur were in the supporting cast.
Swarup Nayak composed the music and also wrote the songs.
The film was released on 17 September 2015.

Q55566170.lead: Chakadola Karuchi Leela is an Odia-language film written and directed by Hara Patnaik and produced by Amiya Ranjan Patnaik, starring Uttam Mohanty, Aparajita Mohanty, Bijay Mohanty and Sujata Anand.

p: Hara Patnaik wrote the story and screenplay and also acted in the film, while Sirshananda Das Kanungo wrote the dialogue. Samba Siva Rao was the cinematographer and Deben Mishra the editor. Mihir Das, Debu Bose, Jayiram Samal, Anuradha, Rekha Jain, Braja Singh, Disco Shanti and Dukhiram Swain were also in the cast.
Akshaya Mohanty composed the music. Sirshananda Das Kanungo and Akshaya Mohanty were among the lyricists, and Anuradha Paudwal and Akshaya Mohanty among the singers.
The film was released in 1990.

Q50220554.lead: I Love My India is a 2006 Odia-language film written and directed by Sangram Biswal and produced by Bibhuti Routray, with Buddhaditya Mohanty and Namrata Thapa in the lead roles.

p: Sangram Biswal wrote the story and screenplay, and Bijay Mishra wrote the dialogue. Samba Siva Rao was the cinematographer and Chandrasekhar Mishra the editor. The film was Buddhaditya Mohanty's entry into Odia cinema. Akshaya Bastia, Debu Bose, Mihir Das, Debjani, Aparajita Mohanty, Bijay Mohanty, Uttam Mohanty, Pintu Nanda and Jayiram Samal were in the supporting cast.
Prem Anand composed the music and Bijay Malla wrote the lyrics. Kumar Bapi and Ira Mohanty were among the singers.

Q110441083.lead: Tike Love Tike Twist is a 2020 Odia-language television film directed by S. K. Muralidharan, with Sambit Acharya and Poonam Mishra in the lead roles.

p: Samaresh Routray, Sambit Acharya and Durga Kinkar Dash produced the film, and Rajani Ranjan wrote the dialogue. R. Bhagat Singh was the cinematographer and Manas Kumar Sahu the editor. Mihir Das, Priyanka Mahapatra, Samaresh Routray and Choudhury Jayprakash Das also appeared.
Prem Anand composed the music and Basantaraj Samal wrote the lyrics. Humane Sagar, Diptirekha Padhi, Lopamudra, Ashutosh and Sanskruti Sharma were among the singers.
The film premiered on Manjari TV on 27 December 2020.

Q141109278.lead: Ei Ama Prema Kahani is a 2024 Odia-language film directed by Rabindra Pradhan, starring Abhishek Rath, Chulbuli Choudhary, Sritam Das, Mihir Das, Asrumochan Mohanty and Shakti Baral.

p: Srikant Gautam, Uday Shankar Sethi and Sanjay Kumar Rout produced the film. Srikant Gautam wrote the screenplay and dialogue and shared story credit with Rabindra Pradhan, who also served as cinematographer and editor. The film runs 168 minutes.
Chandan Kumar composed the music and Srikant Gautam wrote the lyrics. Humane Sagar and Asima Panda were among the singers.
The film was released in cinemas on 19 January 2024.

Q114804701.lead: Dil Re Achhi Tori Naan is a 2022 Odia-language film directed by Tripati Sahu and produced by Ramesh Barik, starring Sambit Acharya, Anuradha Panigrahi and Priyanka Panigrahi.

p: Rajani Ranjan wrote the story and dialogue, and Tripati Sahu wrote the screenplay. Dhrubananda Panda was the cinematographer and Chandra Sekhar Mishra the editor. Pradyumna Lenka, Jiban Panda, Guddu and Tapi were in the supporting cast.
Abhijit Majumdar composed the music and Nirmal Nayak wrote the lyrics. Humane Sagar, Amrita Nayak, Antara Chakraborty, Satyajit Pradhan, Jagruti Mishra and Anuradha Panigrahi were among the singers.
The film was released on 15 July 2022.

Q110628080.lead: Anguru na Milile Khata is a 2020 Odia-language television film directed by Ashwini Gadanayak and produced by Debasish Patra, who also starred in it opposite Ankita Mohanty.

p: Debasish Patra wrote the screenplay and Rajani Ranjan the dialogue. Chandra Sekhar Mishra edited the film. Pupinder Singh, Pintu Nanda, Pradyumna Lenka, Jiban Panda, Rajib Mohanty and Geet Jain were in the supporting cast.
Sarat Nayak composed the music, with lyrics by Bijay Malla and Sarat Nayak among others. Sasank Sekhar, Antara Chakraborty, Sangram and Sarat Nayak were among the singers.
The film premiered on Zee Sarthak on 30 August 2020.

Q140449998.lead: Parbatipurara Pabanasuta is a 2025 Odia-language film directed by Mrutyunjay Sahu and produced by Ajay Kumar Rout, with Sapnil Mishra and Manasi Pal in the lead roles.

p: Priyabrata Panda wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue. Sudarshan Senapati was the cinematographer and Pintu Nayak the editor. Ratan Meher, KD, Badal Mohanty, Dharitri Khandual, Debu Brahma, Preeti, Neer, Natia and Prashant were in the supporting cast.

Biraja Prasad composed the music. Debidutta Mohanty, Nirmal Nayak and Umakanta Nayak wrote the lyrics, and Antara Chakraborty, Sourav Bharadwaj, Satyajit Pradhan, Kaushik and S. Jitu were among the singers.
The film was released on Tarang Plus and Tarang TV on 15 June 2025.

Q140164275.lead: Kabita Banita Lata 2 is a 2025 Odia-language film directed by Mrutyunjay Sahu and produced by Subhalaxmi Pattnaik, with Simran, Hiteisha and Sulagna in the title roles.

p: Priyabrata Panda and Manas Mallick wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue. Sarbeswar Dash was the cinematographer and Pintu Nayak the editor. Simran played Kabita, Hiteisha played Banita and Sulagna played Lata. Tushar, Chandan, Pradyumna Lenka, Pratibha Panda, Prateechi and Debu Brahma were in the supporting cast, and Lovereen Khanam made a guest appearance.
Deepak Kumar composed the music, with lyrics by Bibhuti Swain and Debidutta Mohanty. Antara Chakraborty, S. Jitu, Diptirekha Padhi and Tariq Aziz were among the singers.
The film was released on Tarang TV and Tarang Plus on 12 October 2025.

Q119889710.lead: To Pain Pheribi Rahila Rana is a 2023 Odia-language television film produced and directed by Sanjay Nayak, with Lipsa Mishra and Bikram Mohanty in the lead roles.

p: Dillip Das wrote the story, Debidutta Mohanty the screenplay and B. Chandan Kumar the dialogue. S. K. Arif was the cinematographer and Pintu Nayak the editor. Anshuman, Dibyasha, Usasi Misra and Shakti Baral played supporting roles.
Baidyanath Dash composed the music, with lyrics by Nirmal Nayak and Debidutta Mohanty among others. Neha Niharika Kar, Satyajit Pradhan, Humane Sagar and Sital Kabi were among the singers.
The film was released on Tarang TV and Tarang Plus on 18 June 2023.

Q141550184.lead: Tike Tike Achihna Tu is a 2024 Odia-language film directed by Tapas Sargharia, with Swaraj Barik and Bhoomika Dash in the lead roles.

p: Nabin Bhandari and Deepak Mishra produced the film, and Bharadwaj Panda wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue. Subrat K. Khatoi was the cinematographer and Rajesh Dash the editor. Subham Nayak, Krishna Kar, Pradyumna Lenka, Choudhury Bikash Das, Soma Bhowmick, Priyanka and Deepak Mishra were in the supporting cast.

Prem Anand composed the music, and he and Arun Mantri were among the lyricists. Sabisesh Mishra, Diptirekha Padhi, Humane Sagar, Ashutosh Mohanty, Swaraj Barik and Sohini Mishra were among the singers.
The film opened in cinemas on 7 June 2024.

Q109519717.lead: Bisarjan is a 2021 Odia-language television film directed by Ramakrushna Padhi and produced by actress Sradha Panigrahi, who also starred in it with Subhasis Sharma.

p: Sradha Panigrahi wrote the story, and Chinmay Das Pattnaik wrote the screenplay and dialogue. Akshaya Kumar Nayak was the cinematographer and Manas Kumar Sahu the editor. Lawrence Behera, Aniket, Sudam, Manas, Babu, Situl and Simon were in the supporting cast.
Asad Nizam composed the music and Tapu Nayak wrote the lyrics. Asima Panda, Kuljit Pattnaik and Kumar were among the singers.
The film premiered on Manjari TV on 7 March 2021, timed to International Women's Day.

Q56612695.lead: Subarna Sita is a 1983 Odia-language film directed by Sisir Mishra and produced by Prabhat Mishra, starring Sriram Panda and Tripura Mishra.

p: Bin Mahapatra wrote the story and Somnath Pal the dialogue, while Sisir Mishra wrote the screenplay and also acted. Ashok Swain was the cinematographer and Samaresh Bose the editor. The cast also included Subhra Pati, Pira Mishra, Jayiram Samal, Gloria Mohanty, Hara Patnaik, Mamina, Krushnaprabha, Pradipta Mishra, Raju Sadhangi and Meera Mohanty.
Sribatsa Pattnaik composed the music. Gurukrushna Goswami and Narayan Prasad Singh wrote the lyrics, and Chitta Jena, Sushree Sangita and Bhubaneswari Mishra were among the singers.

Q114804730.lead: Alpa Dinara Galpa is a 2022 Odia-language television film directed by Ashok Pati and produced by Ajay Rout, with Jyoti Ranjan Panda and Sayal Banerjee in the lead roles.

p: Bharadwaj Panda wrote the story and dialogue, and Subham Nanda was the cinematographer. Ratan Meher, Mamuni Panda, Dharitri Khandual, Pragya Khatua, Subas, Manas, Swagatika and Papu were in the supporting cast.
Asad Nizam composed the music and Pushpak Parida wrote the lyrics. Satyajit Pradhan, Asima Panda, Ashutosh and Kuldeep Pattnaik were among the singers. The soundtrack was released on 12 October 2022.
The film premiered on Zee Sarthak on 16 October 2022.

Q55465655.lead: Champion is a 2019 Odia-language film directed by K. Muralikrishna, with Archita Sahu in the lead role as a village girl who becomes a kickboxer.

p: Archita Sahu plays the daughter of a farmer from a village. She later moves to the city to pursue her ambitions and goes on to win honours as a kickboxer at the international level.

The film was produced by N. Gangadhar Reddy and Dipti, and Rajani Ranjan wrote its dialogue. Archita Sahu appeared in four different looks in the film. She took special training in boxing for the role and posted photographs of her regular workouts on her social media page. The supporting cast included Manoj Mishra, Prithviraj Nayak, Salil Mitra, Sudhanshu Narayan Dash and Pritiraj Satapathy.
Baidyanath Das composed the film's music.

Q65504755.lead: Abhiman is a 2019 Odia-language film directed by Mrutyunjay Sahu and starring Sabyasachi Mishra and Archita Sahu.

p: Sitaram Agrawal and Namita Agrawal produced the film, and Nirmal Nayak wrote the dialogue. Bibhuti Bhusan Biswal handled the cinematography and Rajesh Das the editing. Alongside the two leads, the cast featured Harihara Mohapatra, Pradyumna Lenka, Krishna Kar, Jiban Panda, Chhandita Padhi, Rabi Mishra and Namrata Das.

Bikash Das composed the music. The lyrics were written by Bijay Malla, Nirmal Nayak and Arun Mantri, and the songs were sung by Human Sagar, Nibedita, Swayam Padhi, Mantu Chhuria, Asima Panda, Sourin Bhatt and Diptirekha Padhi, among others.
The film opened in cinemas on 4 July 2019, the day of that year's Rath Yatra.

facts: Bijay Malla, Nirmal Nayak, Arun Mantri

Q47087801.lead: Dhanare Rakhibu Sapatha Mora is a 2008 Odia-language film directed by Sanjay Nayak, with Anubhav Mohanty and Archita Sahu in the lead roles.

p: The film was produced by Sarada Prasanna Panda, Ranjan Palli and Prashant Martha. Sarada Prasanna Panda also wrote the story, while Sanjay Nayak wrote the screenplay in addition to directing. S. Ranjan was the cinematographer and Shiba Prasad Mohanty the editor. The supporting cast included Mihir Das, Aparajita Mohanty, Priyanka Mahapatra, Ajit Das, Jayiram Samal, Prayas, Saroj Das and Debu Brahma.
Shantiraj Khosla composed the music, with lyrics by Bijay Malla, Arun Mantri and Nirmal Nayak. Abhijit and Nibedita Basu were among the playback singers.
The film was released in January 2008.

Q139588067.lead: Kanda Mastre is a 2026 Odia-language film produced and directed by Biswajit Panda, starring Bibhu Prasad and Lipsa Mishra.

p: Biswajit Panda produced and directed the film and shared the writing of the story and screenplay with Zakir Khan, who also wrote the dialogue. S. Prasad Bubu was the cinematographer, and the editing was done by Krutartha Chittaranjan and Tapan Kumar Behera. The cast also included Pruthviraj Nayak, Swetashree Padhy, Dharitri Khandual and Sar Apa.
The music was composed by Bikash Das and Shantanu Nayak. Bapu Goswami and Santosh Nayak were among the lyricists, and Gopinath Panigrahi and Shantanu Nayak among the singers.
Before its theatrical run, the film was screened on 14 February 2026 at the third edition of the Salanda Sahitya Sangam in Bhadrak. It opened in cinemas on 6 March 2026.

Q109519684.lead: Mr. Romeo is a 2021 Odia-language film directed by Ashwini Garnayak and produced by Pradyumna Lenka, with Dipak Barik and Lipika Senapati in the lead roles.

p: Rajani Ranjan wrote the dialogue. Dillip Das was the cinematographer and Ranjan Khatei the editor. Dipak Barik played Surya and Lipika Senapati played Nandini; the supporting cast included Pritiraj Satpathy as Rudra, Pintu Nanda as Raja, Harihara Mohapatra as Padanna, Choudhury Jayprakash Das as Kali and Pratibha Panda as Mita, with producer Pradyumna Lenka also appearing.
Prem Anand composed the music and Basantaraj Samal wrote the songs. Sashank Sekhar, Diptirekha Padhi, Pragyan Hota and Biswajit Mahapatra were among the singers.
The film premiered on 7 November 2021 on the Odia television channel Zee Sarthak.

Q29385945.lead: Akhi Kholile Tu Tu Hi Tu is a 2017 Odia-language film directed by Saroj Mahapatra and produced by Sanjay Kumar Choudhury, starring Dipak Barik, Suryamayee Mohapatra and Namrata Singh Deo.

p: The writing is credited to Amaresh, with the screenplay by Saroj. Dhrubananda Panda shot the film and Sukumar Mani edited it. Mihir Das, Bijay Mohanty, Aparajita Mohanty, Minaketan, Pradyumna Lenka, Yogesh and Liya appeared in supporting roles.
Bikash Das composed the score and Bapu Goswami wrote the lyrics. The playback singers included Udit Narayan, Vinod Rathod, Pamela Jain and Antara Chakraborty.
The film was released on 17 March 2017.

Q109519708.lead: Indrajal is a 2021 Odia-language film directed by Pinu Nayak, starring Sambit Acharya and Debjani, which premiered on television.

p: Ramesh Barik produced the film. Pinu Nayak wrote the screenplay as well as directing, and Rajani Ranjan wrote the dialogue. Ranjan Khatei edited the film. The ensemble included Bishal Kotin, Hara Rath, Tapi Mishra, Satyaki Mishra, Binod Parida, Pradyumna Lenka, Sujit Paikaray, Munmun, Bandana, Rajalaxmi, Manas, Kamal and Prithviraj.
Abhijit Majumdar composed the music and Nirmal Nayak wrote the lyrics. The songs were sung by Human Sagar, Tariq Aziz, Satyajit Pradhan, Subham Padhi and Antara Chakraborty, among others.
The film was released on television on 2 May 2021.

Q110441093.lead: Golmaal is a 2020 Odia-language film directed by Ashwini Garnayak, starring Siddhanta Mahapatra and Anisha Sharma, which premiered on television.

p: Kedar Chandra Rout produced the film and Nirmal Nayak wrote the dialogue. Dhrubananda Panda handled the camera and Chandrasekhar Mishra the editing. The cast also featured Chittaranjan Tripathy, Babi Mishra, Pruthviraj Nayak, Aparajita Mohanty, Pragyan Khatua, Pradyumna Lenka, Braja Singh and Pinky Pradhan.
Prem Anand composed the music and Basantaraj Samal wrote the songs, which were sung by Human Sagar and Diptirekha Padhi, among others.
The film premiered on the television channel Zee Sarthak on 8 March 2020.

Q109519724.lead: Paapa is a 2021 Odia-language film directed by Ashok Pati and starring Elina Samantray, which premiered on television.

p: Kabir Das produced the film. Ashok Pati wrote the screenplay and directed, while Sanjay Mahakul and B. Chandan Kumar wrote the dialogue. Somio was the cinematographer and Ranjan Khatei the editor. Ankit Kumar Dalbehera, Pinky Pradhan, Asrumochan Mohanty, Abhishek, Raja D., Piyali, Kunal, Choudhury Jayprakash Das, Nupur and Biju Badajena appeared in supporting roles.
The music was composed by Prem Anand, with lyrics by Saroj Pattnaik. Human Sagar and Diptirekha Padhi were among the singers.
The film was first shown on 10 January 2021 on the television channels Tarang TV and Tarang Plus.

Q140186203.lead: Challenge is a 2025 Odia-language film directed by Sai Kiran Mangaraj, starring Ardhendu Sahu and Elina Samantray.

p: Adikanda Sahu produced the film, and Manas Padhiari wrote both its story and screenplay. Pratap Rout was the cinematographer and Biswajit Patel the editor. Puneet Issar, Lipi Mohapatra, Babi Mishra, Pupinder Singh, Bibhash and Rabi Mishra were also in the cast.

Gaurav Anand and Arjun Anup composed the music. Arjun Anup, Bapu Goswami and Ranjan Nayak were among the lyricists, and the singers included Asima Panda, Arjun Anup, Mr. Gulua, Pralu, Gaurav Anand, Humane Sagar and Ananya Sritam Nanda.
The film opened in cinemas on 26 September 2025.

Q56490055.lead: Pua Mora Jagata Jita is a 2002 Odia-language film produced, written and directed by Sanak Devata, starring Siddhanta Mahapatra, Anu Choudhury and Bijay Mohanty.

p: Sanak Devata wrote the story in addition to producing and directing, and the dialogue was written by Dillip Choudhury and Subodh Pattnaik. Siddhanta Mahapatra, who played one of the leads, also served as an executive producer. Jugal Debata was the cinematographer and Rabi Shankar Pattnaik the editor.

The large cast included Raimohan Parida, Minaketan, Aparajita Mohanty, Asrumochan Mohanty, Hara Pattnaik, Pushpa Panda, Uttam Mohanty, Jayiram Samal, Braja Singh, Saroj Das, Dillip Sadhangi, Subhendu and Jolly.
Akshaya Mohanty composed the music, and Debdas Chhotray and Nizam were among the lyricists.
The film was released on 5 May 2002.

Q140045707.lead: Namaste Kamala Mago 3 is an Odia-language film directed by Amaresh Pati and produced by Ajay Kumar Rout, starring Cookies Swain, Sasmita Piyali Sahoo and Raj Rajesh Panda.

p: The story was written by Monalisa Mohanty, while B. Chandan Kumar wrote the screenplay and dialogue. Sarbeswar Das was the cinematographer and Pintu Nayak the editor. Pruthviraj Nayak, Tribhuban Panda, Dipak Ranjan Das, Payal Jena and Diana Behura appeared in other roles.
Baidyanath Das and Bhairab Prusti composed the music, with songs written by Surya Mishra and Debidatta Mohanty. Sohini Mishra, Human Sagar and Bishnumohan Kabi were among the singers.
The film's release date is given as 30 November 2025.

Q44128992.lead: Mu Kana Ete Kharap is a 2010 Odia-language film directed by Basant Sahu and produced by Madanlal Agrawal, with Anubhav Mohanty and Arpita Mukherjee in the lead roles.

p: Basant Sahu wrote the screenplay as well as directing. The supporting cast included Mihir Das, Bijay Mohanty, Minaketan Das, Satyaki Mishra, Munna Khan, Suman, Harihara Mohapatra, Jiban Panda, Pintu Nanda, Ankita Bhowmick and Subhransu Nayak.

Omprakash Mohanty composed the music. The lyricists included Debdas Chhotray, Arun Mantri, Nirmal Nayak and Nizam, and the songs were sung by Sricharan, Subash Das, Susmita Das, Pamela Jain, Namrata Mohanty, Udit Narayan and Sailabhama, among others.
The film was released on 9 April 2010.

Q45837387.lead: Om Namah Shivay is an Odia-language film released in November 2010, directed by Rabindra Pradhan from his own story and screenplay. Bablu plays the lead, and Rali Nanda appears in a double role.

p: The film was produced by Giridhari Mallick. Besides directing and devising the story and screenplay, Pradhan is credited as editor; Nirmal Nayak supplied the dialogue. The supporting cast included Bijay Mohanty, Anita Das, Hara Patnaik, Minaketan, Chakradhar Jena, Ratan Meher, Salil Mitra, Nilamani Sahu, Santu and Saheb Singh.
Abhijit Majumdar was the music director and one of the playback singers, together with Tapu Mishra and Udit Narayan. Songs were written by lyricists including Arun Mantri, Nirmal Nayak and Nizam.
It opened on 19 November 2010.

Q24555174.lead: Premare Premare is a 2016 Odia-language romantic film directed by Sudhanshu Mohan Sahu and produced by Sitaram Agrawal, starring Arindam Roy and Sheetal Patra.

p: Ranjit Pattnaik wrote the screenplay. Besides the two leads, the cast included Harihara Mohapatra, Mihir Das, Aparajita Mohanty, Pradyumna Lenka, Satyaki Mishra, Chandini Jena, Anjana and Emily in supporting parts.
Bikash Das was the music director, and the songs were written by Bapu Goswami and Mohit Chakraborty. Sourin Bhatt, R. S. Kumar, Nibedita and Lalit Dibya were among the singers.
The film came out on 12 June 2016, during the Raja festival.

Q41234209.lead: Khaas Tumari Paain is a 2014 Odia-language film produced and directed by Sushanta Rath, starring Dushmanta Panda, Debjani and Pinki Priyadarsini.

p: Chinmay Das Pattnaik wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue, and Rajesh Das edited the film. George Tiadi, Debu Bose, Debu Brahma, Debi Barik and Mamali were in the supporting cast.
Bidyut Roy composed the music. Manoj Mahanta, Nirmal Nayak and Panchanan Nayak were among the lyricists, and the songs were sung by Pami, Tapu Mishra and Goutam Giri, among others.
The film was released on 27 February 2014.

Q55274172.lead: Naga Panchami is an Odia-language film from the early 1990s directed by Vijay Bhaskar and produced by Rabindra Sahu, starring Bijay Mohanty, Mahasweta Ray and Mihir Das.

p: Rabindra Sahu wrote the story as well as producing, Bijay Mishra wrote the dialogue, and Vijay Bhaskar wrote the screenplay and directed. B. Satish was the cinematographer and Anil Malnad the editor. The cast also included Raimohan Parida, Asrumochan Mohanty, Jayiram Samal, Mamina, Bina Maharana, Sasmita Pradhan, Keshab, Ganesh, Ramakanta, Rangadhar, Rosy and Kabita.
Prafulla Kar composed the music, with Rabindra Sahu and Prafulla Kar among the lyricists. K. S. Chithra, Trupti Das, Gita Das and Mahaprasad Kar were among the playback singers.

Q55447699.lead: Aemiti Bhai Jagate Nahin is a 1994 Odia-language film written, directed and scored by Prashanta Nanda, who also starred in it; it was produced by Annapurna Nanda.

p: Prashanta Nanda handled the story, screenplay and dialogue, directed the film and acted in it. V. Prabhakar was the cinematographer and Ashok Sharma the editor. The cast also featured Uttam Mohanty, Aparajita Mohanty, Raimohan Parida, Hara Pattnaik, Suresh Bal, Srikant Gautam, Shankar Basu Mallick, Pruthviraj Nayak, Satabdi Roy, Pratibha Sahu, Jayiram Samal and Purnachandra Pratihari.
Prashanta Nanda composed the music and wrote the songs. The singers included Gita Das, Subash Das, Anit Goswami, Kavita Krishnamurthy, Jolly Mukherjee and Mohammed Sajid.
The film was released on 6 January 1994.

Q44525811.lead: Bhul Bujhibani Mate is a 2010 Odia-language film directed by Kunal Pattnaik, with Debasish Patra, Priyanka and Amelie Panda in the lead roles.

p: Alaya Mohanty and Rachita Sadangi produced the film, and Alaya Mohanty also wrote the story. Kunal Pattnaik wrote the screenplay and directed, and Dr. Rajani Ranjan wrote the dialogue. Satya Pattnaik was the cinematographer and Rabi Shankar Pattnaik the editor. Mihir Das, Aparajita Mohanty, Ajit Das, Raicharan Das, Abhay Mohanty, Pintu Nanda, Kashi Rath, Samaresh Routray and Guman Singh played supporting roles.
Prasant Padhi composed the music. Kumar Bapi, Tapu Mishra, Krishna Beura and Bibhu Kishore were among the singers.
The film was released on 9 July 2010.

Q50825286.lead: Ashok Samrat is a 2013 Odia-language film directed by Jyoti Das, starring Arindam Roy and Emili Chowdhury.

p: The film was produced by Annapurna Parida and Amaresh Parida. Abinash Parida wrote the story and Ranjit Pattnaik the dialogue, while Jyoti Das wrote the screenplay and directed. Jagan Chabali was the cinematographer and Chandrasekhar Mishra the editor. Mahasweta Ray, Harihara Mohapatra, Priyanka Mahapatra, Minaketan, Manoj Mishra, Pintu Nanda, Jiban Panda, Jayiram Samal and Papi Santuka were also in the cast.
Abhijit Majumdar composed the music, and the songs were written by Nizam and Nirmal Nayak.
The film was released on 11 June 2013.

Q24039549.lead: Mo Suna Pua is a 2007 Odia-language film written and directed by Jyotiprakash Das, starring Samaresh Routray and Jyoti Mishra.

p: Gyan Pattnaik produced the film. Jyotiprakash Das wrote the story and screenplay, and Bijay Mishra wrote the dialogue. The film marked Samaresh Routray's first acting role in Odia cinema. Mahasweta Ray, Bijay Mohanty, Snigdha Mohanty, Akshaya Bastia, Saroj Das, Jayiram Samal, Saroj Satapathy and George Tiadi were also in the cast. Dilip Ray was the cinematographer and Deben Mishra the editor.
Abhijit Majumdar composed the music and Nizam wrote the lyrics. The singers included Abhijit Majumdar, Tapu Mishra, Pami, Manas Pritam, Arabinda Sadangi and Lulu.

Q21282990.lead: Bad Girl is a 2012 Odia-language film written and directed by Jay Prakash Mohanty and produced by Prabhat Kumar Pradhan, with Lipi Parida in the title role.

p: Jay Prakash Mohanty wrote the story and screenplay, and Bijay Malla wrote the dialogue. The cinematography was shared by Ranjan Mishra, Dhrubananda Panda and Rabindra Sethi, and Ajay Mishra edited the film, which runs 162 minutes.

Lipi Parida played Paripurna Pattnaik, the 'bad girl' of the title. Sambit Acharya appeared as Pritam, Babli as Pragalbha, Dipan as Abishkar, Mihir Das as Aditya Choudhury, Aparajita Mohanty as Suman Choudhury and Bijay Mohanty as Payodhar Pattnaik. Harihara Mohapatra, Salil Mitra, Minaketan, Bobby Pradhan, Jyotsnamayee Khuntia, Gourav, Bhaskar Pradhan and Ranjan completed the cast.
Sarat Nayak was the music director.
The film was released on 7 September 2012.

Q114804733.lead: Tu Mora OK is a 2022 Odia-language film directed by Mrutyunjay Sahu and produced by Sitaram Agrawal, starring Jyoti Ranjan Nayak and Sheetal Patra.

p: Nirmal Nayak wrote the dialogue. Iswar Barik was the cinematographer and Rajesh Das the editor. Usasi Mishra, Pintu Nanda, Pratibha Panda, Premanjan Parida, Pragyan Khatua, Sar Apa and Aishwarya appeared in supporting roles.
Asad Nizam composed the music and Arun Mantri wrote the songs. Human Sagar, Asima Panda and Shreya Mishra sang for the film.
Ahead of its release, Hindi film actor Amitabh Bachchan posted about the film on Twitter. It reached cinemas on 21 October 2022.
