Q140323541.lead: Aliali Rajajema is a 2025 Odia-language television film directed by Amaresh Pati and produced by Sanjeev Dwivedi, starring Sandeep Mishra and Cookies Swain.

p: B. Chandan Kumar wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue. Sarbeswar Das was the cinematographer and Pintu Nayak the editor. Pruthviraj Nayak, Alaka Satapathy, Bhabesh, Payal, Pihu and Rajalaxmi also appeared.

Baidyanath Dash composed the music, with lyrics by Nihar Priyadarshi and Debidatta Mohanty, among others. Chiragdeep Panda, Arpita Choudhury, Tariq Aziz, Sthiti Subhakankhyee and Pragyan Hota were among the singers.
The film premiered on television on 24 August 2025, on Tarang TV and Tarang Plus.

Q114804722.lead: Titli is a 2022 Odia-language film written and directed by S. K. Muralidharan, starring Tushar K. Sinha and Dibyasanta Mohanty.

p: Prabhat Kumar Pradhan and Sisir Chandra Das produced the film. S. K. Muralidharan wrote the story and directed, and Debidatta Mohanty wrote the screenplay and dialogue. Bhagat Singh was the cinematographer and Chandrasekhar Mishra the editor. Mihir Das, Pritiraj Satpathy, Pratibha Panda, Jiban Panda, Hadu and Nupur were also in the cast.
Prem Anand composed the music and co-wrote the songs with Basantaraj Samal.
The film was released during Durga Puja, on 30 September 2022.

facts: Prabhat Kumar Pradhan, Sisir Chandra Das

Q50377209.lead: Nari Akhire Nian is a 2003 Odia-language film written and directed by Sanjay Nayak, with Anu Choudhury, Mama Mishra and Meghna Mishra in the lead roles.

p: Namita Das and Sasmita Samal produced the film, and Sanjay Nayak wrote the story as well as directing. Ranjan was the cinematographer and Biswanath Rao the editor. The cast also included Mamuni Mishra, Siddhanta Mahapatra, Mihir Das, Debu Bose, Braja Singh, Minaketan, Babi Mishra, Uttam Mohanty, Aparajita Mohanty, Jayiram Samal, Kuna Tripathy, Dipa Sahu and Mithi.

Malay Mishra composed the music. The songs were written by Basantaraj Samal, Arun Mantri, Malay Mishra and Nizam, among others, and sung by Pankaj Jal, Selu Mohanty, Shakti Mishra, Ira Mohanty and T. Souri, among others.

Q29869260.lead: Tume Hi Sathi Mora is a 2009 Odia-language film directed by Surendra Mohanty, starring Arindam Roy, Dushmanta Panda and Anu Choudhury.

p: The producers were Suresh Bharlawala, Bijay Khandelwal and Ramesh Verma. Surendra Mohanty both directed and edited the film, and Abhiram Mishra was the cinematographer. Hemanta Das, Mihir Das, Raicharan Das, Aparajita Mohanty, Asrumochan Mohanty and Smita Mohanty were in the supporting cast.

The music was composed by Shantanu Mahapatra, Saroj Pattnaik and Basudeba Rath. Antarjami Mishra, Surendra Mohanty, Nizam, Banabihari Panda and Saroj Pattnaik were among the lyricists, and Kumar Bapi, Bijay Jena, Madhab, Siddharth Mishra and Sailabhama Mahapatra among the singers.
The film was released on 6 November 2009.

facts: Shantanu Mahapatra, Saroj Pattnaik, Basudeba Rath

Q109519413.lead: Chakhyubandhan is a 2021 film directed by Rajendra Mahant, released in Odia and Bengali, starring Bhoomika Dash, Raj Rajesh Panda, Isani Sengupta and Rishi.

p: Tapan Kumar Das produced the film, and Dillip Kumar Choudhury wrote the story. Dipak Kumar was the cinematographer and Manas Kumar Sahu the editor. Dillip Choudhury, Prashant Patra, Tilottama, Dillip Balabantaray, Bini Chatterjee, Sai Prakash and Kamalakanta also appeared.
Abhijit Majumdar composed the music, with songs written by Nirmal Nayak and Rajani Satapathy. Biswajit Mahapatra, Ratikant Satapathy and Sohini Mishra were among the singers.
The film was released on 10 September 2021 in both Odia and Bengali.

Q69118669.lead: Mr Majnu is a 2019 Odia-language film directed by Ashok Pati and produced by Jagi Mangat Panda, starring Babushaan Mohanty opposite three heroines: Sheetal Patra, Divya Mohanty and Suryamayee Mohapatra.

p: Ashok Pati wrote the screenplay and directed. Nirmal Nayak wrote the dialogue as well as songs. The film's muhurat (launch ceremony) took place on 14 August 2019. R. Bhagat Singh was the cinematographer and Sukumar Mani the editor. Mihir Das, Raimohan Parida, Tribhuban Panda and Jojo appeared in supporting roles.
Abhijit Majumdar composed the music, and the lyrics were written by Nirmal Nayak and Bapu Goswami.
The film's release date is given as 4 October 2019.

Q109519719.lead: Super Boy is a 2021 Odia-language film written and directed by K. Anish, starring Jyoti Ranjan Nayak and Tamanna Vyas.

p: Ajay Kumar Rout produced the film. K. Anish wrote the screenplay and shared the story credit with Bijayalaxmi Parida, while Dipak Jena wrote the dialogue. Mahi was the cinematographer and Chandrasekhar Mishra the editor. Subhasis Sharma, Pintu Nanda, Priyanka and Namita Das were also in the cast.

Baidyanath Dash composed the music. Nirmal Nayak, Arun Mantri and Dipak Jena wrote the songs, which were sung by Human Sagar, Diptirekha Padhi, Swayam Padhi, Asima Panda, Satyajit Pradhan, Arpita and Baidyanath Dash, among others.
The film was released on 12 February 2021.

Q38149668.lead: Flashback is a 2015 Odia-language film co-directed by Subhashree Tripathy and Nishikant Dalabehera, with Kiran Jaipuria in the lead role.

p: Ratikant Dalabehera produced the film. Subhashree Tripathy wrote the story and dialogue, and Nishikant Dalabehera wrote the screenplay; the two shared the direction. Anupam Panda, Priya Ranjan Mohanty, Gitimaya Nanda, Jayashree Dhal and Shreya Samiksha made up the rest of the cast.
Nishikant Dalabehera composed the music and Subhashree Tripathy wrote the songs. Both also sang, alongside Abhijit Mishra and Sagar Tripathy.
The film was released on 11 December 2015.

Q56410930.lead: Excuse Me is a 2018 Odia-language film directed by Umesh Das and produced by Ronak Das, who also starred in it opposite Megha Mohanty.

p: Sanjay Mahakul wrote the story and dialogue, and the director wrote the screenplay. Lubun Tubun and Amit choreographed the dances. Mallikarjun was the cinematographer and Soumya Sobhan Nayak the editor. The supporting cast included Mihir Das, Anita Das, Salil Mitra, Saroj Das, Bina Maharana, Dhir Mallick, Baishali, Kalia, Rabi Mishra, Tonia, Bhabani Prasad, Arpan and Sharmistha.
Sarat Nayak composed the music. Debidatta Mohanty and Sanjay Mahakul were among the lyricists, and Subrat and Asima Panda among the singers.
The film was released on 20 July 2018.

Q56556343.lead: Pratidhwani is a 1984 Odia-language film written and directed by P. C. Das, based on a story by Bishnupriya Devi.

p: P. C. Das co-produced the film with Debendra Panda, and wrote its screenplay and dialogue. Debi Das was the cinematographer and V. Rajagopal the editor. The cast included Ajit Das, Jaya B., Sujata Anand, Hemanta Das, Netrananda Mishra, Ramachandra Pratihari, Narendra Kumar Behera, Jayiram Samal, Soudamini, Sachi Panda, George Tiadi, Gita, Niranjan and Meera Mohanty.
Upendra Kumar composed the music. Shibabrata Das and Binodini Devi were among the lyricists, and H. P. Geetha, Vani Jairam and Pranab Pattnaik among the singers.

Q109519723.lead: Romeo Raja is a 2021 Odia-language film written and directed by Rakesh Samal, starring Amlan Das and Tamanna Vyas.

p: Sushanta Panda produced the film. Rakesh Samal wrote the story and screenplay, and James Shukla wrote the dialogue. E. Prasad was the cinematographer and Rajesh Das the editor. Harihara Mohapatra, Dipak, Saroj Kumar, Sarathi Devi, Gyan, Tapan, Silu and Babu Pradhan were also in the cast.
Baidyanath Dash composed the music. The lyricists included Arun Mantri, Panchanan Nayak, Subrat Swain and Subodh Das, and Human Sagar, Asima Panda and Gitishree Saroj were among the singers.
The film opened on 22 January 2021 at Brundaban Hall.

Q140685547.lead: Mo Mummy Papanka Bahaghara 2 is a 2025 Odia-language film directed by Amaresh Pati and produced by Ajay Kumar Rout, released on television and streaming.

p: Amaresh Pati wrote the story and worked on the screenplay and dialogue with B. Chandan Kumar. Sarbeswar Das was the cinematographer and Pintu Nayak the editor. The cast included Sweety Patnaik, Hiranmayee Das, Srijit Mahapatra, Sukanta Rath, Subhransu Nayak, Prabhati and Debu Brahma.
Sushil Dalai composed the music and wrote songs along with Pushpak Parida. Antara Chakraborty, Lopamudra, Mantu Chhuria and Smita were among the singers.
The film premiered on 2 March 2025 on Tarang TV and Tarang Plus.

Q140472443.lead: Bhabantara is a 2025 Odia-language film directed by Anant Mahapatra, starring Abhishek Giri, Suryamayee Mohapatra and Saroj Nanda.

p: The story was written by Ajay Mahapatra, and Anant Mahapatra and Dillip Choudhury wrote the screenplay and dialogue. Satyajit Pradhan edited the film. Besides the leads, the cast included Binayak Mishra, Anant Mahapatra, Mamata Mohanty, Mrutyunjay Panda, Rabi Tripathy, Sabita Sahu, Priya Bisoyi, Pradipta Swain and Uma Saha.
Shakti Mishra composed the music, Debdas Chhotray wrote the songs, and Susmita Das sang them.
The film opened in cinemas on 30 May 2025.

Q43225895.lead: Mu Diwana To Pain is a 2013 Odia-language film directed by Manoranjan Pal, starring Aditya Singh (Bulu) in the lead role.

p: Debendranath Sahu produced the film and wrote the story. Manoranjan Pal wrote the screenplay and directed, while Manoranjan Sahani wrote the dialogue. Sanjay Pradhan was the cinematographer and Chandrasekhar Mishra the editor.
Aditya Singh played Prem. Minaketan appeared as police sub-inspector Nilachal, Manisha Mishra as Pramila, Jyoti Pani as Puja and Jyoti Tripathy as Smita.

Agniraj composed the music. Arun Mantri, Bibhuprasad Mishra, Goutam Rout and Manoranjan Sahani were among the lyricists, and the singers included Kumar Bapi, Antara Chakraborty, Pankaj Jal, Udit Narayan and Sangram.
The film was released on 2 August 2013.

Q109519693.lead: Sastha Ru Nashta is a 2021 Odia-language film directed by Murali Krishna, starring Ardhendu Sahu and Tamanna Vyas, which premiered on television.

p: Surya Rath produced the film. Murali Krishna wrote the screenplay and directed, and Dipak Kumar wrote the dialogue. Pratap Rout was the cinematographer and Ranjan Khatei the editor.

Ardhendu Sahu played Aditya Balabantaray and Tamanna Vyas played Nandini. Shakti Baral appeared as a club owner and Jiban Panda as a paan-shop keeper; Mahasweta Ray, Ilu Banerjee, Ratan Meher, Jojo, Pintu Nanda, Pradyumna Lenka, Sujit Paikaray, Bhabani Prasad and Rakhi Das were also in the cast.
Gudli Rath composed the music and Surya Mahapatra wrote the lyrics. Udit Narayan, Asima Panda and Lipsa Mahapatra were among the singers.
The film premiered on Zee Sarthak on 10 October 2021.

Q50858190.lead: Oh My Love is a 2005 Odia-language film written and directed by Sanjay Nayak, starring Rajdeep and Archita Sahu, and marking Archita Sahu's entry into Odia cinema.

p: Prabhansu Samantaray produced the film, and Sanjay Nayak wrote both the story and screenplay. Ranjan was the cinematographer and Biswanath Rao the editor. Pintu Nanda, Harihara Mohapatra, Kuna Tripathy, Bijay Mohanty, Premanjan Parida, Tandra Ray, Gloria Mohanty, Prakruti Mishra and Bhupati Tripathy appeared in other roles.
Malay Mishra composed the music. Basantaraj Samal, Bijay Malla and Arun Mantri were among the lyricists, and Bibhu Kishore, Tapu Mishra, Ira Mohanty and Sailabhama Mahapatra among the singers.

Q109519720.lead: Tu Bhari Beautiful is a 2021 Odia-language film directed by Sanjay Nayak, starring Jyoti Ranjan Nayak, Lipsa Mishra and Archita Mohanty, which premiered on television.

p: Soumya Ranjan Patnaik produced the film, and Sanjay Nayak wrote the screenplay and directed. Kuna Tripathy, Pushpa Panda, Jiban Panda, Somesh Mohanty, Premanjan Parida, Suresh Bal and Biju Badajena were in the supporting cast.
Malay Mishra composed the music and wrote songs together with Subash Mishra. Human Sagar, Ira Mohanty, Asima Panda, Ashutosh, Aroshish and Neha Niharika were among the singers.
The film premiered on Manjari TV on 31 January 2021.

Q54931979.lead: Dharma Debata is a 2001 Odia-language film directed by Vijay Bhaskar and produced by D. Rama Naidu, starring Siddhanta Mahapatra, Usasi Mishra, Mihir Das and Bijay Mohanty.

p: Vijay Bhaskar and Suresh Krishna wrote the story, and Subodh Pattnaik wrote the dialogue. K. V. Suresh was the cinematographer and Krishna Reddy the editor. The cast also included Tandra Ray, Rekha Jain, Suresh Bal, Namrata Das, Sritam Das, Raimohan Parida, Runu Parija, Hara Patnaik, Jayiram Samal and Braja Singh.
Amarendra Mohanty composed the music. Nizam and Sirshananda Das Kanungo were among the lyricists, and the playback singers included Sonali Bajpai, Sonu Nigam and Sadhana Sargam.

Q60181577.lead: Tu Mo Sweet 16 is a 2018 Odia-language film produced, written and directed by Sambit Kumar, who also played the lead opposite Sonali.

p: Sambit Kumar was responsible for the story, screenplay and dialogue as well as producing, directing and acting. Niranjan Das was the cinematographer and Pintu Nayak the editor. The large supporting cast included Rabi Mishra, Guddu, Tonia, Saswat, Priyanka, Gudia, Amar, Pintu, Sanjay, Manas, Romeo, Kalia, Dushmanta Panda, Rajashree Acharya and Kajal Mishra.

Ganesh Prasad composed the music. Rabindra Muduli, Jyoti Ranjan and M. Suranjan were among the lyricists, and Tariq Aziz, Sabisesh, Barnali Hota, Bishnumohan Kabi and Anuradha Panigrahi among the singers.
The film was released on 16 December 2018.

Q112145993.lead: Drustikona is a 2022 Odia-language film directed by Sushant Mani and produced by Akshaya Kumar Parija, starring Elina Samantray and Subhashree Nayak.

p: Akshaya Kumar Parija wrote the story as well as producing, and Sanjit Rath wrote the dialogue. Kuhu Malla was the cinematographer and Sukumar Mani the editor. Hara Rath, Ankit Kumar, Choudhury Bikash Das, Santosh Mahapatra and Saroj Parida were in the supporting cast, and the Odia fiction writer Haraprasad Das appeared as a judge.
Anup Selvan composed the music and Bijay Malla wrote the songs. Antara Chakraborty sang the title song.
The film was released on 27 May 2022 and was received favourably by critics.

Q56682935.lead: Rahichi Rahibi Tori Paain is a 2003 Odia-language film directed by Sanjay Nayak and produced by Prabhansu Samantaray, starring Siddhanta Mahapatra and Mama Mishra.

p: Prabhansu Samantaray is credited with the story in addition to producing, and Sanjay Nayak wrote the screenplay and directed. Ranjan Mishra was the cinematographer and Biswanath Rao the editor. Usasi Mishra, Bijay Mohanty, Namrata Das, Anita Das, Sritam Das, Pradyumna Lenka, Harihara Mohapatra, Suman Maharana, Salil Mitra, Jayiram Samal, Kuna Tripathy and Biju Badajena were also in the cast.
Malay Mishra and Prabhansu Samantaray composed the music, and Srikant Gautam wrote the songs.

Q141223085.lead: Love 420 is a 2024 Odia-language film directed by Mrutyunjay Sahu, starring Jyoti Ranjan Nayak and Sheetal Patra, which premiered on television.

p: Sachikanta Jena produced the film and wrote its story, while Rajani Ranjan wrote the screenplay and dialogue. R. Bhagat Singh was the cinematographer and Rajesh Das the editor. Babi Mishra, Pintu Nanda, Pradyumna Lenka, Elisa, Sunita, Amar, Hari and Hadu were also in the cast.
Abhijit Majumdar composed the music and Nirmal Nayak wrote the lyrics. The singers included Tariq Aziz, Swayam Padhi, Sohini Mishra, Antara Chakraborty, Rozalin and Abhijit Majumdar.
The film premiered on Alankar TV on 1 March 2024.

Q141192066.lead: Akashvani is a 2024 Odia-language film directed by Tripati Sahu and produced by Rohan Garg, who also appears in the cast.

p: Nirmal Nayak wrote the story and dialogue, while Tripati Sahu wrote the screenplay in addition to directing. The cast featured Rohan Garg, Purnima Baral, Jogesh Jojo, Roshan Bharadwaj and Priyanka Mahapatra, with Pradyumna Lenka, Prithviraj Nayak, Pratibha Panda and Namita Das in other roles.

Abhijit Majumdar composed the score. The songs were written by lyricists including Nirmal Nayak and Kuku Prabhas, and sung by Tariq Aziz, Abhijit Majumdar, Biswa Swarup, Antara Chakraborty, Swayam Padhi, Jyotirmayee and Indu Sonali, among others.
The film opened in cinemas on 16 February 2024.

Q53440528.lead: Suna Palinki is a 1998 Odia-language film directed by Surya Misra and produced by Sunil Rout.

p: Surya Misra wrote the screenplay and shared the story credit with Sujata Rout, and Subodh Pattnaik wrote the dialogue. Surya Pattnaik was the cinematographer and Rabi Shankar Pattnaik edited the film. The cast included Sagar Misra, Gayatri Jariwala, Asrumochan Mohanty, Debu Bose and Smita Mohanty, alongside Kajal, Snigdha Mohanty, Raimohan Parida, Runu Parija, Jayiram Samal, Braja Singh and Debu Brahma.
Subash Ram directed the music. Lyricists including Shirshananda Das Kanungo and Nizam wrote the songs, which were sung by Anuradha Paudwal and Subash Ram, among others.

Q15724405.lead: Nari Nuhen Tu Narayani is an Odia-language film directed by Himanshu Parija and produced by Bijay Kandoi, released in 2002.

p: Bijay Mishra wrote both the screenplay and the dialogue. Niranjan Das handled the cinematography and Chandra Sekhar Mishra the editing. The budget was ₹81.5 lakh. Rachna Banerjee, Siddhanta Mahapatra, Bijay Mohanty, Mihir Das and Debu Bose headed a large cast that also included Pradyumna Lenka, Satyaki Mishra, Runu Parija, Braja Singh, Dipti Panda, Hara Patnaik, Jayiram Samal and Niharika Sahu.
Swarup Nayak composed the music and also wrote the songs. The playback singers included Kumar Bapi, Prakash Dubey and Ira Mohanty.

Q50825294.lead: Mun is a 2012 Odia-language film directed by Nishikant Dalabehera, starring Suman and Nikita in the lead roles.

p: Narendra Sahu produced the film. Padmini Patra wrote the story, Deepak Jena the dialogue, and Nishikant Dalabehera the screenplay. Sushil was the cinematographer. Mihir Das, Romi, Rafi, Pragyan, Bina Mahapatra, Rabi Mishra, Choudhury Jayprakash Das and Devi Barik appeared in supporting roles.
Bibhuti Bhusan Gadanayak composed the music, and Panchanan Nayak wrote the lyrics. Vinod Rathod, Tapu Mishra, Manas Pritam, Amrita Panda, Tarannum Mallik and Rajesh were among the singers.
The film was released on 5 October 2012.

Q21403029.lead: Kie Deba Takkar is a 2015 Odia-language film written and directed by S.K. Muralidharan, with Pradeep Dutta and Patrali Chattopadhyay in the lead roles.

p: Bharat Gourab Das produced the film and also played the college principal. Muralidharan wrote the story and screenplay, and Nirmal Nayak wrote the dialogue. Bhagat Singh was the cinematographer and Sukumar Mani the editor.

Pradeep Dutta played Shiba and Patrali Chattopadhyay played Smruti. Sudhakar Basant appeared as Bhalu Yadav, Mihir Das as Banshidhar, Aparajita Mohanty as Uma and Siddhanta Mahapatra as Bhabani Paikaray, while Pradyumna Lenka and Namrata Das played Shiba's father and mother. Saroj Das, Hadu, Papi Santuka, Siraj, Bindu and Shakti Baral had other roles.
Abhijit Majumdar directed the music.
The film was released on 1 April 2015.

Q141066739.lead: Samaya Kahiba Kie Kahara is a 2024 Odia-language film written and directed by comedian Braja Singh, starring Amlan Das and Trupti Mirambika.

p: Prabhati Acharya and Ramesh Singh produced the film. Braja Singh wrote the story, and Sanjay Mahakud wrote the dialogue. Amlan Das, Trupti Mirambika, Braja Singh and Bijayini Mishra led the cast, with Sonam, Rabi Mishra, Jayaram Samal, Debu Brahma, Arabinda Sadhangi, Pragyan Khatua, Devi Barik and Ashok Mallick among the supporting players.
Shantiraj Khosla composed the music.
The film opened in cinemas on 5 January 2024.

Q15725144.lead: Rupa Gaan Ra Suna Kania is a 1998 Odia-language film directed by Raju Misra, who also composed its music and shot it.

p: Biswanath Mishra and Dilip Mishra produced the film, and Biswanath Mishra wrote the story. Raju Misra wrote the screenplay, and A. Sanjeev edited the film. The budget was ₹89.35 lakh. Uttam Mohanty, Siddhanta Mahapatra, Bijay Mohanty and Aparajita Mohanty led the cast, which also included Jayiram Samal, Rachna Banerjee, Geeta Dutta, Namrata Das, Raimohan Parida and Rajib Mohanty.

Raju Misra directed the music. The lyrics came from writers including Debdas Chhotray, Shirshananda Das Kanungo, Nizam and Nimai Mohanty, and the singers included Geeta Dash, Trupti Das, Amrutanshu, Raju Misra and Sourav.

Q56260739.lead: Sata Michha is a 2003 Odia-language film written and directed by Raju Misra and produced by Pramod Kumar Das.

p: Raju Misra wrote the story and screenplay and also served as cinematographer, while Shirshananda Das Kanungo wrote the dialogue. Ashok Sharma edited the film. Siddhanta Mahapatra, Saheli Mukherjee, Uttam Mohanty, Harihara Mohapatra, Aparajita Mohanty and Raimohan Parida appeared in the cast with Namrata Das, Hadu, Mamina, Kuni Mishra, Premanjan Parida, Sarat Pujari and Jayiram Samal.
Raju Misra composed the music, and Shirshananda Das Kanungo wrote the songs. Geeta Dash, Lopita Mishra, Sunil Parida and Sourav were among the singers.

Q33240396.lead: Mun Gandhi Nuhen is a 2016 Odia-language film produced, written and directed by Suraj Mishra, starring newcomers Krishna and Karan Singh Roy.

p: Suraj Mishra wrote the story as well as producing and directing. The two male leads, Krishna and Karan Singh Roy, were newcomers, as were the two heroines, Diksha and Bhabana Kar. Veteran actor Asrumochan Mohanty, Rabi Mishra and Jayiram Samal were also in the cast. Sanjay Pradhan was the cinematographer.
Pabitra Pattnaik composed the music and Prabir Kumar wrote the songs. The singers included Sailabhama, Sourav Nayak, Kumar Bapi, Tapu Mishra, Nazia Alam, Human Sagar and Nabhya.
The film was released on 29 July 2016.

Q47098638.lead: Shiva Not Out is a 2017 Odia-language film directed by Sudhanshu Mohan Sahu, starring Arindam Roy, who also produced it, and Archita Sahu.

p: Gopal Chandra Roy wrote the story and Bharadwaj Panda the dialogue, while Sudhanshu Mohan Sahu wrote the screenplay. Manoj Mishra and Pragyan Khatua were in the supporting cast. Dhrubananda Panda shot the film and Chandrasekhar Mishra edited it.
Prem Anand composed the songs, with lyrics by Subrat Swain. Dipti Rekha Padhi was among the singers.
The film opened on 27 September 2017, during the Durga Puja season.
Pradyumna Lenka received the best character actor award for his role in the film at the Pratibha Samman ceremony held by the film magazine Chalachitra Jagat.

Q50220630.lead: Guddu & Guddi is a 2018 Odia-language film written and directed by Subhashis Pati, starring Suryakant Samal, who also produced it, and Himika.

p: The film draws on the casting-couch issue in the Odia film industry. Its heroine falls victim to the casting couch and then meets the hero, and the two fall in love.

Subhashis Pati wrote the story and screenplay. Mihir Das, Salil Mitra, Mamuni Mishra, Kishore Khanduala, Subhranshu, Dushmanta Pati, Guddu and Raja played supporting roles. Dipankar was the cinematographer.
Situ and Sanjay composed the music. Lyricists Arun Mantri, Nirmal Nayak and Satyananda Nayak, among others, wrote the songs.
The film was certified U/A and released on 23 February 2018.

Q57268141.lead: Sati Anusuya is a 1978 Odia-language film directed by A. Sanjeev Rao and produced by G. P. Malya and Sriramulu.

p: A. Sanjeev Rao wrote the screenplay and edited the film as well as directing it, while Soubhagya Chandra Das wrote the dialogue. Babu Rao was the cinematographer. The cast included Chakrapani, Roja Ramani, Mahasweta Ray, Narendra Mishra, Rita Chand, Pira Mishra, Swarup Nayak, Sarat Pattnaik and Jyotsna Das. The film runs 132 minutes.
Prafulla Kar directed the music. Soubhagya Chandra Das, Prafulla Kar and Loknath Pattnaik were among the lyricists, and Subash Das, Vani Jairam, S. Janaki and Chitta Jena were among the singers.
The film was released on 30 August 1978.

Q43222137.lead: Parshuram is a 2012 Odia-language film directed by Sudhanshu Mohan Sahu, with Arindam Roy and Barsha Priyadarshini in the lead roles.

p: Sitaram Agrawal produced the film. Ranjit Pattnaik wrote the dialogue, and Sushant Mani wrote the screenplay and also edited the film. The supporting cast included Siddhanta Mahapatra, Pradyumna Lenka, Harihara Mohapatra, Ankita Bhowmick, Ajit Das, Saroj Das, Manas Mishra, Satyaki Mishra, Bijay Mohanty, Pintu Nanda, Prithviraj Nayak, Pinky Pradhan and Pritiraj Satpathy.
Manmath Mishra composed the music and Srikant Gautam wrote the songs.
The film was released on 21 October 2012.

Q139997199.lead: Miss Call Friend is a 2025 Odia-language film directed by Sudhanshu Mohan Sahu, starring Amlan Das, Riya Dey and Sheetal Patra.

p: Sitaram Agrawal and Namita Agrawal produced the film under the Siddharth Movies banner. Jamesh Shukla wrote the story, and Nirmal Nayak wrote the screenplay and dialogue. Amlan Das played Om, Riya Dey played Puja and Sheetal Patra played Bhakti, with Suresh Bal and Bhupati Tripathy in other roles. Niranjan Dash was the cinematographer and Rajesh Dash the editor. The film runs 132 minutes.
Baidyanath Dash composed the music and Arun Mantri wrote the lyrics. Human Sagar, Sriya Mishra, Jagruti Mishra, Gourav Anand and Neha Niharika Kar were among the singers.
The film opened in cinemas on 12 December 2025.

Q55665607.lead: Kandhei is a 1990 Odia-language film written, directed and scored by Prashanta Nanda, who also co-produced it and acted in it.

p: Prashanta Nanda produced the film with Abdul Sayed and wrote its story and screenplay. Jugal Debata and Madhukar S. Rao handled the cinematography, and Nanda edited the film with Bibek Satapathy. Sriram Panda, Prashanta Nanda, Uttam Mohanty, Mahasweta Ray, Gopa Biswas, Suresh Bal, Pratibha Sahu and Sulu Mohanty appeared in the cast, along with Premanjan Parida, Sangeeta Das, Sarbajit Mohanty, Byomkesh Tripathy and Abdul Sayed.
Prashanta Nanda composed the music and wrote the songs. The singers included Subash Das, Leena Ghosh, Jolly Mukherjee, Raghunath Pradhan and Anuradha Paudwal.

Q109519714.lead: Tume Mo Sankha Tume Mo Sindura is a 2021 Odia-language film written and directed by Ranjit Barik, starring Abhishek Rath, Ankita Das and Mahima Das.

p: Badrinath Pattnaik produced the film. Ranjit Barik wrote the story and screenplay, and Saroj Samal wrote the dialogue. Mihir Das, Pratibha Panda, Shibuni, Shakti Baral and Guddu were in the supporting cast. Ajit Kishore Das was the cinematographer and Deben Mishra the editor.
Abhijit Majumdar composed the music. Human Sagar, Swayam Padhi, Ira Mohanty and Rojalin were among the singers.
The film was released in 25 cinemas across Odisha on 1 April 2021.

Q110441086.lead: Prema Na Pagalapana is a 2020 Odia-language film directed by Ashwini Garnayak that premiered on television, with Akash Dasnayak and Lipsa Mishra in the lead roles.

p: Ajay Kumar Rout produced the film and wrote its story, while Ashwini Garnayak wrote the screenplay. Akash Dasnayak played Shiba and Lipsa Mishra played Rosy; Raimohan appeared as Bhanu Pratap and Biju Badajena as a police officer, with Kuna Tripathy, Chandan Mohanty, Guddu, Geeta Jain and Kuni Panda in other roles. Kahnu Charan Nanda shot the film and Rajesh Dash edited it.
Gudly Rath composed the music, and Surya Mahapatra wrote the songs. Satyajit Pradhan, Dipti Rekha Padhi and Lipsa Mahapatra were among the singers.
The film had its premiere on the Zee Sarthak channel on 18 October 2020.

Q4696993.lead: Aila Re Odia Pua is a 2009 Odia-language film directed by Choudhury Bikash Das and Biswajit Mohanty and produced by Pratap Jena.

p: Ranjan Misra wrote the story. Tanmay Mishra, Kajal Mishra, Jina Samal and Anshuman Samantaray played the leads, with Samaresh Routray, Mihir Das, Debu Brahma, Pratap Jena, Ajay Mishra, Aparajita Mohanty, Uttam Mohanty, Bhupati Tripathy and Somesh Mohanty in the supporting cast. Ajit Kumar Das was the cinematographer and Biswanath Rao the editor.
Bikash Das directed the music. Basantaraj Samal and Bijay Malla were among the lyricists, and Kumar Bapi, Sanghamitra Jena, Tapu Mishra and Debashish Mahapatra were among the singers.
The film was released in April 2009.

Q140702158.lead: Baji Lagichi Mo Sankha Sindura is a 2025 Odia-language film directed by Sanjay Nayak that premiered on television and streaming, starring Bikram Keshari Mohanty, Alok Mishra, Sulagna Nayak and Manaswini Pati.

p: Raja Nayak produced the film. Dillip Kumar Das wrote the story and Debidatta Mohanty the screenplay. Kedar Mishra, Rajashree, Kunal Pattnaik and Bijet Barik were also in the cast. Kahnu Nanda was the cinematographer and Arun Kumar Padhi the editor.
Baidyanath Dash composed the music, and Nirmal Nayak wrote the songs. Tariq Aziz, Asima Panda and Simran Das were among the singers.
The film premiered on Tarang TV and the Tarang Plus platform on 9 February 2025.

Q119889699.lead: Preeti Bandhan is a 2023 Odia-language film directed by Rasesh Mohanty, starring Sambit Acharya, Tamanna Vyas and Trupti.

p: Narendra Kumar Patra and Prashant Kumar Nayak produced the film. Abhijit Sinde wrote the story, Sunil Bapi the dialogue, and Rasesh Mohanty the screenplay. Prithviraj Nayak, Pushpa Panda, Bhupati Tripathy, Kedar Mishra, Thin, Alaka Satapathy, Prashant Nayak, Nupur Ghosh and Sasmita played supporting roles. Rabindra Behera was the cinematographer and Ambikesh Kunal Hota the editor.
Abhijit Majumdar composed the music.
The film opened in cinemas on 25 May 2023.

Q43379139.lead: Mo Dil Kahe Ilu Ilu is a 2015 Odia-language film written and directed by Loknath Barik and produced by Rabin Kumar Nanda.

p: Loknath Barik wrote the story and screenplay, and Chinmay Das Pattnaik wrote the dialogue. The cast included Akshay Bastia, Mihir Das, Aparajita Mohanty, Bijay Mohanty and Kuna Tripathy, along with Shruti Das Mahapatra, Bina Mahapatra, the producer Rabin Kumar Nanda and Deb Srichandan.
Agniraj Kishore composed the music and Arun Mantri wrote the songs, which were sung by Udit Narayan and Ira Mohanty, among others.
The film was released on 25 September 2015.

Q112652809.lead: KRAZZY - 4 is a 2022 Odia-language film directed by Samraj that premiered on television, with Abhishek Rath and Suryamayee Mohapatra in the lead roles.

p: J. Ranjan produced the film and Jitendra Kumar Baral wrote the dialogue. Abhishek Rath played Shiba and Suryamayee Mohapatra played Nandini, with Uttam Mohanty, Subhasis Sharma, Pragyan Khatua and Pintu Nanda in other roles. M. Ganesh was the cinematographer and Shankar the editor.

S. Chandrakant composed the music. The lyricists included Arun Mantri, N. Gurudatta and Nirmal Nayak, and the singers included Human Sagar, Asima Panda, Satyajit Pradhan, Sangram Mohanty, Amrita Nayak and Sanju Mohanty.
The film premiered on Manjari TV on 6 February 2022.

Q141658665.lead: Bohu Amara Matric Fail is a 2024 Odia-language television film directed by Mrutyunjay Sahu, starring Rakesh Deo and Nikita Mishra.

p: Sunil Pattnaik produced the film under the Somnath Shine Production banner, and Priyabrata wrote the story. Choudhury Jayprakash Das, Pushpa Panda, Ananta Mishra and Dharitri Khandual were in the supporting cast.

Baidyanath Dash composed the music, with lyrics by Nirmal Nayak and Umakant Nayak, among others. The singers included Human Sagar, Antara Chakraborty, Asima Panda, Satyajit Pradhan, Chiragdeep Panda and Sheetal Kabi.
The film was broadcast on television on 16 June 2024, distributed by Zee Sarthak.

Q119889692.lead: Priya Ra Pre-wedding Love Story is a 2023 Odia-language television film directed by Rajendra Mahant, starring Sambhav Mansingh, Ankit Kumar and Trupti Mirambika.

p: Sanjib Dwivedi produced the film, and Bharadwaj Panda wrote its story, screenplay and dialogue. Mahima Dash, Akash and Prasannajit appeared in supporting roles. Pradeep Nayak was the cinematographer and Pintu Nayak the editor.
Bibhuti Bhushan Gadanayak composed the music, and the songs were written by lyricists including Nirmal Nayak and Debidatta Mohanty.
The film premiered on Tarang TV and Tarang Plus on 30 April 2023.

Q141150243.lead: Shanti Apartment - Flat No. 203 is a 2024 Odia-language film written and directed by Ashwini Tripathy and produced by Bikram Shankar.

p: Ashwini Tripathy wrote the story and screenplay, and Deepak Jena wrote the dialogue. Ragini Sutradhar, Subhasis Sharma, Dipanwit Dashmohapatra and Shakti Baral headed the cast, which also included Santu Nije and Prasannajit Mahapatra. Pratap Rout was the cinematographer and Biswaranjan Subudhi the editor. The film runs 120 minutes.
Sandeep Panda composed the music and co-wrote the lyrics with Nirmal Nayak. The singers included Human Sagar, Arpita Choudhury, Ananya Sritam Nanda, Sandeep Panda and Swayam Padhi.
The film opened in cinemas on 2 February 2024.

Q56256206.lead: Kandhei Akhire Luha is a 2004 Odia-language film directed by Ravi Kinagi and produced by Prabhat Ranjan Pattnaik.

p: Shankar Kinagi wrote the story and Ravi Kinagi the screenplay. Siddhanta Mahapatra and Rachna Banerjee headed a cast that included Debu Bose, Raimohan Parida, Premanjan Parida, Jayiram Samal, Runu Parija, Namrata Das, Suresh Bal, Ashok and Swarup Nayak. Samba Siva Rao was the cinematographer and Biswanath Rao the editor.
Amarendra Mohanty directed the music. Shirshananda Das Kanungo and Nizam were among the lyricists, and Anupama Deshpande, Sonu Nigam and Anuradha Paudwal were among the singers.

Q114804704.lead: Bye Bye Dil is a 2022 Odia-language film written and directed by Kunal Pattnaik, with Raj, Pallavi and Sasha in the lead roles.

p: Jayalaxmi Mishra produced the film. Kunal Pattnaik wrote the story and screenplay and shared the dialogue credit with Subrat, and he also appeared on screen. The supporting cast included Pritiraj Satpathy, Jiban Panda, Ram Babu, Jayalaxmi, Shambhu, Ashish, Tulu and Bitu. Ranjan Mishra was the cinematographer and Debi Prasad Kar the editor.
Tuna and Una composed the music, with lyrics by Sachi Mohanty and Santosh, among others. Ananya Sritam Nanda, Kuldeep Pattnaik, Biswajit Mahapatra and Nabhya Jyoti were among the singers.
The film was released on 31 July 2022.

Q56683203.lead: Mathare Dei Pata Odhani is a 2011 Odia-language film directed by Ranjan Mishra, starring Nikita and Dipak Barik.

p: Anam Charan Sahu produced the film and also composed its music. Laxmipriya Sahu wrote the story and Santosh Mishra the dialogue, while Ranjan Mishra wrote the screenplay and was also the cinematographer. Sukumar Mani edited the film. Mihir Das, Pushpa Panda, George Tiadi, Pintu Nanda, Jiban Panda, Subhransu Nayak, Bhupati Tripathy, Shakti Baral, Bhabani Charan Rath, Amrita, Santosh Mishra, Tribhuban Panda and Chinmay appeared in supporting roles.
Anam Charan Sahu directed the music, and Basantaraj Samal and Arun Mantri wrote the songs.

Q141439366.lead: Bigul is a 2024 Odia-language film directed by Ajay Padhi and produced by Debananda Behera, who also heads its cast.

p: Ajay Padhi wrote the story, and Amit Kumar Dash wrote the screenplay and dialogue. Debananda Behera, Supriya Nayak, Sadashiv Nayak, Prasannajit Mahapatra, Chittaranjan Tripathy and Anubhav Mohanty were in the cast. Judhisthir Behera was the cinematographer and Rashmi Ranjan Dash the editor.

Suraj Purohit composed the music. J. P. Wordsmith, Mohit Chakraborty and Satyaranjan Bal were among the lyricists, and Antara Chakraborty, Manaswini, Anurag, Punam, Milan and Asit Tripathy were among the singers.
The film opened in cinemas on 29 March 2024.

Q29046195.lead: Kurukshetra is a 1988 Odia-language film produced and directed by Sriram Panda, who also played a lead role.

p: Bhagirathi Behera wrote the story and Bijay Mishra the dialogue, while Sriram Panda wrote the screenplay. Asit Padhi and Ashok Swain handled the cinematography, and Bibek Satapathy edited the film. Sriram Panda, Tripura Mishra, Baishali Parida, Debu Bose, Sujata Anand, Asrumochan Mohanty and Binayak Mishra headed the cast, with Debu Brahma, Bhupati Tripathy, Sekhar Dutta, Sulu Mohanty, Radha Panda, Premanjan Parida, Jayiram Samal, Smita and Dukhiram Swain in other roles.
Akshaya Mohanty composed the music.

Q28855781.lead: Diwana Heli To Pain is a 2018 Odia-language film directed by actor Sritam Das, starring newcomer Munna and Riya Dey.

p: Ashok Kumar Das produced the film, and Ranjit Pattnaik wrote the story and dialogue. Munna made his acting debut in the lead, Sritam Das played the villain, and Siddhanta Mahapatra had a supporting role. Usasi Misra, Papu Pom Pom, Debu Pattnaik, Pinky Pradhan, Braja Singh, Satyaki Mishra, Guddu, Amar and Bulu were also in the cast. Niranjan Das was the cinematographer.
Abhijit Majumdar composed the music.
The film was released on 13 April 2018.

Q98387262.lead: Paika Bidroha is a 2020 Odia-language short film about the Paika Rebellion in Odisha, directed by Nischay Rout and Anuj Tyagi.

p: The film depicts the Paika Rebellion in Odisha, focusing on the parts played by Bakshi Jagabandhu of Khordhagada and Jayi Rajguru.

Akshaya Parija produced the film, and Hara Prasad Dash wrote its story, screenplay and dialogue. Samaresh Routray played Bakshi Jagabandhu and Manoj Mishra played Jayi Rajguru. Shakti Baral appeared as Bhupa Singh, Priya Mishra as the Puri Panda, Gopal Biswal as Dala Behera and Sarat Samrat as Bahinipati, with Sundro Pulio and Lucio as British officers. Pratap Rout was the cinematographer and Archit Rastogi the editor. The film runs 27 minutes.
Dharma Bish composed the music.
The film was released on 14 August 2020.

Q139825891.lead: Tate Lagila Mo Sankha Sindura is a 2026 Odia-language film written and directed by Sanjay Nayak that premiered on television and streaming, starring Nikita, Tushar Chandan, Simran and Arpan Mishra.

p: Subhalaxmi Pattnaik produced the film under the Tarang Movies banner, and Sanjay Nayak wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue. Subhransu Nayak, Baby Pradhan, Himanshu, Bhakti, Chandan, Somya Abhishek, Santosh and Mamali had supporting roles. Sarbeswar Dash was the cinematographer and Tapas the editor.
Binayak Panda composed the music and Prakash Chandra Jena wrote the songs, which were produced under the Tarang Music banner.
The film premiered on Tarang TV and Tarang Plus on 17 May 2026.

Q15724958.lead: Mathura Bijaya is a 1979 Odia-language mythological film directed by A. Sanjeevi and produced by Babulal Doshi, with Srikant Gautam as Krishna.

p: A. Sanjeevi also edited the film, and K. S. Prasad and Babu Rao handled the cinematography. The budget was ₹18.25 lakh. Srikant Gautam played Krishna, Rupalekha played Radha, Sarat Pujari played Kansa, Pabana Kumar played Nanda and Anita Das played Yashoda. Mihir Das, Jaya Swami, Geeta Rao, Deepa Sahu, Jayiram Samal, Mamina, Rukmani, Tapas Dasgupta and Syamasundar Mohapatra were also in the cast.

Balakrushna Dash composed the music. Narayan Prasad Singh, Gour Pattnaik and Baikunthanath Mohanty were among the lyricists, and Bhikari Bal, Sekhar Ghosh, Vani Jairam and Geeta Pattnaik were among the singers.

Q41595275.lead: Gaddbadd is a 2013 Odia-language film written and directed by Subhasish Pati, who co-produced it with Ajit Sahu.

p: Subhasish Pati wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue. Siddhanta Mahapatra, Ashwini Brahma, Pritiraj Satpathy, Partha Sarathi Ray, Jina Samal, Ragini and Mousumi Nayak played the main roles, with Minaketan, Debu Bose, Namrata Das, Antaryami Panda, Pragyan Khatua and Bapi Ray in support. R. N. Swamy was the cinematographer.
Prem Anand composed the music. The lyricists included Debdas Chhotray, Basantaraj Samal and Arun Mantri.
The film was released on 26 November 2013.

Q112224840.lead: Premam is a 2022 Odia-language film directed by Tapas Sargharia, starring Babushaan Mohanty and Prakruti Mishra.

p: Sisir Kumar Sadangi produced the film. Tapas Sargharia wrote the story, and Bharadwaj Panda wrote the screenplay and dialogue. Siddhanta Mahapatra and Satyaki Misra were in the supporting cast. Subrat K. Khatoi was the cinematographer and Rajesh Dash the editor.
Gourav Anand composed the music and Bapu Goswami wrote the lyrics. Asima Panda, Babushaan, Kuldeep Pattnaik, Sohini Mishra and Arpita Choudhury were among the singers.
The film was released on 3 June 2022 and was also made available on Disney+ Hotstar.

Q110441085.lead: Durgatinashini is a 2020 Odia-language film written and directed by Raja Dash that premiered on television, with Archita Sahu in the lead role.

p: Akshaya Kumar Parija produced the film. Raja Dash wrote the story and screenplay, and Anshuman Dash and Kumarshree Sahu wrote the dialogue. Archita Sahu played Nitya Das; Partha Sarathi Ray, Jiban Panda, Soma Bhowmick, Choudhury Bikash Das and Rajib Mohanty were also in the cast. Pratap Chandra Rout was the cinematographer and Manas Kumar Sahu the editor.
Gudly Rath composed the music and Surya Mahapatra wrote the songs, which were sung by Gourav Anand and Lipsa Mahapatra.
The film premiered on Zee Sarthak on 15 November 2020.

Q122958187.lead: Michhei Jhia is a 2023 Odia-language film directed by Mrutyunjay Sahu that premiered on television and streaming, starring Jayjit Das and Tamanna Vyas.

p: Sachikanta Jena produced the film under the Tarang Cine Productions banner. Debidatta Mohanty and B. Chandan Kumar wrote the story and screenplay, and Jitendra Baral wrote the dialogue. Mamata Nanda, Rakhee Dash, Anjana Das, Rajesh Panda, Disco Reddy and Sukesh Panda played supporting roles. Soumya was the cinematographer and Rajesh Dash the editor.
Abhijit Majumdar composed the music, with lyrics by Nirmal Nayak and Umakant Nayak, among others.
The film was released on 1 October 2023.

Q28049652.lead: Sankha Sindura is a 1985 Odia-language film directed by Vijay Bhaskar and produced by Babula Mohanty.

p: Vijay Bhaskar wrote the story together with Jagannath Das and Subodh Pattnaik. Surendra Sahu was the cinematographer and Rabi Shankar Pattnaik the editor. The cast included Aparajita Mohanty, Bijay Mohanty, Sriram Panda, Sujata Anand, Narendra Kumar Behera, Hemant Das, Jayiram Samal, Asit Pati, Jaya Swami and Radha Panda.
Akshaya Mohanty composed the music, and Narayan Prasad Singh wrote the lyrics. Vani Jairam, Akshaya Mohanty and Anuradha Paudwal were among the singers.

Q132676485.lead: Bhai: The Opening Part is a 2025 Odia-language film directed by Prithviraj Pattnaik and produced by Nabin Bhandari, starring Amlan Das, Divya Mohanty, Sujit Paikaray and Ananya Mishra.

p: Rabinarayan Das wrote the story and dialogue, and Prithviraj Pattnaik wrote the screenplay. Bikash Gantara, Dibyajyoti Udaysingh and Aiman were in the supporting cast. Rudrakanta Singh was the cinematographer and Manas Kumar Sahu the editor.
Nabajyoti Panda and Saroj composed the music. Arun Mantri and Ranjan Nayak were among the lyricists, and Amrita Nayak and Kuldeep Pattnaik among the singers.
The film was released on 24 January 2025.

Q56046984.lead: 2014 Fear of the Year is a 2014 Odia-language ghost film co-directed by Pradeep Das and Tapas Jena and produced by Pradeep Kumar Era.

p: Pradeep Das and Tapas Jena wrote the story and screenplay together, and Bijay Raul wrote the dialogue. The cast included Sambit Acharya, Dushmanta Panda, Mousumi Nayak, Elli Padhi, K. K. Rakesh, Sneha, Muskan and Deepika Tripathy. Abhiram Mishra was the cinematographer and Rajesh Das the editor.
Shyam Prasan composed the music.
The film was released in Odia and Telugu on 11 July 2014.

Q110060367.lead: Bhoka is a 2021 Odia-language film directed by Rajeev Mohanty, starring Ankit Kumar and Kavya Keeran.

p: Sabyasachi Mahapatra produced the film through Jyoti Production. Ranjan Kumar Das wrote the story and dialogue, and Rajeev Mohanty wrote the screenplay. Kavya Keeran played Hema, and Kuna Tripathy, Pushpa Panda and Pratibha Panda were in the supporting cast. Biswajit Kuldi was the cinematographer and Manas Kumar Sahu the editor.
Bikash Das composed the music. Shiba Rath, Sashank Sekhar and Tapu Mishra were among the singers.
The film was released on 11 December 2021 at Esplanade in Bhubaneswar.

Q139503476.lead: Panga Neichhi Mun Jama Sathire is a 2026 Odia-language television film directed by T. Ganesh, starring Hiranmayee Das and Swastik Mohanty.

p: Ajay Samal wrote the story. Jiban Panda, Jyoti, Mili, Sreela, Illu Banerjee, Mandal Panda, Prajwal, Supriti, Tanushree and Purnendu Dutta were in the supporting cast. Priyaranjan Parija was the cinematographer and Biswajit Beura the editor.
Sarthak Agrawal composed the music and Arun Mantri wrote the songs. Arpita Choudhury, Ayushman Panda, Divya and Lipika Nath were among the singers.
The film premiered on television on 12 April 2026, distributed by Siddharth TV.

Q56378944.lead: Jai Sriram is a 2005 Odia-language film written and directed by Trupti Biswal and produced by Manas Behera.

p: Trupti Biswal wrote the story and screenplay, and Subodh Pattnaik wrote the dialogue. Abhiram Mishra, Amresh Swain and Sushant Bahinipati handled the cinematography, and Chandrasekhar Mishra edited the film. Babi Mishra, Usasi Misra, Bijay Mohanty, Raimohan Parida and Mihir Das headed the cast, which also included Monalisa, George Tiadi, Tandra Ray, Suresh Bal, Runu Parija, Harihara Mohapatra, Pintu Nanda, Soma Bhowmick, Saroj Das and Mili.
Amarendra Mohanty composed the music. Shirshananda Das Kanungo, Bijay Malla and Arun Mantri were among the lyricists.

Q109519690.lead: Durgatinashini 2 is a 2021 Odia-language film directed by Ashwini Tripathy that premiered on television, with Archita Sahu in the lead role. It followed Durgatinashini (2020).

p: Khirod Pattnaik produced the film, and Rajani Ranjan wrote the dialogue. Samaresh Routray, Smita Mohanty, Pintu Nanda, Pushpa Panda, Sujit Paikaray, Sukanta Rath, Illu Banerjee, Papi Santuka, Pritiraj Satpathy and Priyanka Panigrahi were in the supporting cast. Pratap Rout was the cinematographer and Manas Kumar Sahu the editor.
Gudly Rath composed the music.
The film premiered on Zee Sarthak on 17 October 2021.

Q119889701.lead: Sindura is a 2023 Odia-language feature film directed by Sailendra Parida and produced by Premanjana Parida.

p: Bhagyabati Nayak wrote the story and Bapu Goswami wrote the dialogue, while director Sailendra Parida prepared the screenplay himself. Subhasis Sharma, Suryamayee Mohapatra and Ankit Kumar played the lead roles, with Premanjana Parida, Leela, Lipi, Sasmita, Amar and Kalia Shandha in the supporting cast. Sudarshan Senapati was the cinematographer and Pintu Nayak the editor.
Baidyanath Dash composed the music.
A special screening was held on 29 May 2023 and was attended by guests including members of the film industry.

Q15724832.lead: Vidhata is a 2003 Odia-language feature film written and directed by Sangram Biswal and produced by Felu Mohanty and Bishnu Datta.

p: Sangram Biswal wrote both the story and the screenplay in addition to directing. Shirshananda Das Kanungo wrote the dialogue. Shamba Shiva Rao handled the cinematography and A. Sreekar Prasad edited the film, which had a stated budget of about ₹88.75 lakh.

The cast was led by Siddhanta Mahapatra, Mihir Das, Namrata Das, Uttam Mohanty and Aparajita Mohanty, with Ilu Banerjee, Pradyumna Lenka, Minaketan, Satyaki Mishra, Premanjana Parida, Raimohan, Biren Routray, Jayiram Samal and Braja Singh in other roles.
Deepak Kumar composed the score, and Shirshananda Das Kanungo also wrote the song lyrics.

Q110441091.lead: Moosha Mora Rajanikant is a 2020 Odia-language feature film written and directed by Sanjay Nayak, which premiered on television.

p: Jagi Mangad Panda produced the film. Sanjay Nayak wrote the story and screenplay, and the dialogue was written by Sanjay Mahakul and B. Chandan Kumar. Lipika Senapati and Karan played the leads, supported by Abhijit, Asrumochan Mohanty, Biju Badajena and Nila. Pradeep Kumar Sahoo was the cinematographer and Ranjan Khatei the editor.
Prem Anand composed the music to lyrics by Bijay Malla and Basantaraj Samal. Humane Sagar and Asima Panda were among the playback singers.
The film was released on Tarang TV on 14 June 2020.

Q28005979.lead: Paribar is a 1978 Odia-language feature film directed by K. H. D. Rao and produced by V. Anjani Kumar.

p: Akshaya Mohanty and Bishnu Pattnaik wrote the dialogue. S. Parthasarathy was the cinematographer and Ajay Kumar the editor. The cast included Gloria Mohanty, Chakrapani, Anita Das, Jayiram Samal, Bholanath, Abhay Mohanty, Niharika Sahu, Satyaranjan Singh, Narendra Mishra and Gitarani.

Upendra Kumar composed the music. Brundaban Jena and Narayan Prasad Singh were among the lyricists, and the songs were sung by artists including Sikandar Alam, H. P. Geetha, Vani Jairam, S. Janaki and Pranab Pattnaik.

Q42307429.lead: Sandehi Priyatama is a 2013 Odia-language feature film directed by Sudhansu Sekhar Mallick and produced by Narayan Ghadei.

p: Gautam Giri wrote the story, and Chinmay Das Pattnaik wrote both the screenplay and the dialogue. Pradeep Nair was the cinematographer. Debdutta and Kajal Mishra played the lead roles, with Nirab Kumar, Susanket Mishra, Kajal Rath, Hadu, Debu Brahma, Namrata Das, Bijaya Patnaik, Sangram Samantaray, Ipshita Mohanty and Devi Barik in the cast.
Bidyut Ray composed the music and Panchanan Nayak wrote the songs.
The film was released on 13 December 2013.

Q112305045.lead: Lagaam is a 2022 Odia-language feature film directed by Pinu Nayak, written and produced by Ranajit Kumar Sahu, and released on television.

p: Ranajit Kumar Sahu was responsible for the story, screenplay and dialogue as well as producing. Amlan Das and Tamanna Vyas played the leads, with Babi Mishra, Pradyumna Lenka and Harihara Mohapatra in supporting roles. Kaushik Maiti shot the film and Ranjan Khatei edited it; the running time is 136 minutes.
Abhijit Majumdar composed the music. The lyricists included Janmejay Panda and Tapu Nayak, and the singers included Swayam Padhi, Antara Chakraborty, Satyajit Pradhan and Tariq Aziz.
Lagaam premiered on 6 March 2022 on Tarang TV and the Tarang Plus platform.

Q21468049.lead: Aa Aaa Harsaee is a 2015 Odia-language feature film directed by Narasingha Padhi and produced by Krushna Chandra Mallick; it was released in both Odia and Bengali.

p: Kumar Chinmay wrote the story and the director wrote the screenplay. Ardhendu Sahu played the male lead opposite two heroines, Babli and Srijala Guha. Pritiraj Satapathy, Asrumochan Mohanty, Jiban Panda, Mousumi Saha, Subha, Priyanka and Rohan Bhattacharya appeared in other roles.
The music was composed by Gyan and Bibhuti, with songs written by Nirmal Nayak. Kumar Bapi, Pami, Sailabhama, Arabinda and Jaya were among the singers.
The film was released on 6 February 2015.

Q110441084.lead: Tu Mora Sathire is a 2020 Odia-language feature film directed by Raja Das that premiered on television.

p: Rinkurinu Jena and Deepak Kumar Jena produced the film, which was shot in 17 days. Sailendra Samantray and Divya Mohanty played the leads, supported by Asrumochan Mohanty, Bunty R Samal, Bapi, Ananya Adyasha and Trupti Sinha. Akshaya Kumar Nayak was the cinematographer and Manas Kumar Sahoo the editor.
Asad Nizam composed the music and Tapu Nayak wrote the lyrics. The singers included Kuldeep Pattanaik, Asima Panda, Abinash and R. S. Kumar.
The film premiered on Zee Sarthak on 27 December 2020.

Q117221496.lead: Prem For Sale is a 2023 Odia-language feature film directed by Sanjeeb Dwibedi and produced by Subhalaxmi Pattnaik, which premiered on television.

p: The story was written by Umesh Chandra Pattnaik and the dialogue by Chinmay Das Pattnaik. Sambit Acharya and Tamanna Vyas played the lead roles, with Dusmanta Panda and Asit Pati in supporting parts. Chitta Biswal was the cinematographer and Pintu Nayak the editor. The film runs 159 minutes.
Abhijit Majumdar composed the music to lyrics by Nirmal Nayak. Amrita Nayak, Humane Sagar and Lopamudra Das were among the singers.
It was released on Tarang TV and Tarang Plus on 12 March 2023.

Q114804715.lead: Mayabi is a 2022 Odia-language feature film directed by Sudhanshu Mohan Sahu and produced by Tapan Das.

p: Dillip Choudhury wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue. Amlan Das and Bhoomika Dash played the leads, and the supporting cast included Arlin Ankita, Moubani Sarkar, Oliva, Sneha, Ashutosh, Kunal, Chakradhar and Prashant Patra. Dhrubananda Panda handled the cinematography and Rajesh Das the editing.

Yajna Das composed the music. Dillip Choudhury and Jashobanta Das were among the lyricists, and the singers included Ira Mohanty, Ananta Bharadwaj, Prafulla Chandra Panda, Sohini Mishra and Satyajit Pradhan.
Mayabi opened in cinemas on 26 August 2022.

Q119889705.lead: Lagila Ranga Golapi Golapi is a 2023 Odia-language feature film directed by Mrutyunjaya Sahoo and produced by Sitaram Agrawal and Namita Agrawal.

p: Nirmal Nayak wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue. Amlan Das and Riya Dey played the lead roles, with Pragya Khatua, Pintu Nanda, Bhupati Tripathy, Sar Apa and Shankar in supporting parts. Ishwar Barik was the cinematographer and Rajesh Das the editor. The running time is 132 minutes.
Baidyanath Dash composed the music and Srikant Gautam wrote the songs. Producer Namita Agrawal and Kuldeep Pattanaik were among the singers.
The film was released on 9 June 2023.

Q112186132.lead: Au Gote Love Story is a 2022 Odia-language feature film directed by Sanjay Nayak and produced by Ramesh Barik.

p: Akshaya Barik and Panchali Barik wrote the story, while Sanjay Nayak wrote the screenplay and dialogue besides directing. Jyoti Ranjan Nayak and Bhoomika Dash played the leads, supported by Pushpa Panda, Krishna Kar, Biju Badajena and Guddu. Pradeep was the cinematographer and Ranjan Khatei the editor.
Baidyanath Dash composed the music and Arun Mantri wrote the lyrics. The singers included Humane Sagar, Lipi Mishra, Satyajit Pradhan and Asima Panda.
The film was released on 20 May 2022.

Q29561666.lead: Tike Khara Tike Chhai is a 2017 Odia-language feature film directed by Kumar Saroj and produced by Ayaskanta Mohanty.

p: Madhusmita Das wrote the story and Kumar Saroj the screenplay, with dialogue credited to Bapu Goswami and Ajay Samal. Deepak Barik, newcomer Priyanka and Debashish Pati headed the cast, which also included Rock Patra, Prince Aryan, Babu Pradhan, Umesh Das, Junior Papu and Lina.

Biswa Swarup directed the music. Jatindra Pradhan, Biswa Swarup, Manas Samal and Debidutta Mohanty were among the lyricists, and Biswa Swarup, Humane Sagar, Jasaswini Nayak, Asit Tripathy, Asima Panda and Sudeep Prabhu sang the songs.
The film was released on 21 April 2017.

Q141204475.lead: Mo Jejenka Love Story is a 2024 Odia-language feature film directed by Pinu Nayak and produced by Pradyumna Lenka, released on television and streaming.

p: Priyabrata Panda wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue. The cast included Satyajit, Nilakhi Patra, Pradyumna Lenka, Choudhury Jayprakash Das, Somesh Mohanty, Mamuni, Kriti, Sumanta, Manas, Shruti, Subhashree, Lipika and Pragya. Sudarshan Senapati was the cinematographer and Pintu Nayak the editor.
Abhijit Majumdar composed the music and Debidutta Mohanty wrote the songs.
The film premiered on Tarang TV and Tarang Plus on 18 February 2024.

Q141532249.lead: Maa Petaru Mun Jagatajita is a 2024 Odia-language feature film directed by Sanjay Nayak and produced by Raja Nayak.

p: The story was written by Dillip Kumar Das, and Sanjay Nayak wrote the screenplay and dialogue in addition to directing. The cast included Cookies Swain, Swadhin, Gaurav, Biren Mishra, Shakti Baral, Bulu Panda, Pragya Khatua, Kedar Mishra, Disco Reddy, Bijay Sadangi and Jogi. Kanhu Nanda Shubham was the cinematographer and Pintu Nayak the editor.
Biraj Prasad composed the music to lyrics by Nirmal Nayak, with Satyajit Pradhan and Rashmita Das among the singers.
It premiered on Tarang TV and Tarang Plus on 28 April 2024.

Q54504132.lead: Ram Laxman is a 1997 Odia-language feature film directed by Sangram Biswal and produced by B. Pramila.

p: Pramila Rout wrote the story. Sangram Biswal prepared the screenplay and shared dialogue credit with Shirshananda Das Kanungo. Dillip Ray was the cinematographer and Biswanath Rao the editor. The cast included Bijay Mohanty, Sritam Das, Raimohan Parida, Snigdha Mohanty, Braja Singh, Jayiram Samal, Pradyumna Lenka, Pintu Nanda, Hara Patnaik and Tandra Ray.
Amarendra Mohanty composed the music and Shirshananda Das Kanungo wrote the lyrics.

Q56705903.lead: Dekh Khabar Rakh Nazar is a 1983 Odia-language feature film directed by Kumar Anand and produced by Sushant Khuntia.

p: Sushant Khuntia, who also acted in the film, wrote its story. Suresh Mishra wrote the dialogue and Kumar Anand the screenplay. Babu was the cinematographer and Gautam Raju the editor. The cast included Uttam Mohanty, Sriram Panda, Sujata Anand, Guman Singh, Purnima, Deepa, Sudharani, Prakash Pattnaik, Chandralekha, Gita and Dharmananda Das.
Basudeba Rath composed the music. Antarjami Mishra and Surendra Bidyadhar were among the lyricists, and Tansen Singh, Taj Mohammad and S. Janaki were among the singers.

Q28049247.lead: Lal Paan Bibi is a 1988 Odia-language feature film written and directed by Prashanta Nanda, who also starred in it, and produced by Kanchanbala Nanda.

p: Prashanta Nanda wrote the story as well as directing and acting. Surendra Sahu shot the film and Bhai Telang edited it. Mahasweta Ray, Akshaya Mohanty (Kashyap), Snigdha Mohanty, Jharana Das and Dukhiram Swain appeared alongside him, with Shankar Basu Mallick, Byomkesh Tripathy, Biren Routray, Pruthviraj Nayak, Radha Panda, Geeta Rao, Basant Sahu and Ananga Dwivedi in other roles.
Swarup Nayak composed the music, and the songs were written by Debdas Chhotray and Prashanta Nanda.
The film was released on 8 January 1988.

Q140644991.lead: Simili is a 2025 Odia-language feature film directed by Sukumar Mani and produced by Smita Rout and Paresh Chandra Mohanty.

p: Smita Rout wrote the story and Bhaba Binod Mahapatra the dialogue. Sukumar Mani wrote the screenplay and also edited the film, while Dhrubananda Panda handled the cinematography. The cast included Lipika Senapati, Suryamayee Mohapatra, Manoj Rout, Anup Saha, Suman Maharana and Dusmanta Sahoo.
The music was directed by Bachu Mukherjee, Bishnu Mohan Kabi and S. B. Smruti, with lyrics by Nirmal Nayak. Mantu Chhuria, Diptirekha Padhi and Bishnu Mohan Kabi were among the singers.
Simili was released in cinemas on 14 March 2025.

Q15723594.lead: Akshi Trutiya is a 1981 Odia-language feature film directed by Babulal Doshi and Sushil Mukherjee and produced by Babulal Doshi.

p: Kartik Chandra Rath wrote the screenplay. The film had a stated budget of about ₹21.10 lakh. Its cast included Sarat Pujari, Uttam Mohanty, Mahasweta Ray, Niranjan, Radha Panda, Prashanti, Deepa Sahu and Anita Das.

Rakhal Mohanty composed the music. The lyricists included Shibabrata Das, Baikunthanath Mohanty, Nizam, Kartik Chandra Rath and Nanda Kishore Singh, and the songs were sung by artists including Srikanta Das, Subas Das, Nilima Mishra, Geeta Pattnaik, Pranab Pattnaik and Tansen Singh.
The film was released on 23 January 1981.

Q140175609.lead: Tora Mora Prema is a 2025 Odia-language feature film written and directed by Tushar K. Sinha, who also played the male lead, and produced by Bijay Kandoi.

p: Tushar K. Sinha wrote the story and screenplay. He starred opposite Punyatoya Panigrahi, and the supporting cast included Smruti Ranjan Rath, Manaswini Pati, Neetu Mishra, Madhumita, Somu, Disco, Thin and Abhay.

The music was directed by Saroj Samal, Sanat Panda, Gaurav Anand and Sashank Sekhar. Sudhajit Routray, Arun Pattnaik and Rakesh Das were among the lyricists, and the singers included Humane Sagar, Antara Chakraborty, Gaurav Anand, Arpita Choudhury, Sashank Sekhar and Biswajit Mahapatra.
The film opened in cinemas on 10 October 2025.

Q52156270.lead: Haribhai Harena is a 2004 Odia-language feature film directed by Raju Misra and produced by Niranjan Rana.

p: Niranjan Rana wrote the story as well as producing, and Pradeep Nanda wrote the dialogue. Raju Misra prepared the screenplay and was also the cinematographer; Sushant Mani edited the film. Sunil Kumar and Anu Choudhury played the leads. The supporting cast included Mihir Das, Prakruti Mishra, Debu Bose, Badal Mohanty, Pinky Pradhan, Jayiram Samal, Satyaki Mishra, Ritu Sadangi, Buria, Mamuni Mishra, Swarup Nayak and Rekha Datta.
Swarup Nayak composed the music, and the lyricists included Debdas Chhotray, Bijay Malla, Pradeep Nanda and Suresh Parida.

Q116008638.lead: Dear Love is a 2022 Odia-language feature film written and directed by Ashwini Tripathy and produced by Himalaya Raj Parida, which premiered on television.

p: Ashwini Tripathy wrote the story and screenplay, and Rajani Ranjan wrote the dialogue. Gurudev Maharathi and Tamanna Vyas played the leads, with Samaresh Routray, Jogesh Jojo, Arman, Guddu and Deepali in supporting roles. Akshaya Kumar Sahu was the cinematographer and Kumar Manas Sahu the editor. The film runs 131 minutes.

Debasish Mallick and Matruprasad Rath composed the music. Silu Bibhu and Arun Mantri were among the lyricists, and Humane Sagar, Jyotirmayee Nayak, Swayam Padhi and Antara Chakraborty were among the singers.
The film was first shown on television on 25 December 2022.

Q140607693.lead: Ajira Rebati is a 2025 Odia-language feature film directed by Subhransu Das and produced by Ramesh Barik.

p: Badri Mishra wrote the story. Shyam Prasad Mishra wrote the screenplay and shared dialogue credit with Sushant Mani. Kuhu Malla was the cinematographer. The cast included Sheetal Patra, Bonny Sengupta, Pushpa Panda, Pruthviraj Nayak, Usasi Misra and Sukanta Rath.
Prem Anand composed the music. Bapu Goswami and Sushant Mani wrote the songs, and Sabisesh Mishra, Diptirekha Padhi and Satyajit Pradhan were among the singers.
The film was released in cinemas on 11 April 2025.

Q6480103.lead: Lal Tuku Tuku Sadhaba Bahu is a 2007 Odia-language feature film directed by Sangram Biswal and produced by Sumit Rout.

p: Sunil Rout wrote the story and Bijay Malla the dialogue, while Sangram Biswal prepared the screenplay. A. Sreekar Prasad edited the film. Arindam Roy and Anu Choudhury played the leads, and the supporting cast included Kajal Mishra, Babi Mishra, Debu Bose, Bijay Mohanty, Debjani, Pintu Nanda, Tandra Ray and Kuna Tripathy.
Subash Ram composed the music and Arun Mantri wrote the lyrics. Kumar Bapi, Tapu Mishra and Pami were among the singers.
The film was released on 19 October 2007.

Q55808297.lead: Ghara Mora Swarga is a 1992 Odia-language feature film produced, written, directed and scored by Arun Mohanty.

p: Arun Mohanty wrote the story and screenplay, and Subodh Pattnaik wrote the dialogue. The camera work was by Shamba Shiva Rao and K. V. Suresh, and Rabi Shankar Pattnaik edited the film. The cast included Sriram Panda, Mahasweta Ray, Mihir Das, Tandra Ray, Hara Patnaik, Niharika Sahu, Jayiram Samal, Ajit Das, Braja Singh, Kanta Singh, Dukhiram Swain, Srabanti and Banku.
Arun Mohanty also composed the music, with songs written by Debdas Chhotray. Pranab Pattnaik and Isha Bebarta were among the singers.

Q50825289.lead: Deepu The Dance Boy is a 2018 Odia-language feature film written and directed by Arun Das and produced by Manoj Kumar Rout, who also made his acting debut in the lead role.

p: The director wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue. Manoj Kumar Rout, a Chhau dancer, entered Odia films with this project, and Bengali newcomer Elsa Ghosh played the heroine. Babi Mishra, Koel Banerjee, Minaketan, Choudhury Bikash Das, Debu Brahma, Pragya Khatua, Hadu, Thin, Banamali Pandia and Om Biswal completed the cast.
Prem Anand composed the music.
The film received a U/A certificate and was released on 4 March 2018.

Q15725067.lead: Jahaku Rakhibe Ananta is a 1988 Odia-language feature film directed by Ashim Kumar and produced by Basanta Nayak.

p: Bijay Mishra wrote the dialogue. The film includes scenes about the glory of snakes. Uttam Mohanty and Aparajita Mohanty played the leads, supported by Bijay Mohanty, Sriram Panda, Sujata Anand, Pruthviraj Nayak, Debu Brahma, Hara Patnaik, Niharika Sahu, Kanta Singh, Jayiram Samal and Dukhiram Swain. Surendra Sahu was the cinematographer and Rabi Shankar Pattnaik the editor, and the stated budget was about ₹4.85 lakh.
Swarup Nayak both composed the music and wrote the songs. Anuradha, Srikanta, Trupti Das and Debashis Mahapatra were among the singers.
The film was released on 14 October 1988.

Q64708062.lead: Golmaal Love is a 2019 Odia-language feature film directed by Ashok Pati, starring Babushaan Mohanty and Tamanna Vyas.

p: Nirmal Nayak wrote the dialogue and songs. Babushaan Mohanty and Tamanna Vyas headed the cast, with Bijay Mohanty, Salil Mitra, Sritam Das, Ilu Banerjee, Subhransu Nayak, Tribhuban Panda, Jiban Panda, Lina, Manaswini and Nalini in supporting roles. S. Ranjan was the cinematographer and Sukumar Mani the editor. The film runs about 2 hours 40 minutes.
Abhijit Majumdar composed the music to Nirmal Nayak's lyrics. The singers included Mantu Chhuria, Humane Sagar, Swayam Padhi, Lopamudra Das, Pragya Hota and Lipsa Mahapatra.
The film was released on 14 June 2019.

Q41234479.lead: Puni Dekha Heba Ara Janamare is a 2014 Odia-language feature film written, produced and directed by Ashok Kumar Mohanty.

p: Ashok Kumar Mohanty wrote the story and screenplay, and Nizam wrote the dialogue. Sangram Giri was the cinematographer. Babi Mishra and Rali Nanda played the leads, supported by Mihir Das, Pruthviraj Nayak, Runu Parija, Pradyumna Lenka, Priyanka Mahapatra, Braja Singh, Pintu Nanda and Madhusmita Pradhan.
Abhijit Majumdar composed the music and Nizam wrote the songs.
The film was released on 4 February 2014.

Q140814410.lead: Bhai – The Opening Part is a 2025 Odia-language feature film directed by Pruthviraj Pattnaik and produced by Nabin Bhandari.

p: Rabinarayan Das wrote the story and dialogue, and Pruthviraj Pattnaik wrote the screenplay. The cast included Amlan Das, Divya Mohanty, Sujit Paikaray, Ananya Mishra, Bikash Ganatra, Dibyajyoti Udaysingh and Aimon. Rudrakanta Singh was the cinematographer and Manas Kumar Sahoo the editor.
Nabajyoti Panda and Saroj composed the music, with lyrics by Arun Mantri and Ranjan Nayak. Amrita Nayak and Kuldeep Pattanaik were among the singers.
The film was released in cinemas on 24 January 2025.

Q140102315.lead: Shambhu is a 2025 Odia-language feature film directed by S. Dillip Panda and produced by Bibhuti Bhusan Jena.

p: Anupama Jena wrote the story and Rajani Ranjan the dialogue, while S. Dillip Panda prepared the screenplay. Shubham Nayak and Tamanna Vyas played the leads, with Sudhakar Vasant, Harihara Mohapatra, Piyush Tripathy and Mitu Mithun in supporting roles.

Deepak Kumar composed the music. The songs were written by Nirmal Nayak, Bapu Goswami, Ranjan Das and Kulamani, among others, and sung by artists including Humane Sagar, Amrita Nayak, Kumar Bapi, Antara Chakraborty, Satyajit Pradhan, James, Jyotirmayee Nayak and Sasmita Mishra.
The film was released on 31 October 2025.

Q10323448.lead: Mamata is a 1975 Odia-language feature film directed by Byomkesh Tripathy and produced by Prashanta Nanda, who also starred in it.

p: The story was by Sarat Mohanty. The film was the first Odia production of Prashanta Nanda, who is credited as producer alongside Prafulla Mishra. Prashanta Nanda, Sujata Anand and Suresh Mishra played the main roles, and the film marked Suresh Mishra's acting debut. Bhanumati Devi, Dhira Biswal, Asima, Dinabandhu and Radha Panda were also in the cast. Deojibhai and Rajan Kinagi handled the cinematography.

Prafulla Kar composed the score; it was the first film on which he worked as a music director. The songs were written by Prafulla Kar, Madhusudan Rao and Shibabrata Das, and P. Susheela was among the playback singers.

facts: First film produced by Prashanta Nanda
First film scored by Prafulla Kar

Q140621282.lead: Swayambara is a 2025 Odia-language feature film directed by Mrutyunjaya Sahoo and produced by Sanjeeb Dwibedi, released on television and streaming.

p: Priyabrata Panda wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue. The cast included Debjani, Soumya Swarup Padhi, Sankarsan Pradhan, Shakti Baral, Tribhuban Panda, Bhupati Tripathy, Soumya Mishra, Arabinda and Bidu. Subhransu Senapati was the cinematographer and Pintu Nayak the editor.
Baidyanath Dash composed the music, with songs written by Nirmal Nayak and Nihar Priyasish.
The film premiered on Tarang TV and Tarang Plus on 30 March 2025.

Q28388908.lead: Saakhi Gopinath is a 1978 Odia-language feature film directed by Ganesh Mahapatra and produced by P. C. Jena.

p: Basanta Mahapatra wrote the screenplay and dialogue and shared the story credit with Ganesh Mahapatra. Dilip Datta was the cinematographer. The cast included Dukhiram Swain, Mala Bose, Gloria Mohanty, Kedar Guru, George Tiadi, Padma Khanna, Bholanath, Pradeep, Rukmani and Gadi. The film runs 114 minutes.

Basudeba Rath composed the music. The lyricists included Surendra Bidyadhar, Basanta Mahapatra, Ganesh Mahapatra and Kalicharan Pattnaik, and Manna Dey, Chitta Jena and Anuradha Paudwal were among the singers.

Q60368394.lead: Nayakara Na Debadas is a 2019 Odia-language feature film directed by Mrutyunjaya Sahoo.

p: The producers were Prabhat Kumar Pradhan, Sisir Das and Kirtan Patra. Mrutyunjaya Sahoo wrote the screenplay, Debidutta Mohanty the dialogue, and Chandrasekhar Mishra edited the film. Asit, Bhoomika Dash and Anu Choudhury played the lead roles, with Aparajita Mohanty, Uttam Mohanty, Bijay Mohanty, Babi Mishra, Papi, Pintu Nanda and Bhupati Tripathy in the supporting cast.

Baidyanath Dash composed the music and Arun Mantri and Nirmal Nayak wrote the songs. The singers included Humane Sagar, Bishnu Mohan Kabi, Prince, Tapu Mishra, Diptirekha Padhi, Arpita, Asima Panda and Anwesha.
The film was released on 9 August 2019.

Q116008639.lead: To Na Ra Mane Han is a 2022 Odia-language feature film directed by Sudhanshu Mohan Sahu and produced by Amulya Kumar Das, which premiered on television.

p: Sujata Das wrote the story, Deepak Jena the dialogue, and the director the screenplay. Sambit Acharya, Riya Dey and Kavya Keeran played the leads, with Mahasweta Ray, Pintu Nanda, Asit Pati, Soma Bhowmick and Pradyumna Lenka in other roles. Dhrubananda Panda was the cinematographer.
Abhijit Majumdar composed the music.
The film premiered on Star Kiran on 25 December 2022.

Q28061046.lead: Gruhalaxmi is a 1985 Odia-language feature film directed by C. S. R. Rao and produced by Niramarthi Padmakshi.

p: Prabhakar Reddy wrote the story and screenplay, and Bijay Mishra wrote the dialogue. Pachchi was the cinematographer and Satya the editor. The cast included Sriram Panda, Mahasweta Ray, Dukhiram Swain, Debu Bose, Premanjana Parida, Jayiram Samal, Lila Dulali, Samuel Sahu, Geeta Rao, Biren Routray and Kunjalata.
Prafulla Kar composed the music and also wrote the songs, which were sung by artists including Gita Das, Vani Jairam, Chitta Jena and Pranab Pattnaik.
The film was released on 19 July 1985.

Q56220930.lead: Anyaya Sahibi Nahin is an Odia-language feature film released in 1987, written and directed by Ashok Sharma and produced by Suresh Mohanty and Jitendra.

p: Ashok Sharma wrote the story and screenplay, and Ratikanta Mishra wrote the dialogue. Dilip Ray was the cinematographer. The cast included Sriram Panda, Uttam Mohanty, Debu Bose, Debu Brahma, Mamina, Biren Routray, Shehnaz Kudia, Binayak Mishra, Jiten Singh, Jaya B. and Runu Parija.

Basudeba Rath composed the music. Shibabrata Das, Banabihari Panda and Raghunath Rout were among the lyricists, and Mohammed Aziz, Shabbir Kumar, Swagatika Rath and Tansen Singh were among the singers.

Q54801955.lead: Moksha is a 1996 Odia-language feature film directed by Gauri Shankar Das and Malay Roy and produced by Jayadev Mallick and Pramod Nayak.

p: Gauri Shankar Das wrote the story and shared directing duties with Malay Roy. Malay Mishra and Malay Roy handled the cinematography, and Bijay Mishra edited the film. The cast included Choudhury Jayprakash Das, Durga Mahapatra, Pruthviraj Mishra, Bijayini Mishra, Pushpa Panda, Jayiram Samal and Snehaprava Samantaray.
Sumanta Mohanty composed the music.
The film received an award for best regional film.

Q53713496.lead: Katha Rahigala Kala Kalaku is a 1999 Odia-language feature film directed by Kumar Anand and produced by Asit Pati and Anjana Pati.

p: Asit Pati wrote the story and also acted in the film. Pramod Tripathy wrote the dialogue and Kumar Anand the screenplay. Ashok Swain was the cinematographer and Deben Mishra the editor. The cast included Bijay Mohanty, Uttam Mohanty, Pushpa Panda, Ajit Das, Sujata Anand, Anindita, Gita Datta, Arpita Pal, Samaj Pati and Jayiram Samal.
Bachu Mukherjee composed the music and Nimai Mohanty wrote the songs. Anjali, Subas Das, Debashis Mahapatra and T. Souri were among the singers.

Q34640205.lead: Chup Chup Chori Chori is a 2016 Odia-language feature film directed by Sudhanshu Mohan Sahu and produced by Sitaram Agrawal.

p: The film was the seventeenth production from Sitaram Agrawal's banner, with Pradyumna Lenka serving as executive producer. Srikant Gautam wrote the dialogue. Abhishek Rath and Riya Dey played the leads, pairing on screen for the first time, with Bijay Mohanty, Aparajita Mohanty and Harihara Mohapatra in supporting roles.
Manmath Mishra composed the music and Srikant Gautam wrote the songs. Sourin Bhatt and Nibedita were among the singers.
The film was released on 18 March 2016.

Q83182493.lead: Queen is a 2020 Odia-language feature film directed by Mrutyunjay Sahoo and produced by Bijay Kandoi, with a story by its lead actress Barsha Priyadarshini.

p: Barsha Priyadarshini wrote the story and Bijay Malla the dialogue. She played Arohi, with Jayjit Das as Ayush and Lipsa Mishra in the third lead role; Harihara Mohapatra, Usasi Misra, Papi Santuka and Pradeep also appeared. Pratap Rout was the cinematographer and Chandrasekhar Mishra the editor.
Malay Mishra composed the music, with lyrics by Arun Mantri and Jayanta Das. Humane Sagar and Ira Mohanty were among the singers.
The film was released on 15 January 2020.

Q6479854.lead: Lakshmi is a 1962 Odia-language feature film directed by Sarada Prasanna Naik and produced by Gour Prasad Ghose and Parbati Ghose.

p: Sarada Prasanna Naik, who also used the pen name Siddhartha, directed the film under the technical supervision of Binoy Banerjee. It is described as the first Odia film made by an Odia director. Chandana Banerjee, Gour Prasad Ghose and Samuel Sahu (Babi) headed the cast, which also included Dayanidhi Das and Parbati Ghose.
Balakrishna Das composed the music. The song "Arata Sura Bare" was Sikandar Alam's first playback song in films.
Released in 1962, the film ran for 100 days in cinemas.
At the National Film Awards it received the Certificate of Merit for the Second Best Feature Film in Oriya.

facts: National Film Award – Certificate of Merit, Second Best Feature Film in Oriya

Q45223799.lead: Megha Sabari Re Asiba Pheri is a 2010 Odia-language feature film directed by Sanjay Nayak, with Sabyasachi Mishra and Priya Chaudhury in the lead roles.

p: Anam Charan Sahu produced the film. Laxmipriya Sahu wrote both the story and the dialogue, while Sanjay Nayak handled the screenplay and editing in addition to directing. S. Ranjan was the cinematographer. The supporting cast included Akhila Pattnaik, Kuna Tripathy, Bijay Mohanty, Minaketan, Uttam Mohanty, Papu Pam Pam, Arabinda Sadangi, Mihir Das and Bina Maharana.
Malay Mishra composed the film's music.
The film was released on 14 October 2010.

Q141543763.lead: Rakta Samparka is a 2024 Odia-language feature film directed by Mrutyunjay Sahoo that premiered on television and an OTT platform rather than in cinemas.

p: Ajay Kumar Rout produced the film. The story came from Debidutta Mohanty, and B. Chandan Kumar wrote the screenplay and dialogue. Bhagat Singh was the cinematographer and Pintu Nayak edited the film. The cast featured Asrumochan Mohanty, Smita Mohanty, Bikram Mohanty, Rajesh, Elli Padhi, Ankit Kumar, Manaswini and Sudipta.
Sarat Nayak composed the music, and the singer Karunakar provided vocals.
It premiered on 2 June 2024 on Tarang TV and the Tarang Plus streaming service.

Q51080334.lead: To Pain is a 2005 Odia-language feature film written for the screen and directed by Anil Dubey, starring Sambit, Pinky Pradhan, Pratyush and Namrata Thapa.

p: Sumita Dhar and Abha Panda produced the film, with Abha Panda also supplying the story. Pradeep Nanda wrote the dialogue. Babi Mishra, Mohini Shilalipi, Hara Patnaik, Mihir Das and Priyanka Mahapatra appeared in supporting roles.
Manmath Mishra directed the music and was one of the lyricists along with Basantaraj Samal. The songs were sung by Kumar Bapi, Bibhu Kishore, Tapu Mishra and Shakti Mishra, among others.

Q47523464.lead: Mahanayak is a 2007 Odia-language feature film directed by Debu Pattnaik and Sudhanshu Shekhar Sahu, with Anubhav Mohanty and Koel Mallick in the lead roles.

p: Harshabardhan Lal produced the film. Debu Pattnaik wrote the story and shared directing duties with Sudhanshu Shekhar Sahu, while Subodh Pattnaik wrote the screenplay. Niranjan Das handled the cinematography and Chandrasekhar Mishra the editing. The supporting cast included Rahul Dev, Suresh Bal, Namrata Das, Gloria Mohanty, Harihar Mahapatra, Priyanka Mahapatra, Bijay Mohanty, Pintu Nanda, Jiban Panda, Salil Mitra, Tandra Ray and Thin.
T. Souri was the music director.

Q15724100.lead: Chinha Achinha is a 1979 Odia-language feature film and the first film directed by Kumar Anand. Uttam Mohanty, Mahasweta Ray and Sujata Anand headed its cast.

p: Binod Nanda and Suresh Mishra developed the story and screenplay, and Babu Rao was the cinematographer. The film was made on a budget of ₹15.25 lakh. Besides the leads, the cast included Kashi Rath, Niharika Sahu, Sukanta Khuntia, Asit Pati, Niranjan Behera, Rukmani, Mamina and Pitambar. It marked the screen debut of Asit Pati in Odia cinema.

Basudeba Rath composed the music, with lyrics by Narayan Prasad Singh, Surendra Bidyadhar, Dinabandhu Rath and Binod Nanda. Its songs included "Chand Na Tume Tara", "Chhai Chhabeli Ranga Rangeli", "Majhire" and "Jagatara Natha".
The film was released on 13 December 1979.
It won Odisha State Film Awards in three categories: Best Director, Best Actress and Best Story.

facts: Odisha State Film Awards for Best Director, Best Actress and Best Story
Chand Na Tume Tara; Majhire; Jagatara Natha

Q141158320.lead: Ashiq Surrender Hela is a 2024 Odia-language feature film directed by Raja D and produced by Jaya Biswas, featuring Sambhav Mansingh, Jaya Biswas, Manoj Mishra and Mihir Das.

p: Raja D and Jaya Biswas jointly wrote the story and screenplay, and Manas Padihari supplied the dialogue. K. Sunil shot the film and Ranjan Khatei edited it. Anuguliya Banti also appeared in the cast.

Prem Anand composed the score. Subrat Swain and Basantaraj Samal were among the lyricists, and the playback singers included Humane Sagar, Ananya Sritam Nanda, Sabisesh Mishra, Diptirekha Padhi, Asutosh Mohanty and Satyajit Pradhan.
It opened in cinemas on 9 February 2024.

Q56490030.lead: Maa Kande Aaji Puate Pain is a 2002 Bengali film directed by Anup Sengupta that was dubbed into Odia. Prosenjit Chatterjee and Rachna Banerjee played the lead roles.

p: Dhruba Rana produced the film. Snehasish Chakraborty was responsible for the story and screenplay, while Salil Mitra wrote the dialogue. Babul Ray handled the camera and Asit De Sarkar the editing.
