Locket, Tapas Paul, Priya Sengupta, Dipankar De and Anuradha were also in the cast, and Siddhanta Mahapatra is listed among the performers.
Ashok Bhadra directed the music and Purnendu Das Mahapatra wrote the lyrics. T. Souri, Ira Mohanty, Subhasish, Sailabhama Mahapatra, Arabinda Muduli and Sanjukta were among the singers.

Q112194803.lead: Bhabe Sina Kahi Parena is a 2022 Odia-language feature film directed by the actor Asit Pati, with Abhishek Rath and Archita Mohanty in the lead roles.

p: Pankaj Rout produced the film. Chinmay Das Pattnaik wrote its story, screenplay and dialogue. Chitta Biswal was the cinematographer and Amiya the editor. Dusmanta Panda, Asit Pati, Pradyumna Lenka, Manisha Rath and Pupun appeared in supporting roles. The film was Archita Mohanty's first in Odia cinema.
Chinmay Das Pattnaik also composed the music and wrote the song lyrics.
It was released on 1 June 2022.

Q140129490.lead: Vaastav is a 2025 Odia-language feature film directed by the duo Lubun-Tubun, starring Tushar Bedi and Ankita Dash.

p: Badrinath Pattnaik produced the film. Lubun-Tubun wrote the story and screenplay, and Sanjay Mahakul wrote the dialogue. Kanhu Nanda was the cinematographer and Pintu Nanda the editor. The supporting cast included Rabi Mishra, Abhijit Das, Prabhati Sahu, Mitu Mithun, Abhishek, Amar, Madhu, Bhupati, Dibyanshi Sen, Sonali, Bijay, Lulu Bhai and Sahu Babu.
Baidyanath Dash composed the music. The lyrics were written by Nihar Priyadarshi and Arun Mantri, and Humane Sagar and Antarikhya Nayak were among the singers.
The film was released on 18 October 2025.

Q28802701.lead: Pakakambal Potchhata is a 1986 Odia-language feature film written, directed and edited by Prashanta Nanda, who also acted in it alongside Uttam Mohanty and Aparajita Mohanty.

p: Basant Naik produced the film, and Surendra Sahu was the cinematographer. Prashanta Nanda wrote both the story and the screenplay. The ensemble also included Sriram Panda, Mahasweta Ray, Dukhiram Swain, Jayiram Samal, Niharika Sahu, Ananga Dwivedi, Mantu, Prithviraj Nayak, Radha Panda, Rukmani, Raimohan Parida and Purnachandra Pratihari.
Basudeba Rath was the music director.

Q140073102.lead: Ganga Jamuna Saraswati is a 2025 Odia-language feature film written and directed by Sanjay Nayak, with Sradha Panigrahi in the lead role. It premiered on television.

p: Khirod Pattnaik produced the film. Sanjay Nayak wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue in addition to directing. Kanhu Nanda handled the cinematography and Tapas Ranjan Behera the editing. Ankit Kumar, Bikram Keshari Mohanty, Jyoti Prakash Panda, Abhinav Singh and Rashmi were also in the cast.
Sandeep Panda composed the music and co-wrote the lyrics with Nirmal Nayak. S. Jitu, Payal Mohanty and Gaurav Anand were among the singers.
The film premiered on Tarang TV and Tarang Plus on 16 November 2025.

Q21000859.lead: Maa Mate Shakti De is a 1990 Odia-language feature film directed by Samsan Lima, featuring Bijay Mohanty, Tandra Ray and Baishali Parida.

p: The story was by Lalit Nanda, the dialogue by Nizam, and the screenplay by Samsan Lima himself. Dilip Ray was the cinematographer, and Deben Mishra and A. Sreekar Prasad edited the film. Hara Patnaik, Debu Bose, Jayiram Samal, Suresh Bal, Isha Bebarta, Gita Dutta, Tushar Panigrahi, Nihar Samal, Braja Singh, Kanta Singh, Dukhiram Swain and Asim Basu completed the cast.
Mohammad Mushir directed the music, Nizam wrote the songs, and Trupti Das was among the singers.

Q49839725.lead: Rakate Lekhichi Naa is a 2006 Odia-language feature film directed by Himanshu Parija and produced by Niranjan Rana, with Siddhanta Mahapatra and Seema Chakraborty in the lead roles.

p: The film gave actor Sunil Kumar his first role as a villain, and Swaraj Barik began his acting career in it as a child artist. Mihir Das, Ayesha Jhulka, Raimohan Parida, Saroj Das, Pintu Nanda, Salil Mitra, Debu Bose, Chunga and Jiban Panda were also part of the cast.
Manmath Mishra directed the music and Pradeep Nanda wrote the songs. The playback singers included Udit Narayan, Anuradha Paudwal, Sulagna and Manmath Mishra.

Q117286068.lead: Manaska is a 2023 Odia-language feature film directed by Manas Sahoo, starring Ashwini Ray Mohapatra and Madhumita Barik.

p: Bhabani Prasad Majhi produced the film, and Lingaraj Nath wrote its story, screenplay and dialogue. Subhendu Ghadei was the cinematographer and Maninder Pattnaik the editor. Ashwini Ray Mohapatra played Tanis and Madhumita Barik played Shalini. Other roles went to Choudhury Bikash Das as Pagala Baba, Bhabani Prasad as Raghu, Debadutta Nanda as Peter, Rajeswar Patra as Kantababu and Minati Pattnaik as Pagili, with Amrutanshu Bisoyi appearing as a child artist.
Kisalaya Ray composed the music.
The film opened in cinemas on 24 March 2023.

Q114804711.lead: Kichhi Kahibara Achhi is a 2022 Odia-language feature film directed by Tapas Sargharia, starring Siddhanta Mahapatra and Riya Dey. It premiered on television.

p: Sitaram Agrawal and Namita Agrawal produced the film, and Antaryami Sargharia wrote the dialogue. Rabindra Behera was the cinematographer and Rajesh Dash the editor. Harihara Mohapatra, Pradyumna Lenka and Priyanka Mahapatra played supporting roles.
Prem Anand composed the music to lyrics by Subrat Swain. Humane Sagar, Nibedita, Gaurav Anand and Asima Panda were among the singers.
It premiered on Sidharth TV on 15 August 2022.

Q15725360.lead: Suna Harini is a 1999 Odia-language feature film directed by Himanshu Parija, with Rachana Banerjee and Siddhanta Mahapatra in the lead roles.

p: Keshab Rout produced the film. Himanshu Parija wrote the story and co-wrote the screenplay with Subodh Pattnaik. Dilip Ray was the cinematographer and Deben Misra the editor. The budget was ₹89.65 lakh. The cast also featured Suresh Bal, Debu Bose, Mihir Das, Pradyumna Lenka, Hara Patnaik, Runu Parija, Braja Singh and Jayiram Samal.
Manmath Misra was the music director.
Released on 12 October 1999, the film did well at the box office.

Q15725278.lead: Samar Salim Saiman is a 1979 Odia-language feature film directed by Akshaya Mohanty (Kashyap), modelled on the Hindi film Amar Akbar Anthony.

p: Bijay Singh and Sailaja Nanda shared directing credit with Mohanty, and Sailajananda Nayak produced the film. It was made for ₹3.65 lakh. Harish Mohapatra, Sujata Anand and Anita Das headed the cast, which also included Sailajananda Nayak, Ilu Banerjee, Jaya Swami, Suchitra, Narayan Pati, Saileswar and Banku.

The film was the first for which Mohammad Mushir served as music director. Mushir and Nizam wrote the five songs. Subas Das, Sekhar Ghosh, Kumudini Mishra, Tansen Singh and Kanak Mohapatra were among the singers, on songs such as "E Priyatama Priyatama", "Hrudayara Ehi Sunyataku", "Mun Je Eka Pagala Bhanara" and "Tora Udi Udi Jaye Kani".
It opened on 30 August 1979 in Cuttack, Baripada, Bhadrak and other towns.

Q15725137.lead: Ramayan is a 1980 Odia-language mythological feature film based on Valmiki's Ramayana. It was produced by Dhira Biswal and marked Govinda Tej's debut as a director.

p: Uttam Mohanty played Rama and producer Dhira Biswal took the role of Ravana. Director Govinda Tej appeared as Dasharatha, Subhra Pati as Sita, Mihir Das as Shatrughna, Nalini Ray as Lakshmana, Anita Das as Mandodari and Namrata Das as Kausalya. Aparajita Mohanty, Pradeep, Saudamini Mishra, Rabi Mishra, Rajanikanta Mohanty, Premanjan Parida, Sangram Biswal, Narendra Kumar Behera (Nari), Lila Dulali and Meera Mohanty were also in the cast. Ranjan Kinagi was the cinematographer and A. Sanjeev the editor.
Prafulla Kar composed the music and wrote the songs, which were sung by Chitta Jena, Subas Das and S. Janaki, among others.

Q55455089.lead: Laxmira Abhisara is a 1998 Odia-language feature film directed by Raju Misra and based on a story by Manoj Das.

p: Hariram Agarwal and Laxminarayan Agarwal produced the film. Raju Misra wrote the screenplay and also served as cinematographer, while Rohit Gandhi edited it. The cast included Jagyanseni Jena, Mihir Das, Bidyutlal Debi, Rabi Mishra, Shilalipi Parida, Saroj Das and Anita Das.
The music was directed jointly by Giridhar Gamang and Raju Misra.
The film was screened in 2018 at the twelfth edition of an international film festival.
At the 2001 state film awards it won in eight categories, among them Best Film.

facts: State film awards in 8 categories including Best Film (2001)

Q116008636.lead: Natraj 009 is a 2022 Sambalpuri-language feature film written, directed and scored by Bhakta Prasad Barik, with Umakanta Barik and Twinkle in the lead roles.

p: Munna and Sachin Mahapatra produced the film. Bhakta Prasad Barik wrote its story, screenplay and dialogue. Jit and Phelu handled the cinematography and Sumit Sharma the editing. Jayiram Samal, Disco Reddy, Mitu Mithun, Surendra Nanda, Chhabila Pradhan, Sekhar Uma and Dhanesh Nag played supporting parts.
Bhakta Prasad Barik directed the music, and lead actor Umakanta Barik wrote the songs and sang them with Pallavi Nayak.
The film was released on 21 June 2022.

Q117221492.lead: Tinga Raju is a 2023 Odia-language feature film produced and directed by Mrutyunjay Sahoo, starring Rakesh Deo and Jasmin Rath. It premiered on television.

p: Manas Padihari wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue. Piyali Dash, Pruthviraj Nayak and Udit Guru were also in the cast.

Baidyanath Dash composed the music. Nirmal Nayak and Debidutta Mohanty were among the lyricists, and the singers included Satyajit Pradhan, Tariq Aziz, Antara Chakraborty, Swayam Padhi and Sital Kabi.
It premiered on Tarang TV and Tarang Plus on 5 March 2023.

Q109519689.lead: Luchei De Mate Chhati Bhitare is a 2021 Odia-language feature film written and directed by Sanjay Nayak, with Chandan Kar and Tamanna Vyas in the lead roles.

p: Actor Biranchi Narayan Nayak produced the film and also appeared in it. Sanjay Nayak wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue. Pradeep Sahu was the cinematographer and Ranjan Khatei the editor. Tamanna Vyas played Kajal and Sambhav played Badal; Chakradhar Jena and Kusum Tripathy were also in the cast.
Malay Mishra composed the music. Bapu Goswami, Basantaraj Samal and Arun Mantri were among the lyricists, and Ira Mohanty, Satyajit Pradhan and Malay Mishra were among the singers.
The film was released on 17 October 2021.

Q140893020.lead: Baida is a 2025 Odia-language feature film written and directed by Mayur Mahapatra and Siddhant Swaroop.

p: Mayur Mahapatra produced the film and was also its cinematographer and editor. He and Siddhant Swaroop developed the story and wrote the screenplay together with Sulagna Mohanty. The cast featured Shubhangi Harichandan, Saisresth Das, Rajesh Kumar Mohanty, Shivani Khara and Sidharth Ray.
Gaurav Anand and Bani Mohanty composed the music, while Phoenix wrote and sang the songs.
The film was released on 10 January 2025.

Q56061991.lead: Kala Manikora is a 2001 Odia-language feature film directed by Basant Sahu, featuring Mihir Das, Siddhanta Mahapatra, Mita, Aparajita Mohanty and Uttam Mohanty.

p: Braja Pradhan produced the film and wrote its story. Bijay Mishra wrote the dialogue, and Basant Sahu prepared the screenplay. Samba Siva Rao was the cinematographer and Deben Mishra the editor. Swarup Nayak, Jayiram Samal, Braja Singh and Sreelekha were also in the cast.

Swarup Nayak composed the music and was one of the lyricists, along with Purnendu Das Kanungo and Sachi Mohanty. Srikant Das, Gita Das, Ira Mohanty, Ghanashyam Panda, Payal Panda and T. Souri were among the singers.

Q141568581.lead: Dancing Star is a 2024 Odia-language feature film directed by Bobby Islam and produced by Pradeep Kumar Sahu and Pradyumna Lenka. It was released on an OTT platform.

p: Sudharag Banerjee wrote the story and screenplay, and Alok Ray wrote the dialogue. Dhrubananda Panda handled the cinematography and Kunal Raul the editing. The cast included Sailendra Samantray, Sayal Mukherjee, Naina Das, Jina Samal, Badal Mohanty, Manoj Panda, Ratan Meher, Babi Mishra, Shakti Baral, Bibhu Dixit, Rahul and Srikruti.
Asad Nizam composed the music.
It premiered on the Kanchalanka OTT service on 14 June 2024.

Q56070669.lead: Babu Parsuram is a 2000 Odia-language feature film directed by Jyoti Prakash and produced by Raj Kishore Pradhan, starring Bijay Mohanty and Mihir Das.

p: Bijay Mishra wrote the story and dialogue, with Braja Pradhan also credited for the story, and Jyoti Prakash wrote the screenplay. Dilip Ray was the cinematographer and Biswanath Rao the editor. The cast also included Namrata Das, Priyanka Mahapatra, Sritam Das, Mama Mishra, Ilu Banerjee, Debu Bose, Pradyumna Lenka, Rekha Rao, Tandra Ray, Jayiram Samal and Kuna Tripathy.
Swarup Nayak directed the music, and the songs were written by Bijay Mishra, Bijay Malla and Swarup Nayak.

Q68822369.lead: Love Twist is a 2019 Odia-language feature film written and directed by Sachidananda Samal, with Dev and Manasmita in the lead roles.

p: Ananta Kumar Samal produced the film, and Sachidananda Samal wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue. Ghanashyam Rout was the cinematographer and Soumya Sobhan Nayak the editor. Mihir Das, Pragya Khatua, Pushpa Panda, Kalicharan Acharya and Pintu Nanda played other roles.
Sushil Dalai composed the music to lyrics by Bapu Goswami and Nirmal Nayak. Humane Sagar, Bishnumohan Kabi, Asima Panda, Sanju and Tariq Aziz were among the singers.
The film was released on 27 September 2019.

Q33113334.lead: Nijhu Ratira Sathi is a 2017 Odia-language feature film directed by Sanjay Nayak, starring Jyoti Ranjan Nayak and Tamanna Vyas.

p: Santosh Kumar Singh and Anam Charan Sahu produced the film, with Santosh Kumar Singh supplying the story and Sanjay Nayak writing the screenplay. Chandan also had a leading part, and Premananda Parida, Pallavi, Suman, Kuna Tripathy and Biju Badajena appeared in other roles. Actress Sonali made her screen debut in the film.
Malay Mishra composed the music and Arun Mantri wrote the songs. Humane Sagar, Prafulla Behera, Ira Mohanty and Anju were among the singers.
The film was released on 1 January 2017.

Q42178096.lead: Mu Gote Dusta Pila is a 2017 Odia-language feature film written and directed by Ashok Mallick, who also acted in it alongside Dusmanta Panda and Jhansi.

p: Jharan Mallick and Suraj Kumar produced the film. Ashok Mallick wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue. Pradeep and Subham handled the cinematography and Ashok Sharma the editing. Dibya, Rani, Asit Pati, Banamali Pandia, Thin, Braja Singh and Devi Barik were also in the cast.
Bidyadhar Sahu composed the music, with songs written by Mohit Chakraborty and Alok Dev. The singers included Nandita Bhanja, Sanju Mohanty, Monalisa, Sourav, Pradeep Palai and Madhab.
The film was released on 10 November 2017.

Q54257371.lead: Kala Chakra is a 1999 Odia-language feature film directed by Rajat Paikaray, starring Siddhanta Mahapatra, Priyanka Trivedi, Hara Patnaik, Jayiram Samal and Uttam Mohanty.

p: Subash Rath produced the film, wrote its story and acted in it. Subodh Pattnaik wrote the dialogue and Rajat Paikaray the screenplay. S. Gopal Reddy was the cinematographer and A. Sreekar Prasad the editor. Jayashree and Piali also appeared.

Bidyadhar Sahu directed the music. Sirshananda Das Kanungo, Nizam and Subodh Pattnaik were among the lyricists, and the singers included Gita Dash, Ghanashyam Das, Trupti Das, Kavita Krishnamurthy and Sonu Nigam.

Q54513095.lead: Pati Patni is a 1978 Odia-language feature film directed by M. S. Koti Reddy, featuring Sarat Pujari, Uttam Mohanty, Bijay Mohanty and Mahasweta Ray.

p: D. D. Ahalya produced the film. The story was by K. S. Narayan, while Brundaban Jena wrote the screenplay and dialogue. Tandra Ray, Netrananda Mishra, Pira Mishra, Jayiram Samal, Gita Rani, Roja Ramani and Bijay Bani were also in the cast.
Ramesh Naidu composed the music, and Brundaban Jena also wrote the songs. Akshaya Mohanty and S. Janaki were among the playback singers.

Q20890736.lead: Anuradha is a 1980 Odia-language feature film directed by Sashidhar and produced by Raghu Misra, who also wrote its story.

p: Raghunath Mishra wrote the screenplay and dialogue, and Radhakrishna was the cinematographer. The cast included Surya Mishra, Jaya B., Roja Ramani, Shyamalendu Bhattacharya, Namrata Das, Narendra Kumar Behera, Mamina, Ramachandra Pratihari, Raghu Misra, Mamata and Mohan Rath.
Basudeba Rath was the music director and Surendra Bidyadhar wrote the songs. Raghunath Pradhan was among the singers.

Q119889711.lead: Mukhagni is a 2023 Odia-language feature film directed by Biswaranjan Mohanty, with a cast led by Manoj Panda, Priyanka Mahapatra and Dusmanta Panda.

p: The story was written by Subasini Mohanty and Itishree Samapika Samal, and Priyabrata Panda wrote the screenplay and dialogue. Dilip Kumar Rout was the cinematographer. Krishna Kar, Shweta Acharya and Subham were also in the cast.
Ranjan composed the music and Priyabrata Panda wrote the songs.
The film had a special release at Jayadev Bhawan in Bhubaneswar on 27 March 2023.

Q20890863.lead: Raja Harishchandra is a 1984 Odia-language feature film written for the screen and directed by C. S. R. Rao, featuring Chakrapani and Sujata Anand.

p: Niramarthi Padmakshi produced the film and Bhanja Kishore Pattnaik wrote the dialogue. S. Parthasarathy was the cinematographer and Harinarayan Madhu the editor. Jaya B., Narendra Behera, Jayiram Samal, Ashok Chakraborty, Roja Ramani, Shyamalendu Bhattacharya, Mamina, Baliyar Singh, Dilip and Swapna completed the cast.
The songs were written by Surendra Bidyadhar and Sibabrata Das and sung by Vani Jairam, S. Janaki and Tansen Singh, among others.
The film was released on 16 March 1984.

Q16826520.lead: Akhire Akhire is a 2014 Odia-language feature film directed by Sushant Mani and a remake of the Telugu film Ishq. Babushaan and Jhillik Bhattacharya played the leads.

p: The film was made under the Sarthak Films banner, with Bijay Kandoi credited as producer. Siddharth Agrawal wrote the story and Srikant Gautam the dialogue, while Sushant Mani wrote the screenplay and edited the film himself. Sitanshu Mahapatra was the cinematographer. Siddhanta Mahapatra, Samaresh Routray, Harihar Mahapatra, Bijay Mohanty and Aparajita Mohanty were also in the cast.
Malay Mishra composed the music, and the playback singers included Nibedita, Pankaj Jal and Babul Supriyo.
It was released on 1 January 2014.

Q68956528.lead: Dekha Hela Prema Hela is a 2019 Odia-language feature film directed by T. Ganesh, with Abhishek Rath, Ragini and Subhasis Sharma in the lead roles.

p: Ramesh Barik produced the film and wrote its story, and Ajay Samal wrote the dialogue. R. Bhagat was the cinematographer. Pradyumna Lenka, Pratibha Panda and Jojo appeared in supporting roles.
S. Chandrakant composed the music to lyrics by Nirmal Nayak and Arun Mantri. Humane Sagar, Diptirekha Padhi, Swayam Padhi, Arpita, Jyotirmayee and Bishnumohan Kabi were among the singers.
The film was released on 27 September 2019.

Q112176964.lead: Love Fever is a 2022 Odia-language feature film directed by Chandan Jena, starring Rajbir Shankar Deo and Bandana Paramanik.

p: Sachikanta Jena and Bini Pattnaik produced the film under the Moon TV banner. Sachikanta Jena wrote the story, Chinmay Das Pattnaik the dialogue, and Chandan Jena the screenplay. Ajit and Pradeep handled the cinematography and Rajesh Dash the editing. Asit Pati, Pintu Nanda, Pushpa Panda, Minaketan and Asrumochan Mohanty played supporting roles.
Prashant Pal composed the music.
The film was released on 20 May 2022.

Q141452860.lead: Sinduraa is a 2024 Odia-language feature film directed by Biranchi Narayan Panda and produced by Shanti Swarup Satapathy, starring Supriya Nayak and Abhishek Giri.

p: Biranchi Narayan Panda wrote the story, and Bijay Das wrote the screenplay and dialogue and also acted in the film. Narayan Dixit was the cinematographer and Jitendra Jena the editor. The cast also included Usasi Misra, Prithviraj Nayak, Sankar Pradhan, Pragya Khatua, Priyanka Pattnaik, Pramod Rath, Chandradhwaja Panda, Commander Pradeep Routray, Pradeep Sahu, Sandhya Das and Saregama.
Prem Anand composed the music, and Bijay Das wrote the songs.
It opened in cinemas on 5 April 2024.

Q5772247.lead: Hisab Nikas is a 1982 Odia-language feature film written, produced and directed by Prashant Nanda. It was the first CinemaScope film made in Odia cinema.

p: Prashant Nanda also took a leading role, acting alongside Sriram Panda, Mahasweta Ray, Jharana Das, Biren Routray and Deepa Sahu. Hemant Das and Mohammad Mohsin were also in the cast.
Prafulla Kar arranged the music.

facts: First CinemaScope film in Odia cinema

Q41774498.lead: Mu Aashiq Mu Awara is a 2013 Odia-language feature film written and directed by S. K. Muralidharan, with Sunil Kumar and Megha Ghosh in the lead roles.

p: Sukant Sahu produced the film. S. K. Muralidharan wrote the story and screenplay, and Deepak Jena wrote the dialogue. Ajit Kumar Das was the cinematographer and Rajat Ghadei the editor. Samaresh Routray, Harihara Mohapatra, Jayiram Samal, Salil Mitra, Bhagaban Behera, Chunga, Bijay Mohanty, Jiban Panda, Tandra Ray and Trupti Sinha played other roles.
Bikash Shukla was the music director.
The film was released on 8 February 2013.

Q110636877.lead: Lalpan Bibi Ra Smart Family is a 2019 Odia-language feature film directed by Ashwini Gadanayak that premiered on television, with Mahasweta Ray, Mihir Das and Ankit Kumar in the lead roles.

p: Jagi Mangat Panda produced the film under the Tarang Cine Productions banner. Debidutta Mohanty wrote the dialogue. Rajanikanta Barik was the cinematographer and Chandrasekhar Mishra the editor. Devika Arundhati Samal, Jyoti Prakash Panda, Braja Singh, Prithviraj Nayak, Lila Mishra, Tiki Rath, Siddharth, Rupashree and Krishna were also in the cast.
Sarat Nayak and Saroj Samal composed the music, and Debidutta Mohanty wrote the songs.
It was first shown on 24 November 2019.

Q140836475.lead: Adrushya is a 2025 Odia-language feature film written and directed by Satya Narayan Sahoo, featuring Abhishek Giri, Lipsa Mishra and Sayal Mukherjee.

p: Sunanda Sahu and Rajesh Agrawal produced the film. Satya Narayan Sahoo wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue, and S. Ranjan was the cinematographer. Choudhury Jayprakash Das, Jiban Panda, Anant Mishra and Nilamani Sahu were also in the cast.
Malay Mishra composed the music to lyrics by Arun Mantri. Ira Mohanty, Swayam Padhi and Satyajit Pradhan were among the singers.
It opened in cinemas on 17 January 2025.

Q117764162.lead: Parikaribe Bhola Sankara 2 is a 2023 Odia-language feature film directed by Mrutyunjay Sahoo, starring Rakesh Deo and Lipika Senapati. It premiered on television.

p: Sunil Kumar Pattnaik and Mrutyunjay Sahoo produced the film, and Priyabrata wrote the story. Lipika Senapati played Aparna, and Pradyumna Lenka, Kedar Mishra and Somu appeared in supporting roles.
Prasant Padhi composed the music and Nirmal Nayak wrote the lyrics. Antara Chakraborty, Swayam Padhi and Satyajit Pradhan were among the singers.
It premiered on Zee Sarthak on 9 April 2023.

Q140341771.lead: Mo Suna Bhaunii is a 2025 Odia-language feature film directed by Kailash Mahapatra, with Sudarshan Sahu and Hiranmayee Das in the lead roles. It premiered on television and streaming.

p: The film was produced by Tarang Films, and its story and screenplay were developed by an in-house Tarang team. Sanjay and Raju handled the cinematography and Dev the editing. Lovereen Khanam, Soumya, Somesh, Krishna Kar, Gunda, P. K. Sadangi, Jagadish Mishra and Nirban Sadangi were also in the cast.
Santosh Kumar composed the music and wrote the songs, with Somnath and Soujanya among the singers.
It premiered on Tarang TV and Tarang Plus on 17 August 2025.

Q39172526.lead: Haribol Nuhe Tanka Bol is a 2014 Odia-language feature film directed by Krishna Prasad, with Chunga and Kalpana in the lead roles.

p: Srinibas produced the film and wrote its story, while Bijay Mohanty wrote the dialogue and Krishna Prasad the screenplay. Subhendu was the cinematographer. Anant Mishra, Salil Mitra, Pintu Nanda, Akash Dasnayak, Jiban Panda, Samaresh Routray, Jayiram Samal and Trupti Sinha completed the cast.
The music was directed jointly by Bhanu and Anshuman.
The film was released on 1 May 2014.

Q115786317.lead: Mukha is a 2022 Odia-language film directed by Sudhanshu Mohan Sahu that premiered on television, with Jagjit Pal and Arlin Ankita in the lead roles.

p: Sanjeev Dwivedi produced the film. B. Chandan Kumar wrote the story and screenplay, and Jitendra Baral wrote the dialogue. Somio was the cinematographer and Rajesh Dash the editor. Pintu Nanda, Manaswini, Tribhuban Panda, Bapi, Daisy and Debasish were among the supporting cast.
Bishnu Mohan Kabi composed the music, and lyricists including Tapu Nayak and Debidutta Mohanty wrote the songs.
The film premiered on Tarang TV and Tarang Plus on 11 December 2022.

Q140594091.lead: Pade Akasha is a 2025 Odia-language film directed by Sushant Mani and produced by Litisha Mangat Panda, with Archita Sahu, Hara Rath and Smita Mohanty in the cast.

p: Biplab Singh and Debidutta Mohanty wrote the screenplay, and Bharadwaj Panda wrote the dialogue. Subhranshu Das and Falgu Satapathy handled the cinematography, and Sukumar Mani edited the film. Rajesh Jais, Ankit Kumar, Mohan Majithia, Madhumita and Bijayalaxmi also appeared.
Prem Anand composed the music. Bijay Malla wrote the songs, and Sashank Sekhar sang them.
The film opened in cinemas on 11 April 2025.

Q15724730.lead: Batasi Jhada is a 1981 Odia-language film directed by Ramesh Mohanty and produced by Aarati Das, starring Akshaya Mohanty (Kashyap), Jaya and Dukhiram Swain. Salil Chowdhury composed its music.

p: Ramesh Mohanty wrote the story together with Satyabrata Mohanty, while Bijay Mishra wrote the screenplay and dialogue. Ashok Swain was the cinematographer and Asim Basu the art director. The cast also included Kasi Rath, Narendra Kumar Behera, Radha Panda, Pushpa Panda, Madhumita and Runu Parija.
Salil Chowdhury was the music director, with songs by lyricists including Ramesh Jena and Atul Mahakud. Sikandar Alam, Lila Ghosh, Hemlata and K. J. Yesudas were among the playback singers.

Q119889693.lead: Dhoka – The Game of Love is a 2023 Odia-language film directed by Tripati Sahu that premiered on television, starring Subhasis Sharma, Cookies Swain and Abhipsa Bhanja.

p: Khirod Pattnaik produced the film and Rajani Ranjan wrote the dialogue. Prithviraj Nayak and Jagannath Sahu appeared in supporting roles.
Abhijit Majumdar composed the music and Nirmal Nayak wrote the lyrics. Bishnu Mohan Kabi, Antara Chakraborty, Amrita Nayak and S. Jitu were among the singers.
The film premiered on the Zee Sarthak channel on 7 May 2023.

Q140421204.lead: I Am Kalia is a 2025 Odia-language film directed by Harihara Mohapatra, who also plays one of the leads opposite Aniya Andriva.

p: Subas Chandra Sahu produced the film. Monalisa Mahapatra wrote the story, and Harihara Mohapatra wrote the screenplay and dialogue as well as directing. Kahnu Nanda was the cinematographer. Kuna Tripathy, Pushpa Panda and Satyaki Misra were part of the supporting cast.
Baidyanath Dash composed the music. Humane Sagar, Asima Panda, Kuldeep Pattnaik, Pragyan Hota and Sricharan Mohanty were among the singers.
The film opened in cinemas on 11 July 2025, the day of Bahuda.

Q55455108.lead: Sagara Ganga is a 1994 Odia-language film directed by Raju Misra and produced by Bijay Mishra, starring Rachna Banerjee, Sarat Pujari and Dukhiram Swain. It was Rachna Banerjee's first Odia film.

p: Bijay Mishra, the producer, also wrote the story. Raju Misra wrote the screenplay and dialogue, shot the film himself and edited it with A. Sanjeev. Anoop Misra, Raimohan Parida, Jayiram Samal, Sujata Anand, Geeta Rao, Debu Bose and Ashok were also in the cast.
Radhakrishna Bhanja composed the music, and Sadhana Sargam was among the playback singers.

Q140933712.lead: Dori Lagichhi Kalia Pakhe is a 2026 Odia-language film directed by Amaresh Pati that premiered on television and OTT, with Isha, Bikram Keshari Mohanty, Namrata Das and Arpan Mishra in the cast.

p: Sanjeev Dwivedi produced the film, and Sunil Kumar Parida wrote the screenplay and dialogue. Tapas edited it. Likun, Bhakti, Ani, Papu, Priyanka, Gunjan Jayaram, Hapu and Rashmi Ranjan were also in the cast.
Prakash Chandra Jena wrote the songs. The music director is given as Binayak Panda in one place and as Sarbeswar Das in another.
The film premiered on Tarang TV and Tarang Plus on 19 July 2026.

Q109519697.lead: Premikaya Namah is a 2021 Odia-language film directed by Sudhakar Vasant that premiered on television, with Rishi, Tanushree and Sayal in the lead roles.

p: Sushil Kumar Sahu produced the film and Deepak Jena wrote the dialogue. R. Bhagat Singh was the cinematographer and Ranjan Khatei the editor. Pintu Nanda, Tribhuban Panda, Namita Das, Aishwarya, Somu, Amar, Sura, Bitu, Gyan and Ayush were also in the cast.

Vighnanj Band composed the music, and Nirmal Nayak, Tapu Nayak and Debidutta Mohanty wrote the lyrics. Satyajit Pradhan, Asima Panda, Ashutosh Mahapatra, Nabhya Jyoti and Tariq Aziz were among the singers.
The film premiered on Tarang TV and Tarang Plus on 12 September 2021.

Q28953228.lead: The End is a 2017 Odia-language ghost story film directed by T. Ganesh and produced by Satyakanta Sahu, with Ashwini Tripathy and Priti in the lead roles.

p: Satyakanta Sahu supplied the story, T. Ganesh wrote the screenplay and Ajay Samal is credited as writer. Priyaranjan Parija was the cinematographer. Manoj Mishra and Illu Banarjee had prominent parts, with Babu, Suraj Tripathy, Rabi, Megha, Kabita, Pooja, RK and Prashant also in the cast.

S. Chandrakant was the music director. The songs were written by Nirmal Nayak, Jayant Das, N. Garudatta, Dr. Subha Kumar, Bibhuti Swain and Dibyalochan, and sung by Humane Sagar, Prince, Shraddha, Ipsita, Sangram, Bijay Kumar and Pintu, among others.
The film was released on 10 February 2017.

Q141016544.lead: Line Bala is a 2026 Odia-language film directed by Niranjan Behera and produced by Sushant Mohanty, with Sambit Acharya, Swapna Priyadarshini, Asrumochan Mohanty and Debu Brahma in the cast.

p: Sushant Mohanty also wrote the story, while Niranjan Behera wrote the screenplay and dialogue. Subhankar was the cinematographer and Rajesh Das the editor. Suman Maharana, Priti Ranjan and Biju Badajena were among the other actors.
Baidyanath Dash composed the music and Nirmal Nayak wrote the lyrics. Satyajit Pradhan sang for the film.
The film opened in cinemas on 10 July 2026.

Q45117711.lead: Tate Bhala Pauchi Boli is a 2010 Odia-language film directed by Prashant Kumar and produced by Narasingha Lal Agarwal, with Debasish Patra and Koel Banerjee in the lead roles.

p: Pratibha Panda wrote the story and Chinmay Das Pattnaik the dialogue, while Prashant Kumar prepared the screenplay in addition to directing. Aparajita Mohanty, Mihir Das, Jayiram Samal, Kuna Tripathy, Babi Mishra, Biren Mishra and Rabi Mishra were in the supporting cast.
Prem Anand composed the music.
The film was released on 17 September 2010.

Q61948584.lead: Rangila Bohu is a 2019 Odia-language television film produced and directed by actor Sritam Das, with Lipsa Mishra and Debasish Patra in the lead roles.

p: Rajani Ranjan wrote the dialogue. Niranjan Das was the cinematographer and Chandra Sekhar Mishra the editor. Usasi Misra, Pintu Nanda, Madhusmita Pradhan and Sankarshan Pradhan were in the supporting cast, and Prasiddhi Nayak appeared as a child artist.
Debitosh Acharya composed the music and Panchanan Nayak wrote the songs.
The film premiered on television on 24 February 2019.
At the 8th Tele Awards, Lipsa Mishra won Best Actress, Madhusmita Pradhan Best Supporting Actress, Sankarshan Pradhan Best Comedian and Prasiddhi Nayak Best Child Artist.

Q54371825.lead: Kabi Samrat Upendra Bhanja is a 1978 Odia-language film directed by N. Gopalakrishna and written by Raghu Mishra, starring Uttam Mohanty, Sarat Pujari and Mahasweta Ray.

p: Raghu Mishra was responsible for the story, screenplay and dialogue, and also acted in the film. Rabi Shankar Pattnaik and S. V. Raman edited it. Roja Ramani, Narendra Kumar Behera, Chakrapani, Nirmala Das, Bhola, Jyotsna, Raju Misra, Bhagaban Pradhan and Rabi Ray were among the rest of the cast. The film runs 139 minutes.
Bhikari Bal and Upendra Kumar jointly composed the music.

Q141445364.lead: Mitali Apa is a 2024 Odia-language television film directed by Prasanta Lenka and produced by Rabindranath Panda, with Sritam Das, Asit Patra and Mahima Das in the cast.

p: Bijayalaxmi Panda wrote the story, and Rajani Ranjan wrote the screenplay and dialogue. Bibhu Dash and R. Bhagat Singh were the cinematographers. Sonam Das, Krishna Kar, Manisha Rath, Rafiq, Tapan Jena, Narayan Das, Rajani and Sudhanshu also appeared.
Agniraj Kishore composed the music and Prabin Kumar wrote the songs.
The film was broadcast on Alankar TV on 29 March 2024.

Q52768636.lead: Wrong Number is a 2002 Odia-language film written and directed by Bobby Islam and produced by Prafulla Chandra Mahapatra, with Mihir Das, Sritam Das and Pintu Nanda among its cast.

p: Alok Ray wrote the story, and Bobby Islam wrote the screenplay and dialogue. Niranjan Das was the cinematographer and Chandrasekhar Mishra the editor. Jyoti Mishra, Hara Patnaik, Saroj Das, Pradyumna Lenka, Suresh Bal, Rabi Mishra, Monalisa and Banamali Pandia were also in the cast.
Shantiraj Khosla composed the music and Giridhar Gamang wrote the songs. Bibhu Kishore and Nasir were among the singers.

Q60195446.lead: Jibanara Chalapathe is a 2018 Odia-language film directed by Dilip Mohanty and produced by Barshabhabana Khatua and Aditi Das.

p: Soumyakanta Khandayi wrote the story and dialogue, and Dilip Mohanty wrote the screenplay. Gopal Krushna Sahu shot the film and Deben Mishra edited it. The cast included Krishna, Pooja, Rocky, Soni, Padma Bastia, Saubhagini Mahapatra and Khandayi himself.
Soumyakanta Khandayi composed the music and wrote the songs. Abhijit Majumdar, Arabinda Dutta, Namita Mohanty and Khandayi were among the singers.
The film was released on 14 December 2018.

Q99434246.lead: Kanha is a 1997 Odia-language film directed by N. Ram Babu and produced by Trinath Gaud and Udayanath Choudhury, starring Uttam Mohanty and Aparajita Mohanty.

p: N. Ram Babu wrote the story and screenplay, with Baladev Panigrahi credited as writer. Samba Siva Rao was the cinematographer and Deben Mishra the editor. Jayiram Samal, Asit Pati, Suresh Bal, Munna Khan, Mita Chakraborty, Kuni Mishra, Mamina and Manoj Padhi were among the supporting cast.

Basudeba Rath composed the music. Banabihari Panda, Bipin Mahapatra, Raghunath Rout and Soumitra Chatterjee wrote the songs, and the singers included Sekhar Ghosh, Laxmikant Palit, Srikant Das, Tansen Singh, Lopita Mishra and Nandita Bhanja.
The film was released on 25 May 1997.

Q55447898.lead: Subhadra is a 1995 Odia-language film directed by V. Prabhakar and produced by Basudev Tripathy, starring Siddhanta Mahapatra, Rachna Banerjee, Bijay Mohanty, Uttam Mohanty and Aparajita Mohanty.

p: Basudev Tripathy supplied the story and Ramesh Panigrahi the dialogue. V. Prabhakar wrote the screenplay and also worked as cinematographer, while K. Rabindra Babu edited the film. Jayiram Samal, Kanta Singh, Mamina and Rukmani rounded out the cast.
Swarup Nayak composed the music and wrote the songs. Trupti Das, H. P. Gupta, Debashish Mahapatra and Nayak himself were among the singers.

Q38510937.lead: Rock Star is a 2015 Odia-language film written and directed by Kumar Saroj and produced by Manoranjan Pal, with Bulu and Punam Mishra in the lead roles.

p: The film was made under the Manoranjan Films and Entertainment banner. Kumar Saroj wrote the story and screenplay, and Ajay Samal wrote the dialogue. Pragyan Khatua and Pushpa Panda appeared in supporting roles.
S. Chandrakant was the music director and Arun Mantri wrote the songs. Kumar Bapi and Antara Chakraborty were among the singers.
The film was released on 22 May 2015.

Q110737187.lead: Four is a 2022 Odia-language film directed by Abhishek Swain and released on an OTT platform, with Partha Sarathi Ray, Satya Ranjan, Prasanjeet Mohapatra, Swastik Choudhury and Riya Resham Bori in the cast.

p: Kaushik Das and Ram Pattnaik produced the film. Abhishek Swain wrote the screenplay and shares the story credit. Soumyaraj Nayak was the cinematographer and Biswajit Paital the editor. Ashwini Ray Mahapatra, Nitya Prakash Swain and Kalki Krishna were also in the cast.
Kislay Ray composed the music.
The film was released on the OTT platform Aao Nxt on 28 January 2022.

Q119889706.lead: Suka Bhaira Sholay is a 2023 Odia-language film written and directed by Snehasis Das and produced by Kaushik Das, released on an OTT platform.

p: Snehasis Das wrote the story. Srikanta Pattnaik was the cinematographer and Saroj Raul the editor. The cast included Satya Ranjan, Anubha Sourya, Sukanta Rath, Choudhury Jayprakash Das, Dharitri Khandual, Pranab Prasanna Rath, Sasadhar Pradhan, Chuni, Sasmita, Madhusudan Mishra and Tripati. The film runs 96 minutes.
The singer Abhijit Mishra composed the music.
The film was released on the OTT platform Aao Nxt on 10 June 2023 and was later dubbed into Bengali.

Q141164686.lead: Kemiti E Samparka is a 2024 Odia-language film directed by Himanshu Parija and produced by Rupesh Kumar Nayak, with Akash Dasnayak, Elina Samantray, Lipsa Mishra and Usasi Misra in the cast.

p: Rupesh Kumar Nayak also wrote the story, and Chinmay Das Pattnaik wrote the dialogue. Kahnu Charan Nanda was the cinematographer and Rajesh Dash the editor.

Abhijit Majumdar composed the music and Nirmal Nayak wrote the lyrics. The singers included Swayam Padhi, Sohini Mishra, Satyajit Pradhan, Subhalaxmi Dash, Antara Chakraborty, Mrunmay MS and Basabha Dutta.
The film opened in cinemas on 9 February 2024.

Q136094359.lead: Misiri is a 2025 Odia-language film directed by Sisir Kumar Sahu and Peenakee Singh and produced by Nirmal Jaiswal, with Biswajit Rout, Rupashree Panda, Prasanjeet Mohapatra, Shakti Baral and Pushpa Panda in the cast.

p: Amit Kumar Dash wrote the story and screenplay. Rudrakanta Singh was the cinematographer and Rashmi Ranjan Das the editor.

The music was composed by Abhishek Rajput, Ishan Sharma, Kaushik and Dhichen Nayak, with lyrics by J. P. Wordsmith and Prabhas Jena. Arpita Choudhury, Prabhas Jena, Swayam Padhi and Kuldeep Pattnaik were among the singers.
The film was released on 7 February 2025.

Q46841525.lead: Chup Kie Asuchi is a 2009 Odia-language film written and directed by Biswa Bhusan Mohapatra and produced by Mamata Rath and Mohan Kumar Sahu.

p: Biswa Bhusan Mohapatra was responsible for the story, screenplay and dialogue, and also served as cinematographer; Ajay Mishra edited the film. The cast included Sunil Kumar, Anubhav Mohanty, Harihara Mohapatra, Shakti Misra, Bhranti, Biswajit, Jaya Biswas, Subrat Nayak, Sonal, Samar Tripathy and Subhransu Nayak.
Goodly Rath and Biswa Bhusan Mohapatra composed the music together.
The film was released on 5 June 2009.

Q109519713.lead: Jungle is a 2021 Odia-language film written and directed by T. Ganesh, with Suraj and Ahana Baral in the lead roles.

p: The film was made under the Payal Film Entertainment Production and Krishna Films banners. T. Ganesh wrote the story and screenplay, and Nirmala Panda wrote the dialogue. Priyaranjan Parija was the cinematographer and Jayant Kumar Panda the editor. Illu Banarjee, Saroj Das and Rabi Mishra appeared in supporting roles.
S. Chandrakant composed the music. Lyricists including Nirmala Panda and N. Guru Datta wrote the songs, and Jyotirmayee and Amrita Nayak were among the singers.
The film was released on 9 April 2021.

Q139834191.lead: Bideha is a 2026 Odia-language film written and directed by Biyot Projna Tripathy and produced by Bedayan Tripathy, with Kajal Satapathy, Usasi Misra and Sukanta Rath in the cast.

p: The film was made under the Twenty Four January Production banner. Biyot Projna Tripathy wrote the story and screenplay and shared the dialogue credit with Debadas Chhotray. Dhrubananda Panda was the cinematographer and Rajesh Dash the editor. Gaurav Mohanty, Daisy and Elina Kaushik Mahapatra were also in the cast.
Sarat Nayak composed the music, and Debadas Chhotray and Biyot Projna Tripathy wrote the songs.
The film opened in cinemas on 15 May 2026.

Q109519712.lead: Oyee Guitar is a 2021 Odia-language film written, directed and scored by Appu Kanungo, with Aman and Ahana Baral in the lead roles.

p: Appu Kanungo wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue as well as directing and composing the music. Aman played Drupad and Ahana Baral played Sangeeta, with Guddu, Debu Pattnaik, Jiban Panda, Choudhury Jayprakash Das, RJ Guddi and Namita Das in other roles. Ajit was the cinematographer and Chandrasekhar Mishra the editor.
The film opened in several towns across Odisha on 14 April 2021, timed for Pana Sankranti.

Q114804714.lead: Ei Rakhi To Rakhya Kabacha is a 2022 Odia-language television film directed by Sanjay Nayak and produced by actress Lipsa Mishra and Khirod Pattnaik, with Rishi and Ananya in the lead roles.

p: S. Ranjan was the cinematographer and Ranjan Khatei the editor. The lead actor Rishi is also credited as Pradeep Kumar Sahoo. Rajdeep, Bikram Mohanty, Sonakshi and Swaraj Pati were in the supporting cast.

Baidyanath Dash composed the music, with songs by lyricists including Nihari Priyasish and Subha Das. Kumar Bapi, Antara Chakraborty, Humane Sagar, Neha Niharika, Sital Kabi and Subhasish Sahu were among the singers.
The film premiered on the Zee Sarthak channel on 21 August 2022.

Q43548621.lead: Maa Khoje Mamata is a 2011 Odia-language film written and directed by Kshamanidhi Mishra and produced by Bajrang Bansal, with Lokesh Diwang and Rali Nanda in the lead roles.

p: Kshamanidhi Mishra wrote the story and screenplay, while Ranjit Pattnaik wrote the dialogue. Srimanta Barik edited the film. Babi Mishra, Mihir Das, Jayiram Samal, Sudhanshu Dwivedi and Shakti were in the supporting cast.
Prafulla Behera composed the music, and Panchanan Nayak, Nizam, Arun Mantri and Jatindra Pradhan wrote the songs.
The film was released on 16 September 2011.

Q112603726.lead: Eka Tu Eka Mun is a 2022 Odia-language television film directed by Sudhanshu Mohan Sahu and produced by Sitaram Agarwal, with Siddhanta Mahapatra and Anu Choudhury in the lead roles.

p: Nirmal Nayak wrote the dialogue. Dhrubananda Panda was the cinematographer and Rajesh Dash the editor. Pradyumna Lenka and Bhupati Tripathy were in the supporting cast.
Manmath Mishra composed the music and Srikant Gautam wrote the songs. Humane Sagar, Namita Agarwal and Sourav Nayak were among the singers.
The film premiered on Sidharth TV on 14 June 2022.

Q26963237.lead: Sweet Heart is a 2016 Odia-language film directed by Sushant Mani, starring Babushaan Mohanty, Anu Choudhury and Samaresh Routray.

p: Nilakantha Das and Sunanda Dash produced the film, and Sushant Mani wrote the story, with Bapu Goswami credited as writer. Babushaan played a young Pakistani man, his first role as a terrorist, while Anu Choudhury played a journalist and Samaresh Routray took the villain's part. Anubha Sourya, Aparajita Mohanty, Bijay Mohanty, Mihir Das and Chakradhar Jena were also in the cast.

Goodly Rath composed the music for the film's five songs, which were written by Bapu Goswami and Mukesh Singh. The singers were Nabhya, Bibhu Kishore, Tapu Mishra, Ratikant Satapathy, the Hindi playback singer Javed Ali and Indu Sonali; Tapu Mishra and Javed Ali sang the title song.
The film was released on 18 August 2016.

Q57082645.lead: Rama Balarama is a 1980 Odia-language film directed by A. Sanjeevi and produced by Purnachandra Rao Atluri, starring Uttam Mohanty, Anita Das and Deepa Sahu.

p: Nasar Raju wrote the story and Gobinda Senapati the dialogue. A. Sanjeevi prepared the screenplay and edited the film in addition to directing it, and T. H. Rama Rao was the cinematographer. Biren Routray, Radha Panda, Gloria Mohanty, Mamina, Sujata, Rukmani, Ananga Dwivedi and Sudharani Jena were also in the cast.
Prafulla Kar composed the music and wrote the songs. S. Janaki, Chitta Jena and Pranab Pattnaik were among the singers.
The film was released on 19 September 1980.

Q15724192.lead: Topae Sindura Dipata Shankha is a 1989 Odia-language film directed by J. H. Sattar and produced by Sujit Kumar, starring Uttam Mohanty, Aparajita Mohanty, Bijay Mohanty and Tandra Ray.

p: Keshav Rathod wrote the story and screenplay, and Bijay Mishra the dialogue. Surendra Sahu was the cinematographer and Rabi Shankar Pattnaik the editor. The budget is given as ₹55.32 lakh. Jharana Das, Aruna Irani, producer Sujit Kumar, Jayiram Samal, Tapas Paul, Sudharani Jena, Runu Parija, Prithviraj, Dhira Mallick, Nityananda Mishra, Dukhiram Swain and Byomkesh Tripathy were also in the cast.
Sumitra Lahari was the music director, and Trupti Das and Badal Kumar were among the singers.

Q55725969.lead: Loot Taraj is a 1989 Odia-language film produced, written, directed and scored by Prashanta Nanda, who also starred in it alongside Sriram Panda, Prithviraj Nayak and Baishali Parida.

p: Prashanta Nanda handled the story, screenplay and dialogue as well as production and direction, and co-edited the film with A. Sreekar Prasad. V. Prabhakar was the cinematographer. Pratibha Sahu, Ajit Das, Tushar Panigrahi, Ranjit, Braja Singh, Mamina, Sankar Basu Mallick and Munu Pati were in the supporting cast.
Nanda also composed the music and wrote the songs. Geeta Dash, Subash Das, Trupti Das, Debashish Mahapatra, Raghunath Pradhan and Rosy were among the singers.

Q109519695.lead: Rangila Bohu 2 is a 2021 Odia-language television film directed by Ashwini Garnayak and produced by Surya Rath, with Debasish Patra, Lipsa Mishra and Usasi Misra in the lead roles.

p: Alok Ray wrote the story and screenplay, and Saranarabinda Ojha wrote the dialogue. Swarna Prasad was the cinematographer and Ranjan Khatei the editor. Choudhury Jayprakash Das and Jojo appeared in supporting roles.
Goodly Rath composed the music and Surya Mahapatra wrote the songs. Humane Sagar, Lipsa Mahapatra and Debanshi were among the singers.
The film premiered on television on 12 September 2021.

Q56559377.lead: Jeebana Sangama is a 1984 Odia-language film directed by Jeeban Mahanta and produced by Arati Mahanta, with Raju Sadhangi, Mala Bose and Radha Panda in the cast.

p: Arati Mahanta wrote the story, Purna Mallick the dialogue and Jeeban Mahanta the screenplay; Mahanta also acted in the film. Rabi Shankar Pattnaik was the editor. Subhra Pati, Jayiram Samal, Prachi Das, Bholanath, Asit Pati, Bijay Singh, Nata Sen, Banku and Basanti were among the other actors.
Santanu Mahapatra composed the music and Gurukrushna Goswami wrote the songs, which were sung by S. Janaki and Debashish Mahapatra.
The film was released on 29 June 1984.

Q56595572.lead: Kati Patanga is a 2019 Odia-language film directed by Kumar Saroj and produced by Debendra Nath Sahu, with Abhishek Rath and Ananya in the lead roles.

p: Madhusmita Das wrote the story, Ajay Samal the dialogue and Kumar Saroj the screenplay. The large supporting cast included R. K., Uttam Mohanty, Rani Priyadarshini, Asit Pati, Ajit Das, Manisha Mishra and Saroj Das.
S. Chandrakant composed the music.
The film was released on 12 April 2019.

Q21201622.lead: Seeta Labkush is a 1980 Odia-language film directed by S. Jagadish Chandra and produced by K. Narayan Rao, with Uttam Mohanty and Aparajita Mohanty in the lead roles. It is an Odia version of a Telugu film.

p: The film was adapted into Odia from Telugu. Umesh Chandra Padhi is credited as writer, while S. Jagadish Chandra prepared the screenplay and edited the film. K. S. Prasad was the cinematographer. Chakrapani Bhatti, Balakrishna Das, Kartik Ghosh, Rajani, Ramakrishna, Roja Ramani, Satyabhama and Subhash were also in the cast.
Prafulla Kar composed the music, and S. Janaki and Swagatika Rath were among the singers.

Q15724340.lead: Dharmara Heba Jay is a 2005 Odia-language film directed by Sanjay Nayak, who co-produced it with Sitaram Pattnaik, starring Siddhanta Mahapatra, Bijay Mohanty and Kajal Mishra.

p: Sanjay Nayak wrote the story and screenplay, and Subodh Pattnaik wrote the dialogue. Ranjan was the cinematographer and Bijay Mishra the editor. Usasi Misra, Anita Das, Akshaya Bastia, Kuna Tripathy and Jayiram Samal were also in the cast.

Malay Mishra composed the music. Lyricists including Basantaraj Samal, Shirshananda Das Kanungo and Arun Mantri wrote the songs, and Kumar Bapi, Sailabhama Mahapatra and Ira Mohanty were among the singers.

Q53084189.lead: Gopare Badhuchi Kalakanhei is a 1994 Odia-language film directed by Sadhu Meher and produced by Bijay Kumar, starring Siddhanta Mahapatra, Rituparna Sengupta, Uttam Mohanty, Aparajita Mohanty and Bijay Mohanty.

p: Ashok Swain was the cinematographer. Mihir Das, Mamina, Asit Pati, Mahasweta Ray, Samaj Pati and Jayiram Samal were in the supporting cast.

Bachu Mukherjee composed the music, with songs by lyricists including Dhira Basa, Sangram Keshari Mohanty and Bijay Kumar. Mohammed Aziz, Kavita Krishnamurthy, Udit Narayan and Anuradha Paudwal were among the playback singers.
The film was released on 21 April 1994.

Q110401131.lead: Sahani Ghara Kahani is a 2022 Odia-language television film directed by Niranjan Behera and produced by actress Lipsa Mishra, who also co-starred with Bulu.

p: Lipsa Mishra wrote the story as well as producing. Dillip Rout was the cinematographer and Rajesh Dash the editor. Mahasweta Ray, Pintu Nanda, Jiban Panda and Guddu were in the supporting cast.
Asad Nizam composed the music and Pushpak Parida wrote the songs. Asima Panda, Ashutosh Sadangi and Kuldeep Pattnaik were among the singers.
The film premiered on the Zee Sarthak channel on 2 January 2022.

Q140231803.lead: Diary is a 2026 Odia-language film directed by Sushant Mani and produced by Ardhendu Sahu, with Ardhendu Sahu, Jasmin Rath and Kuna Tripathy in the cast.

p: Kuna Tripathy wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue and also acted in the film. Sitanshu Mahapatra was the cinematographer and Sukumar Mani the editor. Pragyan Priyadarshini was also in the cast.

Somesh Satapathy composed the music, with songs by lyricists including J. P. Wordsmith and Ranjan Nayak. Satyajit Jena, Ananya Sritam Nanda, Saurav Bharadwaj and Diptirekha Padhi were among the singers.
The film opened in cinemas on 12 June 2026.

Q55817553.lead: Jibana Sathi is a 1997 Odia-language film directed by Jyoti Prakash and produced by Subas Rout, starring Bijay Mohanty, Aparajita Mohanty, Sritam Das and Mihir Das.

p: Pramila Rout wrote the story and Jyoti Prakash the screenplay. Dilip Ray was the cinematographer, and Biswanath Rao and Ashok Sharma edited the film. Manoj Das, Debu Bose, Jayiram Samal, Smita Mohanty, Pradyumna Lenka, Saroj Das, Raimohan Parida, Illu Banarjee, Runu Parija and Priya Karfa were also in the cast.
Saroj Nanda composed the music and Nizam wrote the songs.

Q50220301.lead: De Ma Shakti De is a 2006 Odia-language film directed by Sanjay Nayak and produced by Purnamasi Sahu, starring Siddhanta Mahapatra, Archita Sahu and Chandan Kar.

p: Sanjay Nayak wrote the story and edited the film as well as directing it, and Sanjay is credited as cinematographer. Usasi Misra, Uttam Mohanty, Raimohan Parida, Papu Pom Pom, Debu Bose, Namrata Das and Biju Badajena were in the supporting cast.

Malay Mishra composed the music. The songs were written by lyricists including Basantaraj Samal, Ganeswar Mahapatra, Bijay Malla, Arun Mantri and Nirmal Nayak, and sung by Kumar Bapi, Pankaj Jal, Bibhu Kishore, Malay Mishra and Ira Mohanty, among others.

Q60315789.lead: Kulangar is a 2018 Odia-language television film directed by Ashwini Garnayak and produced by actor Debasish Patra, with Pradeep Kumar Sahoo and Anisha Sharma heading the cast.

p: Bijay Malla wrote the screenplay and dialogue. Rajanikanta Barik was the cinematographer and Tapas Ranjan Behera the editor. Salil Mitra, Monalisa Patra, Asrumochan Mohanty, Sukanta Rath and Ratan Meher were also in the cast.
Sarat Nayak composed the music and sang for the film alongside Antara Chakraborty and Sangram, among others.
The film premiered on the Odia television channel Zee Sarthak on 25 November 2018.

Q140577405.lead: Dustbin is a 2025 Odia-language film written and directed by Papu Pam Pam, who also composed its music and appears in the cast.

p: Kaminikanta Sahu produced the film. Papu Pam Pam was responsible for the story, the screenplay and the direction, and Deepak Jena wrote the dialogue. Kahnu Charan Nanda shot the film and Arun Kumar Padhi edited it.
Papu Pam Pam was the music director. Ranjan Nayak and Deepak Jena were among the lyricists, and the playback singers included Kuldeep Pattanaik, Antara Chakraborty and Debesh Pati.
The film opened in cinemas on 11 April 2025.

Q110680898.lead: To Bina Mun Kichi Chanhe Na is a 2019 Odia-language television film directed by Rajesh Mohanty and starring Rakesh Deo and Manaswini Pati.

p: Jagi Mangad Panda produced the film under the Tarang Cine Productions banner. Rajesh Mohanty wrote the screenplay as well as directing, and Debidutta Mohanty wrote the dialogue. Sudarshan Senapati was the cinematographer and Jyoti Prakash Das the editor.
The music was directed by Sadhanshu Himansh, with lyrics by Saranarabinda Ojha. Sasikanta Nayak, Diptirekha Padhi, Humane Sagar, Maheswari Pradhan and Shasank Sekhar were among the singers.
Rather than a cinema release, the film premiered on Tarang TV on 16 June 2019.

Q112256168.lead: Didi Namaskar is a 2022 Odia-language television film produced by Ajay Rout, with Saswat and Sheetal Patra in the lead roles.

p: Rajani Ranjan wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue, and Ajay Rout produced the film. Mrutyunjay Sahu directed; his surname also appears as Patra in some credits.
Prasant Padhi composed the music and Nirmal Nayak wrote the songs. The vocals were by Asima Panda, Kuldeep Pattanaik, Satyajit Pradhan and Antara Chakraborty.
The film premiered on the Zee Sarthak channel on 17 April 2022.

Q119889691.lead: IPS Durga is a 2023 Odia-language television film directed by Raja D, with Suryamayee Mohapatra in the title role.

p: Bijay Kandoi produced the film under the Vidisha Craft banner, and Bharadwaj Panda wrote the story. Suryamayee Mohapatra played Durga, supported by Sukanta Rath, Mahaprasad Kar and Madhumita Mohanty.
Goodly Rath composed the music to lyrics by Surya Mohapatra; Shasank Sekhar and Asima Panda were among the singers.
Zee Sarthak premiered the film on 24 April 2023.

Q56047969.lead: Paradesi Babu is a 1999 Odia-language film directed by Hara Patnaik and starring Siddhanta Mahapatra, Rachna Banerjee and Bijay Mohanty.

p: Amiya Ranjan Patnaik both produced the film and wrote its story. Hara Patnaik wrote the screenplay and directed, and also acted in it, while Subodh Patnaik wrote the dialogue. The cinematographer was Samba Siva Rao and the editor Deben Mishra. Jayiram Samal, Braja Singh and Jasmin Tamanna Tithi were also in the cast.
Allauddin Ali directed the music and Debdas Chhotray wrote the lyrics. Nibedita, Sonu Nigam and T. Sauri were among the playback singers.

Q140441081.lead: Mo Bhai Jaga is a 2025 Odia-language film directed by Santosh Biswal, starring Bikram Keshari Mohanty, Asima Pati and Subhashree Barik, that premiered on television and streaming.

p: Tofan Kumar Jena produced the film. The story and screenplay are credited to the Tarang Team, with dialogue by Subhranshu Sekhar Panda. Prem edited the film.
Baibhab Pruseth composed the music and Prakash Chandra Jena wrote the songs, which were sung by Rashmiprabha, Antariksha and others.
It was released on Tarang TV and Tarang Plus on 29 June 2025.

Q56060783.lead: Jibana Mrutyu is a 2005 Odia-language film directed by Raju Misra, with Sunil Kumar and Amelie Panda in the leading roles.

p: Sunanda Kar produced the film. Bijay Mishra wrote the story and dialogue, and Raju Misra shared the story credit, wrote the screenplay, directed and handled the cinematography. Susanta Mani was the editor. The supporting cast included Mihir Das, Aparajita Mohanty, Uttam Mohanty, Munna Khan, Ilu Banerjee and George Tiadi.
Swarup Nayak both composed the music and wrote the lyrics.

Q64780915.lead: Selfish Dil is a 2019 Odia-language film directed by Basanta Sahu, starring Shreyan Nayak and Suryamayee Mohapatra.

p: Mohammad Safi wrote the dialogue and Basanta Sahu directed. The film marked the screen debut of its lead actor, Shreyan Nayak. Dhrubananda Panda was the cinematographer and Rajesh Das the editor. Bijay Mohanty, Munna Khan, Salil Mitra, Guddu and Payal also appeared.
Soumitri Palai directed the music, with lyrics by Nirmal Nayak and Sanjay Mahakul. Humane Sagar, Tariq Aziz and Asima Panda were among the singers.
The film's release date is given as 4 July 2019.

Q140266985.lead: Maa Mora Sahabharasa is a 2025 Odia-language television film written and directed by Tushar Kumar Sinha, who also acts in it alongside Bikram Keshari Mohanty and Nikita Mishra.

p: Bijay Kandoi produced the film under the Vidisha Craft banner. Tushar Kumar Sinha wrote the story and screenplay, and Sunil wrote the dialogue. Ashu Kumar was the cinematographer and Suresh Sahu the editor. Pralipta Priyadarshini completed the main cast.
Santosh Kumar composed the music and also wrote the songs.
The film premiered on Tarang TV and Tarang Plus on 21 September 2025.

Q42550927.lead: Premika is a 2013 Odia-language film directed by Shiba Prasad Mohanty, with Prakruti Mishra in the lead role.

p: Bijay Kumar Behera produced the film and wrote its story. Shiba Prasad Mohanty wrote the screenplay and directed, Rajani Ranjan wrote the dialogue and Prem Shankar was the cinematographer. The cast also included Bulu, Rudra Panigrahi, Abhishek Mishra, Swarnali Banerjee, Asrumochan Mohanty and Debu Bose.
Bibhuti Bhusan directed the music.
The film was released on 30 August 2013.

Q27150253.lead: Love You Hamesha is a 2015 Odia-language film starring Arindam Roy and Jhillik Bhattacharya, and the first production of Sabitri Cine Production.

p: The film was made under the Sabitri Cine Production banner, with Suresh Kumar Haibru and Smruti Ranjan Rout as producers. Himanshu Parija is credited as director and screenwriter, although the direction is also attributed to Chandi Parija. Rahul and Mantu wrote the story. Mihir Das, Piyush Tripathy, Sritam Das, Anita Das, Saroj Das and Salil Mitra were among the supporting cast.

Prem Anand directed the music. The lyricists included Bijay Malla, Arun Mantri and Basantaraj Samal, and the songs were sung by Ira Mohanty, Sricharan, Humane Sagar, Kumar Bapi, Samiksha, Sohini Mishra, Ratikant Satapathy and Shreya Mishra.
It was released on 12 June 2015, during the Raja festival.

Q109519698.lead: Paro Hates Devdas is a 2021 Odia-language television film directed by Ashok Pati, starring Babi Mishra and Priya Chaudhury.

p: Ramesh Barik produced the film. R. Bhagat Singh was the cinematographer and Ranjan Khatei the editor. Manaswini Pati and Srijit Mohapatra were also in the cast.
Baidyanath Dash composed the music and Nirmal Nayak wrote the lyrics. Asima Panda, Gaurav Anand, Humane Sagar, Lipsa Mohapatra and Abhijit Majumdar were among the singers.
The film premiered on television on 29 August 2021 and was available on Tarang Plus. It runs for 2 hours 8 minutes.

Q55861530.lead: Lat Saheb is a 1999 Odia-language film written and directed by Basanta Sahu, with Mihir Das heading the cast.

p: Subhakanta Sahu produced the film. Basanta Sahu wrote the story and screenplay and directed, while Narayan Sahu wrote the dialogue. Dilip Ray was the cinematographer and Ashok Sharma the editor. Kuna Tripathy, Suresh Bal, Debu Bose, Panki Pradhan and Badal Mohanty were among the other actors.
Swarup Nayak directed the music.
The film was released on 14 January 1999.

Q109519694.lead: Ardha Satya is a 2021 Odia-language film written and directed by Bharadwaj Panda, with Hara Rath and Sradha Panigrahi in the lead roles.

p: Kaushik Das produced the film, and Bharadwaj Panda wrote both the story and the screenplay. Matruprasad Parida shot the film and co-edited it with Maninder Pattnaik. RJ Guddi, Krishna Sourav, Shailen Routray, Rabindranath Mishra and Barsa Samal appeared in supporting roles.

A special screening was held on 8 October 2021 at Cinepolis in the Esplanade Mall, Rasulgarh, attended by Prashant Nanda as a guest along with members of the cast and crew. The film was then made available to viewers on Aao Nxt.

Q41532082.lead: Sindura is a 2014 Odia-language film directed by Simanchal Nayak, with Siddhanta Mahapatra and Namrata Thapa in the lead roles.

p: Pranay Jethy produced the film. Simanchal Nayak wrote the story in addition to directing, and Rajani Ranjan wrote the screenplay and dialogue. Anu Choudhury, Minaketan, Namrata Das, Saroj Das and Braja Singh were also in the cast.
Badri Narayan Mohanty composed the music, and the songs were written by Arun Mantri and Jatindra Pradhan.

Q56760365.lead: Devajani is a 1981 Odia-language film written and directed by Byomkesh Tripathy, starring Ajit Das and Sharabani Ray.

p: Byomkesh Tripathy wrote the screenplay and dialogue, directed the film and also appeared in it. K. S. Prasad was the cinematographer and A. Sanjeev the editor. The cast also featured Ramachandra Pratihari, Chakrapani, Purnima, Jyotsna Das, Bhanumati Devi, Umapada Nanda and Rita Biswal. The film runs for 136 minutes.
Prafulla Kar directed the music and wrote the songs, which were sung by Vani Jayaram, Chitta Jena and Pranab Patnaik, among others.
The film was released on 10 April 1981.

Q27923926.lead: Radha is a 1984 Odia-language film written and directed by J. H. Sattar and produced by Subrat Samantaray, who also leads the cast.

p: J. H. Sattar wrote the story and screenplay and directed, and Bijay Mishra wrote the dialogue. Ashok Swain was the cinematographer and Haramohan the editor. Alongside Subrat Samantaray, the cast included Kasturi Badu, Deepa Sahu, Biren Routray, Surya Mishra, Raju Mishra, Jayiram Samal, Jaya B, Geeta Rao and Nagesh.
Kamal Pattnaik directed the music, and Chitta Jena and Anuradha Paudwal were among the playback singers.

Q116838663.lead: Bandini is a 2023 Odia-language television film directed by Pinu Nayak, with Subhasis Sharma and Riya Dey in the lead roles.

p: Khirod Pattnaik produced the film and Janmejaya Panda wrote the story. Babi Mishra, Saroj Das, Subhransu Nayak and Manisha Rath were among the supporting cast.
Abhijit Majumdar composed the music to lyrics by Nirmal Nayak. The singers included Swayam Padhi, Antara Chakraborty, Abhijit Majumdar, S. Jitu, Lipsa and Sasmita.
The film premiered on Zee Sarthak on 19 February 2023.

Q36531672.lead: Kalki is a 2015 Odia-language film directed by Tapas Sargharia and produced by Arindam Roy, who also plays the lead opposite Riya Dey.

p: Bharadwaj Panda wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue. Rabindra Behera was the cinematographer, and Nanja and Sabyasachi edited the film. The supporting cast included Jyotirmayee Bal, Harihar Mahapatra, Satyaki Mishra, Pradyumna Lenka, Asit Pati and Sunil Sankhua.
Bibhuti Bhusan Gadanayak directed the music.
The film was released on 25 November 2015.

Q140142445.lead: Udhara Karibu Satapurusha is a 2025 Odia-language television film written and directed by Sanjay Nayak, with Jyoti Prakash Panda and Helina in the lead roles.

p: Ajay Rout produced the film, and Sanjay Nayak wrote the story as well as directing. Pradyumna Lenka, Kedar Mishra, Rajashree, Subhransu Nayak and Biren Mishra were among the supporting cast.
Baidyanath Dash composed the music and Nirmal Nayak wrote the lyrics. Shasank Sekhar, Sanju Mohanty, Chiragdeep Panda and Neha Niharika Kar were among the singers.
Zee Sarthak premiered the film on 12 October 2025.

Q27536672.lead: Tu Je Sei is a 2016 Odia-language film directed by Ashok Pati, starring Babushaan, Sheetal Patra and Riya Dey, and based on the Tamil film Raja Rani.

p: Sitaram Agrawal produced the film under the Sarthak Movies banner; it was that company's sixteenth film. Ranjit Pattnaik is credited as writer. Babushaan played the hero opposite two heroines, Sheetal Patra and Riya Dey, and Debasish appeared in a supporting role.
Bikash Das directed the music. The songs were sung by Namita Agrawal, Sourin Bhatt and Babushaan, among others.
The film was released on 1 January 2016.
Its story is taken from the Tamil film Raja Rani.

Q140938371.lead: Chithi Lekhichi Mo Chaka Akhiku is a 2026 Odia-language television film directed by Mahesh Hazra and produced by Sitaram Agrawal and Namita Agrawal.

p: Priyabrata Panda wrote the story. Rashmi Rekha Behera, Abhijit Patra, Saroj Parida and Mithi headed the cast. Shubham was the cinematographer, and Satyajit and Mrutyunjay edited the film.
Sarthak Agrawal composed the music and Arun Mantri wrote the songs. Adya Adhikari, Debasmita Acharya, Swarup Gautam and Shraddha Shree were among the singers.
The film premiered on Sidharth TV on 19 July 2026.

Q43303445.lead: Jaggu Autowala is a 2012 Odia-language film directed by James Anthony, produced by Pupinder Singh, who also stars opposite Pamela Mondal.

p: Prakash Baral wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue. The film was made in Bengali as well as Odia. Bijay Mohanty, Tandra Ray, Manoj Mishra, Prince and Suman were in the supporting cast.
Abhijit Majumdar directed the music, and Antara Chakraborty was among the singers.
The film was released on 7 December 2012.

Q29431869.lead: Agni Parikshya is a 1980 Odia-language film directed by Balai Sen from a story by Ashapurna Devi, starring Sriram Panda and Mahasweta Ray.

p: Ram Avtar Jalan produced the film, and Bijay Mishra wrote the dialogue. Bimal Mukherjee was the cinematographer. Prasanna Pati, Surya Mishra, Snigdha Mohanty, Nagen Ray and Saraswati were also in the cast.
Shantanu Mahapatra directed the music and Guru Krushna Goswami wrote the lyrics. Bhikari Bal, Swarup Chakraborty and Debasish Mahapatra were among the singers.
The film was released on 18 April 1980.

Q55466646.lead: Jouthi Thile Bi Tu Mora is an Odia-language film written and directed by Srikant Gautam, with Riya Dey as the heroine and Sambit Acharya and Aryan Dash as the two heroes. It was described as an upcoming release.

p: Nitesh Pandey and Vinit Sapru produced the film. Srikant Gautam wrote the story and screenplay and also acted in it. Sambit Acharya played Sagar, Riya Dey played Payal and Aryan Dash played Akash, with Babi Mishra, Meghna Mishra and Pupinder Singh in other roles.
Prem Anand directed the music, and Srikant Gautam wrote the song lyrics.

Q40895615.lead: Mental is a 2014 Odia-language film directed by Dilip Panda, starring Anubhav Mohanty and Barsha Priyadarshini.

p: Anuprash Mohanty produced the film, and Nirmal Nayak wrote the dialogue as well as the songs. Chandrasekhar Mishra was the editor. Harihar Mahapatra, Raimohan Parida, Pintu Nanda, Saroj Das, Salil Mitra and Rock Patra were in the supporting cast.
Prem Anand directed the music. Mika Singh, Humane Sagar, Javed Ali, Palak, Vinod Rathod and Ritu Pattnaik were among the singers.
The film was released on 2 October 2014.

Q119889709.lead: Pakhe Pakhe Thibi Harpal is a 2023 Odia-language television film directed by Tripati Sahu, with Sambit Acharya and Tamanna Vyas in the lead roles.

p: Sitaram Agrawal and Namita Agrawal produced the film under the Sidharth Music banner. Nirmal Nayak wrote the story and dialogue, and Tripati Sahu wrote the screenplay. Ajit was the cinematographer and Rajesh Das the editor.
Baidyanath Dash composed the music. Arun Mantri and Nirmal Nayak were among the lyricists, and the singers included Arpita Choudhury, R. S. Kumar, Neha Niharika Kar and Humane Sagar.
The film premiered on television on 14 June 2023.

Q61640987.lead: Premare Rakhichi 100 Ru 100 is a 2019 Odia-language film directed by Sanjay Nayak, with Jyoti Ranjan Nayak and Riya Dey in the lead roles.

p: Biranchi Narayan Panda and Dilip Kumar Dash produced the film, and Dash also wrote the story. Sanjay Nayak wrote the screenplay and directed. Premanjan Parida, Biju Badajena, Guddu and Amar were also in the cast.
Malay Mishra directed the music, with lyrics by Nirmal Nayak and Arun Mantri among others. The singers included Sabisesh, Diptirekha Padhi, Ira Mohanty and Swayam Padhi.
The release date is given as 10 February 2019.

Q115786313.lead: Sahari Bagha is a 2022 Odia-language film produced and directed by Ramana Moguli, with Sambit Acharya and Pavani in the lead roles.

p: Rajendra Bharadwaj wrote the story and Sunil Bapi the dialogue, while Ramana Moguli wrote the screenplay in addition to producing and directing. Nagendra Kumar was the cinematographer and V. Nagireddy the editor. Prithviraj Nayak, Bahubali Prabhakar, Bhupal Raj, Ravi, Vijay Bhaskar and Sanjay Mahananda were in the supporting cast.
Bole Shavali directed the music. Humane Sagar, Bishnu Mohan Kabi, Amrita Nayak and Satyajit Pradhan were among the singers.
The film was released on 11 November 2022.

Q141048998.lead: Kemiti Bhulibi Mun is a 2024 Odia-language television film directed by Himanshu Parija and produced by Sitaram Agrawal.

p: Chinmay Das Pattnaik wrote the story, screenplay and dialogue. The cast listed for the film includes Dipak Barik, Poonam Mishra, Divya Mohanty and Pradyumna Lenka.
Baidyanath Dash and Sumit Dixit composed the music. Srikant Gautam and Nihar Priyasish were among the lyricists, and Diptirekha Padhi, S. Jitu, Humane Sagar and Pragya Hota among the singers.
The film premiered on Sidharth TV on 1 January 2024.

Q60368327.lead: Jay Hind is a 2014 Odia-language film directed by Ranjan Misra, with Dipan Das and Amrita in the lead roles.

p: Pravati Mohapatra produced the film and wrote its story. Ranjan Misra wrote the screenplay and directed, and Ashutosh Barik and Sanchit wrote the dialogue. Minaketan, Akshay Bastia, Namrata Das, Saroj Das, Choudhury Bikash Das and Hadu were among the supporting cast.
Shantiraj Khosla composed the music.
The film was released on 4 April 2014.

Q42892689.lead: Pratisodha Aparadh Nuhen is a 1989 Odia-language film written and directed by Binod Nanda and produced by Bijay Nanda.

p: Binod Nanda wrote the story as well as directing. Ashok Swain was the cinematographer and Rabi Shankar Pattnaik the editor. The cast included Bijay Mohanty, Pushpa Panda, Mihir Das, Debu Bose, Debu Brahma, Dukhiram Swain, Jayiram Samal and Asit Pati.
Basudev Rath directed the music, with lyrics by Binod Nanda and Dibyashree. Debasish Mahapatra, Anuradha Paudwal, Swagatika Rath and Tansen Singh were among the singers.

Q15725323.lead: Sabitri is a 1995 Odia-language film directed by Jitendra Mahapatra, notable as the screen debut of Sritam Das.

p: Basudev Tripathy produced the film and wrote the story. Jitendra Mahapatra wrote the screenplay and directed, and Nizam wrote the dialogue. Samba Siva Rao was the cinematographer and Deben Mishra the editor. Sritam Das began his Odia film career here, acting alongside Mihir Das, Bijay Mohanty, Runu Parija, Anisha Das, Hara Patnaik and Saumen Pujari.
Sibu Jena directed the music and Nizam wrote the lyrics.

Q55455055.lead: Sarpanch Babu is a 1999 Odia-language film directed by Chakrapani, starring Siddhanta Mahapatra and Ajit Das.

p: Mahesh Paidi produced the film and also acted in it. T. Madhu wrote the story, Bijay Malla the dialogue, and Chakrapani the screenplay. Bijay and Harinath Reddy handled the cinematography, and Murali Ramya edited the film. Anuradha, Chandrashree, Satyaki Mishra, Raimohan Parida, Jayiram Samal and Braja Singh were also in the cast.
Amarendra Mohanty directed the music.

Q33138156.lead: Asilu Jebe Tu Jaana Pheri is a 2016 Odia-language film directed by the duo Babuda and Dipun, starring Pinky Priyadarshini and Piyush.

p: Pritiranjan Sahu produced the film under the Maa Biraja Movies banner. Simamayee Gurubala wrote the story and Ajay Samal is credited as writer, while Babuda and Dipun wrote the screenplay as well as directing. Deepak, Kuna Tripathy, Asit Pati, Jiban Panda and Salil Mitra played supporting roles.
S. Chandrakant directed the music and Arun Mantri wrote the songs.
The film was released on 23 September 2016.

Q110197598.lead: Ardhangini is a 2021 Odia-language television film directed by Bobby Islam and produced by Debasish Patra, who also stars with Monalisa Patra and Lipsa Mishra.

p: Rajani Ranjan wrote the dialogue. Niranjan Das and Shubham were the cinematographers, and Rajesh Das edited the film. Pradyumna Lenka, Suresh Bal, Amrita Shukla, Akash and Ayush appeared in supporting roles.
Goodly Rath composed the music to lyrics by Surya Mohapatra, with vocals by Ira Mohanty, Humane Sagar and Lipsa Mohapatra among others.
The film premiered on Zee Sarthak on 19 December 2021.

Q114804728.lead: Oye Anjali is a 2022 Odia-language film written and directed by Ramashankar, with Swaraj Barik, Manavi Patel, Shreyan Nayak and Jogesh Jojo in the cast.

p: Suman Barma produced the film. Ramashankar wrote the story and screenplay, and Debasish Aswini Gadanayak wrote the dialogue. B. Laxman was the cinematographer and Asif Khan the editor.
Prem Anand directed the music and Basantaraj Samal wrote the lyrics. Biswajit Mahapatra, Diptirekha Padhi, Humane Sagar, Saurav, Ashutosh Mohanty and Ananya Sritam Nanda were among the singers.
The film was released on 14 October 2022.

Q29380819.lead: Tapori is a 2017 Odia-language film directed by Biswajit Panda, with Ardhendu Sahu and Anwesha in the lead roles.

p: Adikanda Sahu produced the film. Suresh Pattnaik wrote the screenplay and Dibya is credited as writer. Prafulla Sahu was the cinematographer. Pratibha Panda, Mihir Das, Pragya Khatua, Gyan, Guddu, Harihar Das and Amar were also in the cast.
Asad Nizam directed the music and Tapu Nayak wrote the lyrics. The singers included Udit Narayan, Vinod Rathod, Kuldeep, Diksu and Satyajit Pradhan.
The film was released on 13 April 2017.

Q140535823.lead: Sunanaki Bohu is a 2025 Odia-language television film directed by Mrutyunjay Sahu, with Sapnali Mishra, Nikita Mishra, Pushpa Panda and Prithviraj Nayak in the cast.

p: Umesh Pattnaik produced the film, and Priyabrata Panda wrote the story and dialogue.

Baidyanath Dash composed the music. The lyrics were written by Arun Mantri, Umakanta Nayak and Nihar Priyasish, and Anurag Das, Asima Panda, Chiragdeep Panda and Arpita Choudhury were among the singers.
Zee Sarthak premiered the film on 27 April 2025.

Q43274190.lead: Kidnap is a 2014 Odia-language film directed by Simanchal Nayak, featuring Minaketan, Saroj Das, Runu Mahapatra, Kedar Mishra, Pushpa Panda and Linkan Pattnaik.

p: Lokanath Das and Nabin Chandra Parichha produced the film, with Das also writing the story. Dr Rajani Ranjan wrote the screenplay and dialogue.
Prasant Padhi directed the music.
The film was released on 9 August 2014.
Saurav Nayak received an award at the 26th Odisha State Film Awards for his playback singing in the film.

Q55455082.lead: Saubhagyabati is a 1998 Odia-language film written and directed by Basanta Sahu, starring Siddhanta Mahapatra, Jyoti Mishra, Mihir Das and Uttam Mohanty.

p: Ranjit Rout produced the film. Basanta Sahu wrote the story and screenplay and directed, and Ramesh Panigrahi wrote the dialogue. Dilip Ray was the cinematographer and Ashok Sharma the editor. Asrumochan Mohanty, Rakesh Jain, Debu Bose, Suresh Bal, Jayiram Samal, Rabi Mishra and Saroj Das were also in the cast.
Swarup Nayak directed the music, and the lyricists included Srikanta Das and Swarup Nayak.

Q60590428.lead: Ajab Sanjura Gajab Love is a 2019 Odia-language film directed by Ashok Pati, with Babushaan Mohanty and Archita Sahu in the lead roles.

p: Nihar Samal and Bini Samal produced the film, and Ranjit Pattnaik wrote the dialogue. Sitanshu Mohapatra was the cinematographer and Sukumar Mani the editor. Mihir Das, Jiban Panda, Babi Mishra and Somadutta Das were in the supporting cast.
Prem Anand directed the music. Subrat Swain and Basantaraj Samal were among the lyricists, and the singers included Humane Sagar, Babushaan, Diptirekha Padhi, Ashutosh and Sabisesh.
The film was released on 13 January 2019.

Q47492660.lead: Agnisikha is a 2007 Odia-language film directed by Himanshu Parija, with Barsha Priyadarshini and Sunil Kumar in the lead roles.

p: Ashok Kandoi produced the film, and Himanshu Parija wrote the screenplay as well as directing. The supporting cast included Mihir Das, Hara Patnaik, Suresh Bal, Akshay Bastia, Saroj Das, Pradyumna Lenka, Pushpa Panda, Runu Parija, Papi Santuka and Braja Singh.
Manmath Mishra directed the music. Kumar Bapi, Sricharan, Alok Kundu, Sucharita Mishra, Rupali and Sailabhama were among the singers.

Q109519685.lead: 2 Chocolate is a 2021 Odia-language film written and directed by Sushant Mani, with Lohitaksha Pattnaik and Swapna Priyadarshini in the lead roles, released on an Odia streaming platform.

p: Akshaya Kumar Parija produced the film, and Sushant Mani wrote the story and screenplay. Lohitaksha Pattnaik played Raja and Swapna Priyadarshini played Ahana. Neetu Singh, Chittaranjan Tripathy, Linkan Pattnaik, Binay Dey, Dilip Choudhury and Gitimay Nanda were among the other actors. Subhranshu Das was the cinematographer and Sukumar Mani the editor.
The film was released on 5 November 2021 on Kanchalanka, an Odia OTT platform.

Q117221494.lead: Bahaghara Dot Com is a 2023 Odia-language film directed by Sudhanshu Mohan Sahu and produced by actor Pradyumna Lenka. It premiered on television rather than in cinemas.

p: Pradyumna Lenka produced the film and also appeared in it. Pradeep Kumar Sahoo and Sayal Banerjee played the lead roles, with Pushpa Panda among the supporting cast.
Goodly Rath composed the music, and the songs were written by Surya Mohapatra. The playback singers were Bishnu Mohan Kabi, Somesh Satpathy, Gaurav Anand, Lipsa Mohapatra, Lopamudra and Debanshi Das.
The film had its premiere on the television channel Zee Sarthak on 19 March 2023.

Q109519721.lead: Srikshetra is a 2021 Odia-language film written and directed by Tapas Sargharia and produced by Ajay Rout. It was released on television.

p: Tapas Sargharia wrote the screenplay in addition to directing. Pratap Rout handled the cinematography and Rajesh Das edited the film. The cast included Siddhanta Mahapatra, Sambit Acharya, Tamanna Vyas, Braja Singh and Priyanka Panigrahi.
The score and songs were composed by Goodly Rath, with lyrics by Surya Rath. Humane Sagar, Lipsa Mohapatra and Antara Chakraborty were among the singers.
Srikshetra premiered on Zee Sarthak on 24 January 2021.

Q6663417.lead: Loafer is an Odia-language film written and directed by Ashok Pati and produced by Sunil Panda, starring Babushaan Mohanty and Archita Sahu in the lead roles.

p: Ashok Pati wrote both the story and the screenplay, while Rajani Ranjan wrote the dialogue. Ramesh Babu was the cinematographer and Sukumar Mani the editor.

Besides the two leads, the cast featured Buddhaditya Mohanty, Samaresh Routray, Mihir Das, Aparajita Mohanty, Minaketan, Lovely, Priyanka Mahapatra, Jiban Panda, Bijaya Patnaik, Biresh Mishra and Uttam Mohanty, with Anmol Pati appearing as a child artist.
Goodly Rath was the music director.
The film was released on 14 January 2011.
